2791241084.title: Console Commands (Modding Tool), the mod works 100000% please just use it and enable the script break warning
2791241084.description:
Adds a bunch of commands that help with mod making and testing. Type the command into a text box that is opened using a new button in the top left (see screenshot). Press the button to the right to execute the typed-in command.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2791241084/3317484899042502888/]List of DB keys and how to find them[/url]

Some commands have arguments in [b]<bold>[/b] and you need to supply a valid value there, e.g. wh_main_emp_empire instead of [b]<faction_key>[/b] (so without the <>, it's here to increase visibility):
[list]
[*]give gold [b]<number>[/b] - gives [b]<number>[/b] of gold to the player (can also be negative), if you have a settlement selected it will give gold to the faction owning the settlement
[*]give gold - gives 50000 gold to the player, same faction things as above
[*]fow on - fog of war on
[*]fff - fog of war off
[*]am - restore selected char movement points
[*]mov - gives the selected character a buff with bonus movement points (applied after you end the turn)
[*]mov off - removes the buff with bonus movement points from the selected character (removed after you end the turn)
[*]au [b]<unit_key>[/b] [b]<number>[/b] - add [b]<number>[/b] of units with unit_key to selected army*
[*]au [b]<unit_key>[/b] - add unit with unit_key to selected army*
[*]add axp [b]<number>[/b] - add [b]<number>[/b] of ranks to all units of selected army
[*]add axp - add 1 rank to all units of selected army
[*]add xp [b]<number>[/b] - add [b]<number>[/b] of xp points to the selected character, unembed heroes to give them xp
[*]primary [b]<number>[/b] - set primary slot level of selected region to [b]<number>[/b]
[*]primary - set primary slot level of selected region to max
[*]region - gives 1000 growth, 1000 horde growth and 1 turn build speed to all player regions
[*]region off - turns off region
[*]gr - gives the player ownership of the selected region
[*]gr [b]<faction_key>[/b] - gives [b]<faction_key>[/b] ownership of the selected region, if a faction has no regions or armies on the map you can't give them a region, spawn them an army first
[*]abandon - makes the selected region be abandoned
[*]kill - kills (or wounds if immortal) the selected character and his army
[*]technology - gives the player +2000% research speed
[*]technology [b]<number>[/b]  - gives the player [b]<number>[/b]% research speed (can also be negative)
[*]technology off - remove the technology bonuses
[*]global rec [b]<number>[/b]  - changes the player's global recruitment time by [b]<number>[/b] of turns  (use negative value to lower)
[*]global rec off - remove the global recruitment time bonuses
[*]heal [b]<number>[/b] - sets health of each unit in the selected army to [b]<number>[/b], that is between 0-100
[*]to_pool [b]<agent_key>[/b] [b]<agent_subtype_key>[/b] - adds a lord to the player faction recruit pool, the name will be blank and the character won't be immortal, cross-race stuff won't work without table adjustments
[*]item [b]<ancillary_key>[/b]  - gives the player an ancillary (items characters can equip), giving mounts won't work, some items are culture-locked
[*]tele  - first select a character, then select another character or a settlement as a teleport target, after that typing tele will teleport the character
[*]at [b]<trait_key>[/b] - adds a trait to the selected character, e.g. add trait wh2_dlc09_trait_defeated_settra
[*]at [b]<trait_key>[/b] [b]<points>[/b] - for traits with multiple levels
[*]rt [b]<trait_key>[/b] - removes a trait
[*]spawn [b]<subtype>[/b] [b]<faction_key>[/b] [b]<units>[/b] - spawns an army next to selected character or settlement, use agent_subtype in the Character art sets table, where the agent_type is "general", faction_key and units are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2094338970/2793873197769912565/]optional[/url]
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2791241084/3775742652429304429/]More command descriptions here since I hit the workshop word limit:[/url]
[list]
[*]shroud2
[*]kill2, killc, killc2
[*]agent agent_type agent_subtype
[*]bb building_key
[*]prg, ancies
[*]etc.
[/list]

Commands related to resources, you probably want one of the pooled resources:
[list]
[*]res [b]<pooled_res_key>[/b] [b]<number>[/b] - add [b]<number>[/b] of a [b]<pooled_res_key>[/b] to the player faction (can be negative), look in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2094338970/2250056952644776979/]discussion thread[/url] for a list of keys
[*]hef_inf [b]<number>[/b]  - gives the player a faction buff that gives [b]<number>[/b] of High Elf influence per turn, can be negative
[*]hef_inf off - remove the High Elf influence bonuses
[*]other_res [b]<number>[/b] - way to change chivalry, type other_res [b]<number>[/b] to adjust how much you get those every turn, you don't need to specify the resource name here
[/list]

Commands related to diplomacy, you can disable fog of war to be able to select any region:
[list]
[*]alliance - make a military alliance with the owner of the currently selected settlement or character
[*]peace - make peace with the owner of the currently selected settlement or character
[*]trade - make a trade agreement with the owner of the currently selected settlement or character
[*]confederate - confederate the owner of the currently selected settlement or character
[*]war - starts a war between the player and the owner of the currently selected settlement or character
[*]vassal- some thing as above
[*]milaccess - military access
[*]defalliance - defensive alliance
[*]alliance2, peace2, trade2, confederate2, war2, vassal2, milaccess2, defalliance2 - same thing as the commands above but can target any 2 factions, and not necessarily involve the player faction, so the way it works: select first region, select second region, type the command (for example war2)
[/list]

2791799449.title: Modding Development Tools: Lua Console!
2791799449.description:
Happy Warhammer III! This one is a relatively simple mod, used for running Lua code within the game. Built heavily off of existing Creative Assembly scripts and UI files, which have been changed pretty majorly for further functionality.

[h1]How To Use[/h1]
In-game, press "Shift+F3". This will open up the Lua Console window. From there, you can move the window around, type in your code into it, and execute it using the "Run" button. You can also use the "Clear" button to empty out the console completely.

You can run `console_print()` to print things out to the console (either from within the console, or within your external Lua files), or you can `return` things to get them printed out to the console. The console will also print out an error if any is found in your code.

Right now, there is support for only 8 lines of code, but each line can go as long as you would like. Next patch will include a vertical scroll so there can be a much higher limit of lines.

Any Lua variable that exists within the global scope (ie. it isn't defined as "local") can be accessed within the Lua Console - it can trigger listeners, print out info, call "cm" if it's available, and so on.

If you aren't planning on using Lua, this mod probably isn't necessary for you.

If you'd like easier-to-use commands, a la older Age of Empires games, use
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2791241084.

[h1]API[/h1]
The following global functions are added by this mod:

[code]
console_print(text) -- prints out the text provided to the Console itself.
console_printf(text, ...) -- prints out the text provided to the Console itself, after using string.format() on the text provided. You can use, for instance, `console_printf("My name is %s", "Charles")` to print "My name is Charles". More info at http://www.cplusplus.com/reference/cstdio/printf/

t_get(table, index) -- returns the value found in the table at index. Long-hand workaround for `value = table[index]`.
t_set(table, index, value) -- sets the value to the table at index. Long-hand workaround for `table[index] = value`
[/code]
[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
Future updates will include Quality of Life improvements, as well as introductions of other forms of modding development tools - more ways to access game information, quick-use buttons to interact with the world similar to RimWorld's development tools, etc.

Check out the planned updates, the progress, and download the updated packs at https://github.com/chadvandy/devtools


[url=https://discord.gg/moddingden][img]https://i.imgur.com/R4kQ0hO.png[/img][/url]

2794696516.title: Landmarks of Legend
2794696516.description:
[h1]OVERVIEW[/h1]
Landmarks of Legend adds a variety of landmarks to locations all over the Warhammer world, with some landmarks granting access to special units and Regiments of Renown, while others grant new items or unique effects. Additionally, some landmarks can even grant Legendary Lords or Heroes if you have the companion mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2931087074]Heroes of Legends[/url] enabled!

Currently, there are landmarks for the following factions:
- Grand Cathay
- Kislev
- Khorne
- Slaanesh
- Nurgle
- Tzeentch
- Ogre Kingdoms
- Legion of Chaos
- The Empire
- Vampire Counts
- Skaven
- Bretonnia
- Tomb Kings
- Greenskins
- Dwarfs
- Wood Elves
- High Elves
- Dark Elves
- Lizardmen
- Beastmen
- Norsca
- Warriors of Chaos
- Vampire Coast
- Chaos Dwarfs
- Nagash

You can find a detailed list of all the landmarks in the mod currently and other planned ones [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e7ImhWdK6YY3Az9HYGz2D5VSetNgns_bw2_OkwggTNk/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
- Over 200 landmarks
- Over 80 special units/RoRs (Can be disabled; more info below)
- Custom unit cards and landmark icons
- Custom settlement icons for Wei Jin and Zharr Nagrund
- New models for most Norscan Monster Hunt bosses
- Legendary Lords & Heroes if you have the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2931087074]Heroes of Legends[/url] mod enabled


[h1]<<NOTICE>>[/h1]
- Place Mixu's Unlocker above this mod (if you are using it)

- This mod will work fine without the Unlocker but you will lose the ability to build a large number of landmarks. This is because the Unlocker edits the startpos files and allows us to place buildings wherever we want. Editing these files would break compatability with most other mods.

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2931087074]Heroes of Legend[/url] is a companion mod that implements new playable factions, Legendary Lords & Heroes recruited from landmarks. Both are intended to be used in conjunction with eachother.

- Many landmarks from the WH2 mod "Landmarks of the Old World" have been integrated into this one.

- If you have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021&searchtext=mct]MCT[/url] enabled, then you can disable specific or all custom units added in this mod if you want to. This does [u]NOT[/u] mean MCT is required to run this mod.

- The spreadsheet has a column called "Status" when you scroll right, which will tell you if a landmark is currently in-game (listed as "Implemented") or if it isn't yet (listed as "Planned").

- If you encounter a crash, please check if the crash occurs when it's just this mod enabled (and the Unlocker if you use it).

- If a crash occurs or content from new updates are not working, unsubscribing and resubscribing to the mod should almost always fix it (especially right after a new update).

- If you encounter any bugs, typos, etc, please post them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2794696516/5456682769554320713/]Bug Report[/url] discussion.

- This mod works with The Old World map mod by ChaosRobie.

[h1]F.A.Q[/h1]
Do you need to start a new game for these changes to appear?
- No, but some scripted effects (like granting ancillary items or mercenaries) will not work.

Is this compatible with Immortal Landmarks and Landmarks of Eternity?
- Yes.

SFO?
- If you intend to play this mod with SFO then use the SFO submod listed below.

Will the AI build these landmarks/Will the AI recruit these units?
- Yes to both but AI recruitment of units can also be disabled if you have MCT enabled.


[h1]FUTURE PLANS[/h1]
- Rework/rebalance older landmarks, icons and units [Current Focus]

- Continue adding landmarks (leave any suggestions on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2794696516/5456682769554318094/]appropriate[/url] discussion page).


[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
- Some reports regarding a conflict with garrison mods.




[h1]SUBMODS[/h1]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2931087074]Heroes of Legend[/url] -- Companion mod to LoL; Adds new playable factions alongside a bunch of new characters that are recruited from landmarks.

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3231024410]SFO Compatibility mod[/url] by GabeSky

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3364003364]Radious Compatibility mod[/url] by The Bald Eagle

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2795817897]RU Translation mod[/url] by Gosudar

- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3507135981]2x Unit Size mod[/url] by SFH

2854346056.title: Immortal Landmarks
2854346056.description:
UPDATED FOR 8.0
The mod will run without Mixu, but you'll be missing a bunch (~80%) of the landmarks. Adding landmarks requires startpos modding, Mixu's Unlocker = common startpos framework that keeps mods compatible. 


[h1] KEY FEATURES [/h1] 

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/R1rto4r.png[/img]
                                                   [IMG]https://i.imgur.com/7OCrSDU.png[/img]

[h1] WHY GET THIS MOD? [/h1] 

Tired of building up generic province #26? This mod aims to make the world feel more dynamic by greatly expanding the landmark system used in vanilla. While the landmarks in this mod do include some standard landmark stuff (+2 order factionwide etc...), I tried to expand the design space of landmarks by including many effects which aren't used for vanilla landmarks. 

This includes things like landmarks that summon a storm in coastal regions, or give your armies in Ulthuan access to powerful cataclysm spells (in a balance-limited fashion); even a landmark which can make your city invisible and untargetable, for a cost. Rather than give +2 recruit rank to Slayers, why not design a cool new ability that Slayers will gain with the landmark? Instead of +10 growth, why not have landmarks that grant you cool weapons and artifacts, or landmarks that trigger quests for powerful items in the lore that aren't represented in the game? 

You can check out a list of landmarks, and a couple bullets on their biggest effects (there are ofc other effects, but I'm trying to keep the Google doc manageable), in the links below. NB that Steam hates Google doc links, just click through the warnings like you do for every other mod :p

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16VAJ5DVRbrPc_G8rAR9BuO1gaqJKmhvO5s_rq89Qqig/edit#gid=1172813702] Landmarks for order(ish) factions [/url] 
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16VAJ5DVRbrPc_G8rAR9BuO1gaqJKmhvO5s_rq89Qqig/edit#gid=1970654904] Landmarks for evil(ish) factions [/url]


[h1] GAME BALANCE [/h1] 

Because landmarks are inherently limited by region and faction, they are an excellent tool to spice up your campaign without greatly impacting overall balance. That said, I've tried to keep all effects broadly in line with vanilla balance. The AI will make full use of the new landmarks, that includes scripts which will give them quest rewards the same way they do for Legendary Lord quests. I hope that by letting the AI fully utilize landmarks, it will avoid making the player overpowered. But of course it is impossible for me to test every effect in every situation, so I encourage you to share your balance thoughts and feedback!  

[h1] COMPATIBILITY [/h1] 
[list]
    [*] Works with Immortal Empires Expanded mod
    [*] Does not add anything to the Chaosrobie's Old World Campaign map
    [*] MIXER IS COMPATIBLE WITH SFO, THIS MOD IS COMPATIBLE WITH SFO, WE'RE ALL COMPATIBLE WITH SFO. If you don't believe me, start a game with only this mod + Mixer + SFO. You too can become a scientist, using the scientific method to unravel the mysteries of compatibility!
    [*]RE SFO; note that, for the landmarks which add units or unit summons, the stats won't be aligned with the changes SFO makes to equivalent units. If someone wants to make a submod they are welcome to it. 
    [*]Requires a new game
    [*]Yes it's compatible with Landmarks of Legend (I think Inquisitor and I have avoided overlap)
    [*]Works with Immortal Empires or Realm of Chaos campaigns (but the locations in the documentation refer to IE locations!)
    [*]Polish translation submod here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2857387944
    [*]German Translation [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3569309957]Here: [/url], credit Balthasar23
 [*]Korean Translation [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3736806336]Here: [/url], credit 드로우달스
    [*]To use with other startpos mods (more slots, etc...), you will need a compatibility patch between the startpos mod and Mixu's unlocker. 
[/list]
If a mod is compatible with Mixu's unlocker mod, it should also be compatible with this one. If a mod isn't compatible with Mixu's unlocker, then...it won't be compatible with this one. Please report any incompatibilities and I'll look into it. 

[h1] FUTURE / OTHER NOTES [/h1] 

I have more landmarks planned, and will update this mod throughout the life of Immortal Empires. I also would like to include support for mod configuration tool to enable lore-strict vs. lore-loose settings. While more of the landmarks are loreful, I took minor creative liberties for the sake of gameplay on occasion (though I think the only landmarks that are entirely made up are Surtha Ek's workshop and a bunch of Cathay ones). In a few cases I moved the loreful location a bit to better fit with gameplay. 

There are a very small handful of new Regiment of Renown type units, but no normal 'unlimited recruitment' units. The new units included are mostly fun variants of existing units (Corrupted Terracotta Sentinel for Tzeentch, etc...). If you're interested in new units from landmarks though, I encourage you to check out Inquisitor's excellent [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794696516] Landmarks of Legend mod! [/url]   


[h1] CREDIT / THANKS [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Hate Criminal and Mall of America for their work on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1972169254] Landmarks of the Old World [/url]  (and all others credited with that mod). This mod was made with Hate Criminal's permission.
    [*]Spartan VI and Sjeng Nedam for new building icons, Vladislav Grechko for dilemma art,  
    [*]Zaskar70 and Zerg93 for the Black Guard of Morr model 
    [*]rossco437 and Scribe of Nekoti for suggestions and outright designing a few of the landmarks 
    [*]The incredible people over at [url=https://discord.com/invite/moddingden] Da Modding Den [/url], without whom I never wou

2854819509.title: Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords
2854819509.description:
WH2's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1736529254]Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords[/url] ported to [b]Total War: WARHAMMER III – Update 9.0.x[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

This mod transfers legendary/immortal lords and heroes of defeated factions to factions that are still in play. It works both for the player and the AI (though the player will be favored)!

[b]Scenario 1[/b]
Has that foolish counterpart of a Vampire Count refused to confederate, be reasonable or flat out irked the grand, righteous ruler that you are? Are you left with no choice but to defeat him, yet fear for the consequences as you can’t have their legendary lord this way? Well no more!

That’s right, they will serve their rightful masters! You can now pummel your "like-minded", bovine-staring-face neighbor into the ground, destroy his useless empire, sack all his cities, plunder him to your heart's content and then recruit his legendary lord as a fresh, empty-headed recruit!

[b]Scenario 2[/b]
You'd like to help the Last Defenders but as the Hexoatl you might as well be on another planet and confederating territories that far away might not be ideal.
Well, if he's ever defeated, you can now hire him, build up spanking shining new armies and lead him to retake his lost territories!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] After factions are defeated their legendary/immortal lords and heroes will be made available to remaining factions (player as well as AI) of the same subculture/race - e.g. A defeated Lizardmen faction will only join other Lizardmen factions (basically confederation with a few extra steps).
[*] Lords/heroes obtained this way will start off wounded.
[*] Legendary Lords/Heroes recruited this way are the "original" ones (not copies like in previous versions of the mod). This means there won't be doppelganger, item quests will work and the lord/hero will retain their level, items, skills and traits.
[*] This works with all legendary/immortal lords and heroes regardless whether they are modded or vanilla characters. No submods needed!
[*] Event messages indicating newly available lords/heroes will appear for all base game & dlc lords.
[*] Most factions, even if they are not able to confederate, benefits from this mechanic (e.g. Vampire Coast and Tomb Kings).
[*] By default, defeated faction won't join AI led factions before turn 50 (for balance reasons).
[*] By default, defeated factions prefer to join factions of the same race, they also prefer player over AI led faction, they furthermore prefer factions they already met, ones they had good relations with (before their demise) and they'd rather seek refuge with a playable (major) faction than a minor one.
[*]When your faction is chosen as the preferred refuge, you'll get the refugee dilemma shown in the image above. You then either:
[b]Accept[/b], to gain their immortal lords and heroes.
[b]Reject[/b] and another faction gets the dilemma.
[b]Kill[/b] them, so they can't join anyone (unless they manage to revive via rebellion).
[b]Delay[/b] your decision and decide again after 25 turn.
[*]By default chaos factions (Warriors of Chaos, Mono-god, Daemon and Norscan factions) can join each other, even across "race-barriers" if all factions of a given race are defeated and only chaos factions of another race are available (players-led chaos factions are allowed to accept refugees from different chaos-races even if there are other factions of that race remain alive).
There are mct-option to restrict this.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
Save to add at any point, but [b]not[/b] save to remove! You can disable the mod via mct option.
Should play well with most other mods.
Works with Immortal Empires and the Return of Chaos campaign on singleplayer, but is disabled during The Lost God prologue campagn.

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] The mod transfers lords/heroes whether or not they are real legendary lords or just immortal lords. On the one hand this means you won’t miss out on legendary lords even if they were just recently added, e.g. by a mod update (you’d get the lord even if no event message appears) on the other hand you’ll get lords from minor factions you may not necessarily want. This may lead to a slightly more crowded recruitment pool (you can make us of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2958113532]Execute (useless) Lords & Heroes[/url] mod to remedy this issue). 
[*] If you add the mod mid campaign and a lot of factions are already defeated by that point it may take a few turns for all characters to be assigned to their new factions. This was done deliberately to limit start turn lag.
[*] If the player confederated recently then defeated characters will be transferred after the confederation penalty is expired.
[*] Since the script uses confederation methods to transfer defeated characters, AI or player factions that take on defeated lords will have their original faction name changed to their "confederation name".
[*] Faction that "were confederated" can't spawn endgame armies. In case you want the endgame events to be as scary as possible, I'd recommend setting the "AI Delay" (by default it's 50 turns) mct-option to a value greater than the maximum end turn number you set at campaign start.
[*] MP: Desync galore
[/list]

2859968660.description:
This is a startpos mod that makes all factions in Realms of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns playable.
This mod also adds some modder utilities like ability to increase number of building slots, additional hero categories and other things that require startpos modding.


[h1]"You still need to buy the DLC if you wish to play with DLC factions" [/h1]
No, seriously, this mod does not give you free DLCs.
If you actually wanna know what this mod does, skip to "What's included".
I'm tired of seeing this asked.
I'm tired of having to explain this simple thing.
I'm tired of people not reading the mod descriptions.
I'm tired, boss.


[h1]MCT Requirement:[/h1]
The newest version of MCT is recommended to be used with this mod.
It will work without it, but your save files will be bigger.
Don't use MCT if you plan on playing multiplayer, unless Groovy makes mct work in multiplayer at some point and I forget to update this blurb.

[h1]What's included:[/h1]

With this mod there are now 458 playable lords in IE and 141 playable lords in RoC.
Some of those factions require other mods before they can be played.

It also provides a framework for other modders to use stuff like new agent types for existing factions and unique building slot templates for landmark mods.

This mod edits the max number of available building slots, so that it's compatible with mods that increase the number of building slots. Major settlements have a max of 20 and minors a max of 8.
This mod itself shouldn't increase any available slots, you will need other mods for that.

[h1]Compatibility:[/h1]
This mod edits startpos and isn't compatible with other startpos mods.
This mod edits some vanilla scripts, like monster hunt script and some narrative script stuff, it's to make all factions actually playable without script errors.
This does mean that some other mods may conflict if they edit these same script files.


[h1]"You do actually genuinely need to buy the goshdarn DLCs if you wish to play factions that are behind a DLC or Warhammer 2 or Warhammer 1" [/h1]

2927955021.title: Mod Configuration Tool - v0.9 Beta
2927955021.description:
[b]USE IN MULTIPLAYER AT YOUR OWN RISK.[/b] Solutions have been researched for years. There are a few promising ones I will be testing shortly, but until they're in - consider MCT MP as "thar be dragons" territory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jYDc60V.png[/img]

The Mod Configuration Tool is a user interface, and a rich backend system, which enables modders to create settings for their mods, which can be edited within the Mod Configuration Tool. [b]In short, if a mod you use doesn't use this, you don't really need it.[/b] That said, I'd love to have you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZCKJzZ3.png[/img]
All you have to do is click the button at the top left corner that now exists, and edit the variables within that panel that opens up. All of the currently enabled "MCT Mods" - that is, mods that have hooked up into MCT - will be listed on the left. Click through them and edit the settings to change up your experience!

[b][h1]How It Works[/h1][/b]
What MCT does:
- Creates and populates the settings menu.
- Handles the setting, saving, and loading of individual settings.
- Exposes an "API", an "Application Programming Interface", for modders to interact with the MCT systems. This is how modders get their setting groups and individual settings linked into the settings menu, and it's how they can query the current user's setting value.

What MCT DOES NOT do:
- MCT does not handle ANY of the impacts [b]after a setting has been set[/b]. 

You can think of MCT like a courier, a settings delivery system:
- MCT takes the input of a modder who says "Hey, I want a setting called 'This Setting Does Nothing', and I want it to be a checkbox, so it can be either true or false."
- MCT then drives that setting over to the user, and hands the checkbox over. MCT patiently waits for the user to change the setting, if they do at all.
- Once the user changes the setting, MCT [b]drives on back to the modder[/b] and says, "Hey boss, got your value here." It is entirely up to the modder's code, at that point, to handle the response. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jk7c87I.png[/img]
This upload I'm considering a "beta" release. For all intents and purposes, it's functional, but there are three major things I have to sort out for the next release, in no particular order:

- [b]Profiles are not implemented in this version[/b]. Due to some major backend rewrites for how settings are stored, they became a bit of a hot topic at Groovy HQ, so at the moment they're just disabled. The full release of v0.9, or barring that, v1.0, will reintroduce Profiles, back and better than ever.
- [b]The View system is unincorporated[/b]. Moving forward, there is a system I'd like to implement which will allow the MCT panel to undergo various 'views'. Settings exist in a few different states, multiplayer has a client/host paradigm, and profiles will need some good user interface for read/writing.
- [b]Extra goodies for modders[/b]. Immediate builds are patch notes, popup-style options, the ability to force a save reload, and extra support to find issues in their scripts.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/lP98GkG.png[/img]
Fully compatible with anything on the Workshop!

[b][h2]Known Issues[/h2][/b]
- Multiplayer has been acting increasingly erratic through the years. At the moment, "thar be dragons", unfortunately.

[b][h2]Reporting Issues[/h2][/b]
If you're having trouble as a user, ask yourself if the problem is with the end result of the setting or if the problem is with the delivery system itself. If it's the former, the issue is likely caused by the mod in question. If it's the latter, the issue is far more likely to be MCT.

[b]After deducing that it may in fact be MCT[/b], I need just three things from you.
1) A clear, detailed, and hopefully concise description of the problem at hand.
2) Any relevant information you're hiding: mod list, when the problem started, reproduction steps.
3) Data: You can provide me with some logs, and it'll go a long way. In the WH3/ folder, you can, IMMEDIATELY AFTER HITTING THE ISSUE, send me the latest "script_log_xxx" file, and the latest "groovy_log.txt" file.
4) A smile and a can-do attitude.

You can submit those as an "Issue" in the GitHub Repo for this mod, or in my Discord channel below. I'll look through comments here, but honestly, it's like finding a needle in a haystack.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mc46vDa.png[/img]
An old (and mostly invalid) manual can be [url=https://chadvandy.github.io/mct_wh2/topics/manual.md.html]found here[/url]. [b]Do not trust the documentation.[/b] Better primary sources are the MCT source code and MCT mods. I will surely update the documentation one of these years.

If you'd like to include a banner for your mod saying it's MCT enabled, use the following in your mod description!
[code][noparse]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021][img]https://i.imgur.com/1Vglg7c.png[/img][/url]
[/noparse][/code]

[url=https://github.com/chadvandy/mct_wh3][img]https://i.imgur.com/fy0erGx.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/dd4TUDm][img]https://i.imgur.com/R4kQ0hO.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://tw-modding.com][img]https://i.imgur.com/72KhAbE.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/groovewizard][img]https://i.imgur.com/VNKTirl.png[/img][/url]

2931377022.title: Trade Any Settlement
2931377022.description:
This mod makes it possible to trade any settlement with any encountered faction as long as you aren't at war with them. To use it, just click on the new "trade settlements" button displayed on the top-left corner of the screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HWB8tvn.jpg[/img]

In the base game, it's possible to trade regions with someone only if they are near the border. The vanilla restrictions make it difficult or even impossible to exchange some settlements even if you give them a lot of money.

Even though the mod simplifies the region trading system, this is not intended to be a cheat mod and I will try to keep it balanced somehow, even though it's tricky with this kind of feature.


[h1]Here is how it works by default :[/h1]
You can gift any of your settlements to a faction to get a diplomacy buff with them.
You can buy any settlement if you have enough money.
You can exchange settlements, if your settlement has a higher value you will get a good relation buff, if the AI's region is better you will need to give extra money to confirm the trade. If none is "better" than the other, then the trade is free.

Both the diplomacy buff and the price depend on the value of the region which is defined by its level and how many buildings it currently has.

The price in gold of settlements also increases a little bit each turn. The last factors affecting the price in gold is if the settlement is part of a province entirely owned by the AI faction which increases its value by a flat 10k gold, and also if it's a faction capital (also a flat 10k gold increase). These 3 factors don't affect the diplomacy buff that only depends on your own region's value.


Just like in the similar mod in Warhammer 2, I think it's good for balance to not get any money when trading settlements and instead have a relations boost.

The diplomacy boost is like the gift buff and is displayed as "Recent events involving..." if you check in the diplomacy menu, the relations stats of the AI faction you traded with. It slowly improves the relations over time but the power of the buff also decays over time. Just like other diplomacy "buffs", this boost also slightly affects other factions. They can like or dislike you more depending on their relations with the faction you traded with. 

Contrary to the vanilla trade system, there is no restriction regarding capitals with this mod, you can trade them if you want.
I made it impossible to buy the last region of a faction though since it doesn't make sense for factions to just destroy themselves, but you can still exchange settlements or gift them regions.


[h1]Options panel :[/h1]
I updated the mod to add an options menu screen allowing you to change most rules and modifiers of the mod. That way you can manage the balancing aspect yourself if you think settlements are too cheap or expensive for example. Just click on the gears button at the top left corner of the main panel of the mod. Here are the available options...

"Available factions to trade with" = You can choose to allow trading with only met factions or all factions and also factions at peace or even those at war with you.

"Player's gains when selling" = By default, you only get an attitude bonus with the faction you are trading with if for example you gift them a region. It allows you to earn gold instead. If the AI faction doesn't have enough gold, the system will gift an "equivalent" as an attitude bonus instead. This equivalent value is calculated based on the ratio of gold and attitude values set for the settlement level 3 defined at the bottom of the page.

"Diplomatic relations discount/surcharge modifier" = This reduces the price of a settlement if the attitude of the other faction is positive, otherwise it increases the price. It scales with the attitude amount.

"Discount/surcharge cap (in %)" = This puts a cap to the discount/surcharge amount described above. If set at 50, the discount or surcharge effect on the region price coming from the diplomatic relations will not go above 50%. This only affects the attitude modifier and not the vassal or ally discount modifiers explained below.

"Vassal discount modifier" = This reduces the price of a settlement if the faction you are trading with is a vassal. At 0.3, it provides a 30% discount. Setting the modifier to 1 means you can get the vassal's settlements for free.

"Ally discount modifier" = This reduces the price of a settlement if the faction you are trading with is an ally. At 0.15, it provides a 15% discount. Note that this doesn't affect the vassals, for them use the "vassal discount modifier" instead.

"AI can sell regions if they own at least..." = If you set this to 2 for example, only factions who have 2 or more regions will be available in the factions list.

"Extra gold cost for owning the whole province..." = This increases the value of a settlement by a flat gold amount when the AI holds the whole province, to show that since they own the whole province they are "less willing" to trade it.

"Extra gold vost for the faction's capital..." = This increases the value of a settlement by a flat gold amount if it's a faction capital.

"Gold price increase per turn modifier..." = This is the modifier that increases the price of settlements each turn. Since we tend to get much more money late game, it's a way to keep the system somewhat balanced. Contrary to all previous modifiers, it also affects the value of the player's settlement.

"Gold/Attitude price per building modifier..." = This increases the price of the region based on how many building it currently has. it also affects the value of the player's settlement

"Gold/Attitude base values..." = Here you can define the base price of each settlement individually at each level.


Regarding attitude gains, it's only given by a multiple of 5. It's not possible with apply_dilemma_diplomatic_bonus to define a precise attitude bonus. So I just round up a

3032439976.title: All Diplomatic Options - Vassalize, Liberate, Confederate
3032439976.description:
[h1]OVERVIEW[/h1]
Hello all!
This is the updated version of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2843411818&searchtext=diplomatic]All Diplomatic Options[/url] mod by FiftyTifty who will be unable to update the original mod for the foreseeable future but has kindly given me permission to maintain and update this awesome mod for coming updates. Factions added by Patch 4.0 (minus the Changeling) can now be vassalised/liberated.


A possible oversight by CA, was to give some factions settlements, but not have them actually own them. That meant you could not liberate a handful of factions.

When playing as a modded race, you may get many "Liberate" options when conquering settlements. If you are planning to play a modded race that is not in the list of compatible mods below, then it is recommended that you disable this mod.

Compatible mods so far:
- Cataph's Southern Realms
- OVN Fimir
- OVN Albion
- OVN Dread King
- Legions of Nagash
- Gnoblar Hordes - The Unwashed Masses
- OvN Araby
- The Hung


[h3]IMPORTANT[/h3]
Modded factions CANNOT be liberated. That would require editing the startpos which this mod does not do.

The Maneaters do not have access to vassalisation options as they cannot make alliances.

Recommended mods:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794064207]Fudging Vassals[/url]


[h1]SUBMODS[/h1]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3563518591]German Translation[/url] by Balthasar23th


[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
- Duplicate versions of modded heroes may spawn when the faction it is tied to is revived. To my understanding, this is because that hero is scripted to spawn for that faction at the start of the game when it is "spawned in". The game considers reviving a dead faction as them being spawned in for the first time and so gives the hero it's told to give again. I don't believe there is anything I can do to fix that on my end. Thanks to Dredd_87 for notifying me of it.

- Liberate currently brings the faction as a military ally instead of a vassal. Use the Fudging Vassals mod alongside this to get a dilemma between military ally and vassal once a faction is revived.


[h1]CREDITS[/h1]
A massive thanks to FiftyTifty for porting the original mod to WH3 and maintaining it for as long as he did and for giving me permission to continue maintaining this mod.

3291116635.title: OvN Lost World
3291116635.description:
OvN Lost World adds over 150 unique settlement skins, 35+ campaign scenes, and 20+ new landmarks to both Immortal Empires and Immortal Empires Expanded. If you've ever wished that Warhammer cities looked as unique as they are described to be in the lore, this is the mod for you. This is the definitive campaign map mod for Total War: Warhammer 3, with the goal of adding a little flavour to every single part of the map.

Lost World includes lore descriptions for every single settlement in the game. These can be accessed by hovering over the 'i' icon next to the settlement bar.  This mod requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2859968660] MIXER[/url] to work and is not save game compatible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H3NWa3O.png[/img]

[h1]What's Included[/h1]
Here are some of the 130+ settlements covered in this mod:
[list]
[*] Al Haikk
[*] Altdorf
[*] Black Crag
[*] Couronne
[*] Great Hall of Greasus
[*] Itza
[*] Karak Eight Peaks
[*] Kislev
[*] Lothern 
[*] Mousillon
[*] Naggarond
[*] Skavenblight
[*] Wei-Jin
[/list]

We've also added campaign eye candy like elephants, mammoths, culchans, a Fimir tower and more to the map as campaign scenes.

Chances are that if a place has a lot of lore significance, we've covered it. Even if a location isn't that important, we still might have created a new skin for it. Lost World also fills out entire regions with unique settlements. Locations such as Araby, Albion, the Empire, Kislev, the Darklands, and Naggaroth have unique settlement skins for nearly every major city and some of their minor settlements as well. You can check out an image gallery with over 65 of the unique settlements and campaign scenes we've created here: [url=https://imgur.com/a/ovn-lost-world-showcase-G1jSKdb] OvN Lost World: Showcase Gallery[/url]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some settlements are given to existing minor factions in lore-plausible places this is to help spread unique races around the map and can complement the new settlement skins, this feature can be turned off via the Mod Configuration Tool mod.
[*] A small handful of settlements have a 'Special Building Effect' where a building has a settlement unique effect. At present this is used to add walls to certain known fortifications like Castle Alexandrov for Kislev factions.
[*] The campaign map now has more vibrant and colourful oceans.
[*] A small amount of provinces mainly around the Badlands are renamed to more interesting names.
[*] Thunder Guts faction are renamed to "Guards of Pigbarter" and given a new faction flag.
[*] There is a new minor faction "Leopoldhiem" placed at what is now Leopoldhiem in the Southlands
[*] A small amount of vanilla settlement skins are swapped for other vanilla skins where they fit better, for example 'The Forbidden Citadel' is now a Deamon skin rather than a Norscan one.
[*] Some settlements are renamed to more interesting places and are complemented with custom settlement skins.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Mat0MA.png[/img]

[h1]Q&A[/h1]
Important: You can configure how many settlements you want to change on turn one and then how many on subsequent turns using the Mod Configuration Tool. For instance if you did want to load all the settlement skins on turn one you can do that. Using the default settings it is normal to experience a split second delay when beginning a new turn for about the first few turns. This is Lost World's script working in the background to add more of our skins to the map each turn, starting with those nearest to you. This is why if you were to use another mod to turn off all Fog of War you will not see all the custom settlement skins only those in your vicinity.

[B]What's a campaign scene?[/B]
A campaign scene is eye candy we've added to the map that is not part of a settlement skin. Whenever you see an animated creature like a wolf or a spider on the map, that's a campaign scene.

[B]Does this mod add unique battle maps?[/B]
No it does not though some of our settlement skins represent the custom maps in FSFRangers Custom Siege Maps for Campaigns mod.

[B]Do the settlements have different visuals for each tier?[/B]
Most settlements do not feature unique visuals for each tier, and their visuals will represent their "final form". We recognize that it's a trade-off to no longer see the settlement grow as it advances through the tiers. Though in lore you would see big established cities like Altdorf in their final form already. Plus creating 3-5 versions of each skin would have meant creating a lot less skins and we prefer the variety. Some skins though do have tiers, some custom ruins and others even unique skins based on which race owns it.

[B]Is this mod lore accurate?[/B]
It varies greatly from skin to skin. Some of the visuals we've created are entirely our own invention, with the design not being present in the lore but still having the feel of a Warhammer city. Others have been partially or totally informed by their lore descriptions or old images and maps. However, having to make cities in miniature means that liberties need to taken with our designs. We hope that each settlement feels like it belongs on the map whether we've followed a lore blueprint or not.

[B]Why do some settlements have new names?[/B]
In some cases, a settlement that we wanted to create visuals for wasn't present on the map, so we've co-opted some CA settlements and renamed them to fit our ideas. In other cases, we did it for lore reasons or to more accurately represent our vision for the map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Mat0MA.png[/img]

[h1]Mod Compatibility and Compatibility Submods[/h1]
- Simple Dynamic Settlements - Do not use together
- 3 Slots and Landmarks for Nagash Minor Settlements - Do not use together
- Old World - We have not tested these mods together, settlement skins may not load up or might not look right for the OW campaign
- Radious has been reported to wo

changes: reduced breast size, buffed hips, recolored hood white + black => black + gold, added lace rose shawl, modified facial textures


[h1]Lore[/h1]

Amidst ancient tombstones and under twilight shadows, a serpent with iridescent scales and sinuous grace slithered through rose beds. Its eyes gleaming with forbidden knowledge, it approached Elspeth as she tended to her Garden of Morr. A voice - sweet and insidious - caressed her mind, promising revelations about the balance between life and death, decay and rebirth. "Elspeth," it hissed, weaving through twisted roots and darkened petals, "I bring you tidings from the depths of destiny, secrets that will elevate your understanding of mortality beyond that of any mortal." The allure of such wisdom tugged at her curiosity, competing with her vigilance against speaking snakes. "Seek the hood of knowledge lost in these ruins..."

3406868790.title: Lord Hero Swap
3406868790.description:
This mod allows you to convert all vanilla lords into heroes and all heroes into lords. These lords and heroes have different skills depending on what hero type they are. 


[h1]How it Works:[/h1]
Each vanila character that makes sense has a new button into lord/hero button in their character panel.

If the lord has an army they will re-spawn next to the army and you will be prompted to assign a new general.

Traits, ancillaries, items and character level will carry over.

Red and blue lord skill lines are swapped out for hero blue lines whilst the character is a hero and the opposite.

[h1]Restrictions:[/h1]
You can always convert Legendary Lords(LL) into Legendary Heroes (LH), bu converting LH into LL requires you to have available army cap, like with tomb kings, and beastmen. You can only convert Generic Lords (GL) into Generic Heroes (GH) if you have the available cap for that hero, for example the "General of the Empire" to be converted into a hero you need capacity for "Empire Captains" since they share the type of champion. You can check what characters are what hero type by checking in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3406868790/600767526707687364/] discussions [/url].
For bretonia the vows will be converted from lord into hero but some of them can't be completed has a lord or as hero.

[h1]Compatibility:[/h1]
This mod datacores db/military_force_type_feature_junctions_tables to remove entries so that this mod works with horde factions. This change means that for hordes you can lose your lord and the horde not be immediately destroyed and be substitute by another.
It also overwrites a lot of entries if there are other mods that mess with the same entries this mod won't work then.
If you use a mod that gives extra xp or levels then characters might lose progress when they get converted.

Incompatbility with "Daniel Not Poor (Normal Items for Daemon Prince)" mod
Incompatibility with "Resized Lords Heroes 3" mod

CROSS-RACE/ culture doesn't work so if you want to play karl franz as a lord with tyrion as a hero in his army it won't work probably.


Works with multiplayer.

[h1]Bugs:[/h1]
[b]Sister os twilight[/b] and the [b]cathay alchemist hero[/b] require you to first turn on 2d portholes then select their skills then change the lord to a hero, do not click them, then save the game load that save and now you can use them as a hero and can turn the porthole back into 3d. the game crashes if you do not do these steps when you either look at their porthole or look at their character screen.

Just because a skill says "for agent in army" or "for general", etc that doesn't mean that a skill doesn't work, you need to actual verify if it works or not.
If you find a issue with skills not being in the correct place or not being able to command a hero to target something tell me and I will fix it.
Contact me either here in the comments or in the #skeleton_crew in the modding den for bugs and suggestions.

3801669633.title: 色孽远征— 派系 Mod | Slaanesh Expedition
3801669633.description:
[h1]Slaanesh Expedition | 色孽远征[/h1]

[b]A complete, playable Slaanesh faction for Immortal Empires. Cross the Rifts, hunt legendary figures across the world, corrupt them and bring them into your expedition.[/b]

[b]English text:[/b] the mod ships in Simplified Chinese. Subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3802335820][b]Slaanesh Expedition - English Translation[/b][/url] and enable it with this mod.

[h2]How to start[/h2]

The Slaanesh Expedition is a Minor Faction. Enable [b]MIXER - Mixu's Unlocker[/b], then in Immortal Empires: [b]choose the Slaanesh race → show Minor Factions → choose the Slaanesh Expedition.[/b]

All of the mod's systems are built for this faction; do not start with any other Slaanesh faction.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3801669633/525387344813200052/][b]FAQ / Known Issues[/b][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]A custom faction leader[/h2]
A custom Legendary Lord made for this mod now leads the faction: [b]the Expedition Commander. New campaigns only; existing saves cannot be migrated.[/b]

[h2]13 corrupted Legendary Heroes[/h2]

[b]Miao Ying, Tzarina Katarin, Morathi, Alarielle, Crone Hellebron, Isabella von Carstein, High Queen Khalida, Drycha, Mother Ostankya, Elspeth von Draken, the Fay Enchantress, Repanse de Lyonesse and Aranessa Saltspite.[/b]

Defeat and corrupt them and they join you as Legendary Heroes, each with a redesigned skill tree and army bonuses. [b]Their former factions become your vassals.[/b]

[h2]Rift expeditions[/h2]

Use the Rifts to jump straight to distant regions and your next target: [b]find a target → cross the Rift → corrupt her → move on.[/b]

[h2]Expedition reinforcements[/h2]

A reinforcement system like [b]Markus Wulfhart's Imperial Supplies[/b], without Hostility. Higher tiers unlock as the expedition grows, with units from [b]Slaanesh, the Dark Elves, Cathay, the High Elves, Bretonnia and the Empire[/b].

[h2]Endgame[/h2]

At [b]Glory IV[/b], your faction leader's army faces this mod's endgame battle, [b]Crusade of the Four Kings[/b], against four full-strength armies. Difficulty is set in [b]MCT[/b] (default Hard).

[h2]Exclusive technologies[/h2]

Each corrupted Hero unlocks her own [b]exclusive technology[/b], with unique effects for her and her army: [b]Strategy[/b] tab → [b]Court Register[/b], researchable once her corruption is complete (1 turn / 20,000 gold). 12 Heroes have theirs so far; Aranessa's is in development.

[h2]Also included[/h2]

[list]
[*]Corruption Court and expedition progress
[*]Strategic technology tree
[*]Desire Development
[*]Expanded settlements, defences and garrisons
[*]Expedition campaign UI
[*][b]Stronger player autoresolve[/b] and [b]higher AI potential[/b] for the corruption targets, so they are more likely to survive until you arrive
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

Works with most model and cosmetic mods; mods that change the same unit cards, portraits or UI may conflict.

[b]Immortal Empires Expanded (IEE):[/b] also subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3804558717][b]Slaanesh Expedition × IEE Compatibility Patch[/b][/url]. Not needed in vanilla Immortal Empires.

[h2]Beta[/h2]

All main systems are playable, but you may still hit bugs. When reporting, please include your game version, mod list, what happened and screenshots or logs. Suggestions are welcome in the comments.

[h2]Next version[/h2]

[list]
[*]New corrupted Heroes: [b]the Sisters of Twilight[/b] and [b]Neferata[/b]
[*]An exclusive artifact for the [b]Expedition Commander[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]MIXER - Mixu's Unlocker[/b] (place this mod above MIXER)
[*]Optional: [b]Mod Configuration Tool (MCT)[/b], for the Endgame difficulty
[*]Some Heroes and reinforcement units need the matching official DLC
[/list]

[b]Cross the Rifts. Hunt the legends. Carry rapture to every corner of the world.[/b]

If you enjoy the mod, please give it a thumbs-up!

3810275955.title: Lord Hero Swap - 9.0 Fix (Unofficial)/领主和英雄切换9.0 修复版（原版失效修复）
3810275955.description:
原 MOD「Lord Hero Swap」（作者 @All is Dust）领主和英雄切换，给领主和英雄个人界面添加了一个按钮，可以随意切换身份属性。7 月后再没更新，9.0 大更后整体失效。本 MOD 是它的 9.0／9.0.1 修复版：只改了 MOD 文件的数据，不动游戏本体，老存档可用。

Lord Hero Swap (by @All is Dust) switches lords and heroes. It has not been updated since July and is completely broken after the 9.0 update. This mod is a fix for it on 9.0 / 9.0.1: only the files of this mod were changed, nothing in the base game, and existing saves still work.

**修了什么：**

- 逐一对照 9.0 数据改写 42 处失效引用（进战役／读档崩溃的根因）
- 领主、英雄各一套技能树，效果范围随形态切换
- 补齐领主形态的军队线与最下面那条战役线（含纳迦什 9.0 新领主线）
- 恢复 16 个英雄子类型的名字组，转出的角色有名字了
- 转回领主时还原称号与原版技能树
- 修好了「转成英雄后技能页空白、什么都没有」的问题
- 修好了「转成英雄后不能随军、技能说明写成领主军队」的问题（现在能随军，说明也写着英雄所在军队）
- 修好了转换后角色面板显示乱码（{{tr:...}} 那种）的问题
- 神器（任务物品）：已经拿到手的会跟着转换，英雄形态也能正常装备，来回转不会越转越多；还没做的神器任务仍然要自己去做（不白送，免得影响平衡）

**What was fixed:**

- All 42 broken references rewritten against the 9.0 data (the cause of the crash on entering a campaign / loading a save)
- Separate skill trees for lords and heroes, with effect scopes that follow the form
- Restored the lord's army line and the bottom campaign line (including the new 9.0 Nagash lord line)
- Restored the name groups of 16 hero subtypes, so characters get names when they are swapped
- Converting back into a lord restores the original title and the vanilla lord skill tree
- Fixed the blank hero skill page (it used to show nothing but "extra skill points")
- Fixed heroes not being able to join an army, and tooltips wrongly saying "Lord's army" (they now say the hero's army)
- Fixed the raw {{tr:...}} text that appeared on the character panel after a swap
- Quest items (artifacts): the ones you already own follow the swap and can be equipped in hero form, and switching back and forth no longer duplicates them. Items you have not earned yet still have to be earned by playing normally, so nothing gets unbalanced

**比原版多了什么：**

- 9.0 新增的 35 个角色也能转（纳迦什、涅芙瑞塔、古墓军锋等）
- 9.0 新增的 45 个坐骑现在按每个角色对应的英雄身份类型全部补齐（领主→英雄 45 条、英雄→领主 42 条），两个方向都能保住坐骑不丢。
- 原版 bug 清单那两条已消除：震旦炼金术士与暮光姐妹，原版要先开 2D 立绘、选技能、存档读档才转得了，否则一看面板就崩；现在 3D 立绘全程开着切换也正常
- 暮光姐妹、艾斯林、海员、龙船船长、诺斯卡两个巫师、高尔法格这些角色，现在能转成「真英雄」，转完可以正常随军
- 混沌这些以前会崩的领主现在能转了：阿扎泽尔、维里奇、瓦尔基娅、斯卡布兰德、卡洛斯、色孽假面、费斯图斯
- 弗拉德、伊莎贝拉、吸血鬼海岸舰队上尉等「转过去没单位／转不回来」的问题也修了

**What is new compared to the original:**

- The 35 characters added in 9.0 can be swapped too (Nagash, Neferata, Tomb Herald, ...)
- All 45 mounts added in patch 9.0 are whitelisted for the matching hero agent types in both directions (45 rows lord->hero, 42 rows hero->lord), so mounts survive either way
- The two bugs on the original's bug list are gone: the Cathay alchemist hero and the Sisters of Twilight used to require turning on 2D portraits, picking their skills and saving/reloading, otherwise the game crashed the moment you looked at their panel. Now they swap back and forth with 3D portraits kept on
- Sisters of Twilight, Aislinn, Sea Helm, Dragonship Captains, two Norscan sorcerers and Golgfag now turn into real heroes that can join armies
- Chaos lords that used to crash can be swapped again: Azazel, Vilitch, Valkia, Skarbrand, Kairos, the Masque of Slaanesh and Festus
- Vlad, Isabella, the Vampire Coast fleet captains and others no longer lose their unit or get stuck when switching back

**尚未解决的问题：**
这几种角色暂时还不能转（按钮不显示）

- 卡拉丁、贵族民兵：游戏原版就没有他们的技能树，转了会一片空白
- 绿骑士、影行者、教派法师：原版数据本身不全，转了技能树会乱
- 恶魔亲王、克罗克、各种 boss：机制特殊，不是普通的领主/英雄，做了会坏档
- 模型/立绘特殊的：格罗特三兄弟、疫蛆三兄弟（莫比德斯／欧格浩斯特／布罗本）、古崔特·泡液、埃皮德穆斯、瘟父、高崔克 —— 转换会崩溃或换脸，按钮先关着，等修好再开

曼弗雷德（还有阿克汉、涅芙瑞塔）的第 4 个坐骑，转成英雄后会没有。原因是这个坐骑在原版是"升级自动给"的，转换出来的角色拿不到。

**Unresolved issues:**
These characters still can't be switched yet (no button is shown):

- Caradryan, Noble Militia: the base game has no skill tree for them, so switching would leave the page blank
- Green Knight, Shadow Walker, Cult Magi: the base game data itself is incomplete, so the skill tree would be a mess after switching
- Daemon Princes, Kroak, various bosses: they use special mechanics and are not normal lords/heroes - switching them would break saves
- Special models/portraits (switching crashes the game or swaps their face, buttons stay off until fixed): the Glottkin, the three Maggoth Lords (Morbidex, Orghotts, Bloab), Gutrot Spume, Epidemius, Ku'gath and Gotrek

Mannfred (also Arkhan and Neferata): their 4th mount is gone after switching to a hero, because in the base game that mount is granted automatically by levelling up and converted characters cannot get it.

**安装**：订阅本 MOD 后直接启用本 MOD 即可（已含原 MOD 全部内容）；订阅原 MOD 的，只需启用本 MOD。

**Install**: subscribe to this mod and simply enable it (it already contains everything from the original mod); if you also subscribe to the original mod, enabling this one is all you need to do.

**说明**：跨种族转换与原mod列出的不兼容 MOD 仍不适用；转换过的老角色转一次形态即可重解析技能树。无偿修复，若原mod后续更新以原版为主。

**Notes**: cross-race swaps and the mods listed as incompatible on the original mod's page still do not work; characters that were already swapped only need one more swap to re-parse their skill tree. This is a free fix - if the original mod is updated later, the original version takes precedence.

自制文本汉化包（按需订阅，非必选，不影响本mod使用）This is a Chinese-only text patch — English players don't need to subscribe to it.：
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3810700906

注意：如果出现游戏原版mod管理器里没有本mod的情况，请使用第三方mod管理器，谢谢！
If the mod doesn't show up in the vanilla in-game mod manager, please use a third-party mod manager instead. Thanks for understanding!

2789862740.title: Cpecific's Traits Manager (+win64)
2789862740.description:
You can set trait level with double click, or remove trait by double-clicking on an active level.
⚠️ *IMPORTANT* - Area with lords is scrollable.
⚠️ [u][b]Can work[/b][/u] without [b]memreader[/b], but you won't have access to some features.
✔️ Compatible with any mod.
✔️ Savegame compatible.
✔️ Multiplayer compatible.
✔️ (only [b]memreader[/b]) Background skill can be edited (MUST READ DESCRIPTION BELOW).
🤔*Have a problem?* Try to re-subscribe. Steam sometimes doesn't download the latest version of the mods.

Vanilla trait limit is 40.
After update 4.0 (Shadows of Change) it became possible to modify trait cap.
Search for such mods in workshop ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3029800597]link[/url]).
Traits Manager doesn't modify trait cap, and will show cap value "40" regardless of its actual modded value.

[h1]What are "inactive" traits?[/h1]
Traits have levels, each level has a threshold point. You acquire traits throughout your campaign by doing certain actions. When those actions are done, game will add (usually) 1 point to a trait. When trait has accumulated enough points to have 1st level, it will become active (its' effects are now working). When trait is still inactive, all it does is occupy your 40 traits cap.

[h1]Why are some traits duplicated[/h1]
You would think that traits, that have negative and positive parts, should be the whole thingy. But nope, CA decided to go the hard way. You could, technically, compose even 100 different traits into one blob.
In vanilla negative and positive parts are separated into different traits. They can be composed by linking them together as trait-antitrait pair. You can even link antitrait in one direction. Vanilla even has 2 of such traits (WH2 example).
Antitrait is not what you would expect it to be. It doesn't mean that it is negative or opposite. It means, that when you (with scripts) add point to that antitrait, then the game will first remove points from all other linked traits.
So, all the traits should be printed separately, as each could have a completely different antitrait configuration. It is even possible to have points in both antitraits at the same time (if they are one-directional).
[u][b]For example[/b][/u], vanilla (WH2) has such configuration (trait -> antitrait):
[list]
[*] trait_corrupted_chaos -> trait_non_corrupted
[*] trait_corrupted_vampire -> trait_non_corrupted
[/list]
And that would be the output:
[list]
[*] trait_corrupted_chaos = [trait_corrupted_chaos, trait_non_corrupted]
[*] trait_corrupted_vampire  = [trait_corrupted_vampire, trait_non_corrupted]
[*] trait_non_corrupted = [trait_non_corrupted]
[/list]
When adding points to:
[list]
[*] [b]trait_corrupted_chaos[/b], game won't delete points from other traits.
[*] [b]trait_corrupted_vampire[/b], game won't delete points from other traits.
[*] [b]trait_non_corrupted[/b], game will delete points from [b]trait_corrupted_chaos[/b] AND [b]trait_corrupted_vampire[/b].
[/list]

[h1]Changing Background Skill (unstable)[/h1]
Background skill is the thing, that majority of lords and heroes have (knowledgeable, tough, etc...).
Even though they are rendered inside the traits list, they are not actually traits, but skills that were flagged as "background skill".
There is no native support for modders to change or view background skills (you can remove it, but not add).
This mod allows to change your background skill.
[b]BUTT... there's a caveat![/b]
[list]
[*] it only works with [b]memreader[/b].
[*] you can only select those background skills, which this type of agent is allowed to have. I tried giving "unallowed" background skills... upon loading, game would just discard those background skills.
[*] this mod writes directly into memory and hopes that "it just works". And it indeed works.
BUTT! You MUST immediately save and load new save. Because mod is directly writing to memory, CA's code is unaware of those changes, and therefore a gigantic cascade of problems could occur. For instance, if you change your background skill, then all the effects that are coming with it do not get applied. That's why you need to re-save the game.
[*] because this feature is so unstable in my eyes, I will not be adding multiplayer support for it.
[/list]

[h1]My Other Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789864490]Skill Queue[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789868216]Army Carousel[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789869874]Quick Building Upgrade[/url]
[/list]

2794064207.title: Fudging Vassals 9.0.4
2794064207.description:
Welcome back, commanders!  If you used [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2444626205]this mod in Total War: Warhammer 2[/url], then you know what the deal is.  For everyone else, read on:

[hr][/hr]

[h1]VASSAL BEHAVIOR CHANGES[/h1]

Only daemon armies from the Realms of Chaos can declare war on a vassal, no one else can.

Vassals shouldn't secede from their protectors.

If you're at war with a faction, [i]all[/i] of your vassals will be at war with that faction [b]starting next turn at the latest[/b].

If any of your vassals are at war with factions you are not at war with, peace treaties will be signed [b]next turn[/b].

If your vassals like you, they'll share vision and offer more allegiance points per turn.

[strike]Strong vassals will receive a tiny nerf that scales with the number of enemies they're stronger than.[/strike]  Removed by popular demand.

If your vassal has a general that doesn't move or recruit for more than 2 turns and it isn't a legendary character or faction leader, then that general will be disbanded.

If a vassal doesn't create a new military force for 10 turns, then a new force will be slapped together using available units.  It will have no upkeep for 30 turns but [strike]will be compelled to attack the nearest opponent[/strike].  (The compulsion is broken but will be either fixed or removed soon.)  The size of the new force depends on the number of available allegiance points, which are burnt to pay for the compelled force.  (This doesn't apply to Blood Voyage or Defenders of the Great Plan, neither of which can yolo swag new armies.)

If a vassal is losing money:

[list]
[*]The leader's stack will get a larger upkeep reduction.
[*]A unit with the highest upkeep from all of the their stacks will be sent to a farm in Norsca where they will be happy and have plenty of room to play.
[*]If they [i]could[/i] go bankrupt next turn, then 1) tribute collected by the protector is reduced slightly and 2) if the protector has a large enough treasury to prevent this, then sufficient money will be refunded to prevent bankruptcy attrition.
[*]If tribute reduction happens, it increases progressively each turn as required, otherwise it decreases at the same rate if no longer needed.
[/list]


[h1]NEW DILEMMAS[/h1]

If your new vassal is the same subculture, you'll be asked if you'd rather confederate [b]unless both you and your new vassal are part of the Empire politics system[/b].

If your vassal captures a region outside of their home province, you'll be asked if you want control of that region.

If you capture a region in your vassal's home province, you'll be asked to return it.

If you capture a region in an unsuitable climate, you'll be asked if you'd rather gift it to a vassal better suited to that climate.


[h1]ATTRITION/CORRUPTION/PLAGUE PROTECTION[/h1]

If your faction has a [b][i]specific[/i][/b] attrition immunity, then your vassals will receive the same protection:

[list]
[*] Yvresse's vassals are not only protected [i]against[/i] the Mists of Yvresse, the mists will spread to their regions in outer Ulthuan as well!
[*] Vassals of a Tomb King will receive [i]temporary[/i] sandstorm protection when their protector invokes Great Incantation of Khsar.
[*] Vassals of a Vampire Pirate will receive [i]temporary[/i] cursed mist protection when their protector invokes Curse of the Sea Mist.
[*] Vassals of Kislevite factions will receive [i]temporary[/i] winter protection when their protector invokes The Motherland.
[*] Vassals of Lizardmen factions will receive [i]temporary[/i] protection when their protector invokes Rite of Allegiance or Rite of Sotek.
[/list]

For all other vassals, if the vassal's subculture is different from the protector's, then that vassal will receive a [i]small[/i] casualty reduction for whatever attrition their protector is immune to.

If a vassal's force is taking attrition and it's [i]possible[/i] to put that force in a stance that doesn't take attrition, then it will be put into that stance at the end of the vassal's turn.

Vassals of Slaaneshi, Khornate, Tzeentchian, Nurglish, or Chaos factions will receive a [i]fixed[/i] public order buff.

If one of your plagues strikes one of your vassals, that vassal will receive [i]temporary[/i] protection from your plague and your plague only.  It will not protect your vassal from receiving the same plague from a different faction.


[h1]WARRIORS OF CHAOS[/h1]

When capturing a Dark Fortress, you will [i]not[/i] be asked to return it.  It's yours.

When your non-WoC vassal captures a Dark Fortress which is [b]not their only settlement[/b], you will be prompted to take it.

When your WoC vassal captures a Dark Fortress that would grant control of a Norscan vassal, both Dark Fortress and the associated vassal will [i]immediately[/i] be put under your control.


[h1]DWARFS[/h1]

Vassals can clear grudges for their Dwarf protectors.

Dwarf missions that require destroying a faction will succeed if those factions are vassalized instead.

Dwarf missions that require the entirety of a province to be Dwarf-owned can now succeed if a vassal owns regions in that province.


[h1]THE ENDGAME[/h1]

When it's time for the endgame, vassals will not join the catastrophe.  This works with both vanilla scenarios and modded ones, with one big exception:

Mods which add additional endgame scenarios which do [b]not[/b] use CA's endgame:declare_war function are excluded from consideration.


[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

The YOLO button still doesn't work.

This mod uses custom (as opposed to hardcoded) dilemmas to ensure the information presented in each dilemma is accurate.  However, CA will not allow the same custom dilemma to be displayed twice in a row.  If that is scheduled to happen, a "ghost" dilemma will be inserted in between to ensure the correct info is displayed.

2799316652.title: AI General 3
2799316652.description:
[h1]This mod likely still works even though I no longer update it.[/h1]

[b]Unfortunately, I no longer maintain WH3 mods, including this one. Since WH3 rarely seems to cause any breaking changes to these scripts, I expect that this mod will continue to function as it did before (for better or worse). And perhaps other modders that enjoy scripting will step forward if needed.[/b]

(Modders are welcome to pick this up or create something new.)


[h2]New options for end-of-battle chasing[/h2]
In March 2025, I introduced configuration options for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/591766834833788979/]different end-of-battle chasing[/url]. I recommend trying the beta channel. (I never did get any feedback on it, but I liked it in my own games.)

--------------------------------------------

[h2]When to use AI General[/h2]

Delegate control of some or all of your units to an AI General during battle. You can select which units AI General should control. With another hotkey, you can temporarily override the AI's orders.

Because AI General is not smart, some people just use this mod to chase down enemies after the battle's victory is declared.

AI General III is not smart, but it can command many units at once. This might be helpful for controlling basic units while you micro high-value units. Or it might be helpful if you don’t sweat the battle's outcome and want to have a relaxed experience while you enjoy the spectacle.

[h2]AI General is not smart[/h2]
Do not expect AI General to perform better than the game's AI on normal difficulty unless you help it. Even on normal difficulty, there are situations where this mod performs worse than the enemy AI.


[h2]WARNING about siege battles[/h2]
Some users still report crashes in siege battles, though I have not reproduced them in years. It is safer to not use this mod in siege battles. (There is a configuration option for disabling this mod in siege battles if you'd like. See below.)

AI General uses the game's AI Planner (with a few exceptions). I don't think the AI Planner is the same as the enemy AI (except for in some quest battles?). It comes with a warning that “It is not recommended to try and use ai planners during siege battles...” It's not very aware of complicated situations like quest battles. Some players choose to use AI General in these situations anyway because they find it helpful. Be aware that doing so is experimental.


[h2]Tested in single-player. What about Multiplayer?[/h2]
AI General 3 is not polished in multiplayer, and not all players can use it at once. For details or to report multiplayer issues multiplayer, see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/3378284761889925674/]the multiplayer discussion[/url].


[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]
During battle, this mod reacts to the hotkeys for "Save Camera Bookmark 1" through 7. You can set these to whatever key combination you'd like in the game settings.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 1 (Shift+F9)[/u][/b] - Set AI Selection. Cancels any previous AI control, then gives any currently selected units to the AI. If all units are given to the AI, your reinforcements will be given to the AI, too.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 2 (Shift+F10)[/u][/b] - Set AI selection [b](reversed)[/b]. Cancels any previous AI control, then gives everything in your army to the AI *except* the current selection. This also gives reinforcements and summoned units to the AI.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 3 (Shift+F11)[/u][/b] - Turn Audio On/Off for Unit Responses.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 4 (Shift+F12)[/u][/b] - Turn On/Off giving summoned units to the AI.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 5 (no default)[/u][/b] - Turn On/Off giving to the AI all units that recover from routing or rampaging.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 6 (no default)[/u][/b] - Keep your current AI selection (if any) and only turn on/off AI control for the currently selected units. If your selection has some units under AI control and some under your control, it will cancel AI control for all the units selected.

[b][u]Save Camera Bookmark 7 (no default)[/u][/b] - Override the AI temporarily. AI General will resume command when the units are idle again.

[h2]How will I know that AI General 3 is enabled?[/h2]
During battle, there is a new AI button on the bottom right, next to the button that hides your unit cards. If you select some units, the button should become enabled. The button does the same thing as the hotkey for Save Camera Bookmark 6 (see above).

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/601917670267302883/]Known Issues and Important Notes[/url][/h2]
(Please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/601917670267302883/]the discussion[/url].)

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
If this mod is not working, try these [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/3390672107128729593/]troubleshooting steps[/url].[/b]

[h2]Optional Configuration[/h2]
You can use MCT or a text file, as [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/3267933887526164195/]explained here.[/url]
If you want to use or submit a translation of config settings, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2799316652/4615641483003457102/]submitted and example translations[/url].

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021][img]https://i.imgur.com/1Vglg7c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Acknowledgements[/h2]
Hambango created the initial versions of AI General 1 and 2, which paved the way for this mod. Decomposed was the steward of AI General 1 and 2 on Steam for years before I got involved Jan 2020 - Sep 2025.

The modding community is great, including [url=https://discord.gg/dd4TUDm]Da Modding Den[/url], [url=https://github.com/Frodo45127/rpfm/releases]RPFM[/url], and many others.
