2963986848.title: Better Sound Levels Mod v8.0
2963986848.description:
Do you like the battle sounds but hate all the yelling and screaming that drowns out all other details, such as melee sounds? Or do you think that the guns and cannons and magic blasts sound weak? Do you think the campaign map and battlefield is so full of noise that you can hardly make out the details? If so, then this mod is for you!

This mod aggressively adjusts the original battle sound levels (attenuation) so that you get a better mix of audio effects, rather than hearing nothing but mass yelling and screaming of constant ear-plundering vocals, especially when the camera is down at the ground level.  Additionally, battle audio is re-mixed so that guns, cannons, and magic are louder, voices are less invasive (voice volume should "fall off" (diminish) better over distance from the POV), and melee sounds, Foley effects, projectile flight and impacts are more easily heard (and "fall off" less quickly over distance). Sound effects are brought more to the front of the audio scene, and vocals pushed to the back, so the speak. The most important part of sound design is getting the sound levels of each sound right, otherwise details are lost, or there is no impression of power.

[h2]"You will hear things you never heard before."[/h2]

Essentially this mod is a tedious 500+ hour revision (including testing - aka "playing") of the WH3's battle audio by a game developer/sound designer. Think of it as a re-mix, or a remaster of the battle and campaign audio, to fix the hot mess audio mixing in the standard game. This mod only adjusts audio table data -- essentially the data "under the hood" (and all of this is accomplished with numbers - in some cases extreme settings given the limited tools to work with - without adjusting anything in Wwise), so it should work with every other mod available. [b][i]Additionally, no other sound mods were used nor evaluated in the creation of this mod (truth be told, I didn't even check if there were sound mods out there before I started working on this, and it is probably better that I didn't, allowing me to blunder down my own path here, but also allowing it to develop in its own direction. So, everything here is specific to this mod[/i][/b]).

[b]Edited: This mod originally focused on battle sounds only, but has now been expanded and also adjusts the sound levels of various campaign map sounds too, so that subtle details on the campaign map can be more clearly heard, rather than hundreds of map sound effects competing with each other in a constant drone of identical volume noise.[/b]

This mod...
✅Is save game compatible
✅Is compatible with all DLC
✅Works in multiplayer campaigns (as long as your friends also have it activated)
✅Should work with every other mod in existence (unless they also adjust sound data)
✅Can be turned off and on whenever you want


Suggested volume level settings (in options menu)...
🔊Speech: 55%
🔊Effects: 100%
🔊Interface: 85%
🔊Music: 65%

🖥️Make certain you choose the correct speaker configuration or it will not sound good, no matter what you do!

NOTE: After each CA patch, it is best to re-check your volume slider levels because they may get reset (at least it has happen once before).

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]

[b]It is normal for sounds to drop out during battle. Why this normally happens is complicated, but it is primarily due to two main reasons (in most games): culling and size. 
___a) Culling is generally where only so many sounds can be buffered (played) at once due to hardware limitations that exist in all games, and what usually happens is sounds are culled (dropped) from the buffer of ~500 sounds (AFAICT) based on the quietest, oldest (those that have been alive the longest), or furthest distance away. 
___b) Size deals with the priority of the sound being played (which I think internally CA refers to as intensity, difficult to determine). So, if you are close to an entity playing a louder (larger) sound, then the other sounds 'in the scene' will be reduced in volume or (usually) muted, likely depending on the size comparison. It is important that it works this way because otherwise you would have a drone of overloaded noise and you wouldn't be able to distinguish one sound from another. This would be the audio equivalent of mixing all the paint colors together on the palette and trying to paint a "picture" from the mixed singular brown mud color). This is also a trick/technique in audio design in movies and games where you make the loudest sounds actually sound like they are louder, by reducing the quieter sounds (fade off all sounds right before a huge explosion, for example). 
With all that in mind, there is only so much that can be done about sound drop outs. The long term plan is to try to minimize this as much as possible, but otherwise this is an issue with the sound engine.[/b]

 NOTES:

I stress that this mod does NOT add new sound effects, nor does it change any sound effects. It changes the VOLUME (attenuation, culling, and distance parameters) of the sounds, altering the distances in which they can be heard, among other fine adjustments. It also creates a lot of new profiles for sounds, to affect the properties of them based on the type of sound, and the distance that they should carry. Think of it as a remix of the audio. It is possible that the average user might not notice the obvious improvements, but even without trained ears you should notice details and sounds that you didn't hear before.

[i]You will still hear yelling and screaming in battle from when units charge, or if a unit screams all the time in combat (like the "Sisters of the Screaming Doom" Dark Elves unit), but you won't hear the constant excessive yelling/screaming during melees, and especially won't hear all the random soldier vocals unless you are down near the action (the distance that these were heard were too far away). Then where voices are heard, they fall off rapidly over distance.[/i]

All future patch

2998630271.title: Campaign Weather Overhaul
2998630271.description:
[b] Mod is fully adapted to every map in the game, including Immortal Empires Expanded and The Old World map, but place mine first in the load order! [/b] 

[h1] INTRODUCTION [/h1] 
This mod is a complete overhaul of campaign map lighting and weather. There are close to 300 new environments, with more than 60 new weather effects for Realms of Chaos, Immortal Empires, Immortal Empires Expanded and The Old World map. [b] This mod puts visuals and immersion over gameplay, so some areas might not be visually optimal for everyone.[/b]  

[b] This mod is entirely designed with the Improved Campaign Camera mod in mind. The lower inclination of the vanilla camera is NOT the intended "angle of view" for the visuals provided by this mod. [/b] 

[h1] THE OLD WORLD [/h1] 

[b] The Empire [/b] 
Foggy and gloomy, with areas of intermittent rain. The southern areas are sunnier. The east and north have light snow and a colder feel. The Middle Mountains have strong snowfall. Grey and Black Mountains are under moderate snowfall. 

[b] Sylvania [/b] 
Gloomy, spooky, foggy, dark and full of bats!

[b] Bretonnia [/b] 
Generally bright and sunny. The northern Marches are rainy. Forests have slight leaf fall. Mousillon is rainy. The Coast of Lyonesse is misty. 

[b] Athel Loren [/b]
Magical, verdant forest with perpetual leaf fall and magical spores. 

[b] Southern Realms [/b]
The Border Princes are cloudy or with slight rain. Tilea is bright and sunny, Estalia has a more arid feel. Sartosa is shrouded in rainy fog. The Vaults are ravaged by violent gusts of snow.

[b] Skavenblight [/b]
Dark, rainy and putrid.

[b] Kislev [/b]
Under perpetual snowfall. In the south, snowfall is mild. Central areas are under abundant but gentle snowfall. Troll Country is ravaged by violent gusts. The north-east is under a more violent snow storm.

[b] Norsca [/b]
An inhospitable, violent, frozen wasteland, ravaged by a blizzards or more moderate snowfall. 

[b] Albion [/b]
Heavy perpetual rain, fog and some magical spores.

[b] World's Edge Mountains [/b]
The north is under intense snowfall that gets milder moving south. In the Badlands area, they have an arid and/or vulcanic feel. 

[b] The Badlands [/b]
Bright and dry, except the Marshes of Madness that have a swampy feel. 

[h1] THE NEW WORLD [/h1] 

[b] Nehekhara [/b]
Dry and arid. The Black Pyramid and the Tower of Arkhan have some ghostly presence.

[b] Araby [/b]
Bright, scorching desert. 

[b] Southlands Jungles [/b]
Sunnier but steaming jungles. Some areas are under moderate rain. Zlatlan is hidden by moderate fog. The Cape is misty and with light rain.

[b] Lustria [/b]
Isthmus is sunny and with light rain. Northern Lustria is swampy and fetid. The central areas are under intermittent heavy tropical rain. The Vampire Coast is dark and rainy. Xlanhuapec area is shrouded in mist and Culchan Plains are sunny. Western Jungles and Turtle Isles are cooler, coastal forests. Deserts are dry and the Cape is cold and rainy. 

[b] Ulthuan [/b]
Nagarythe is dark and barren. Eataine, Tiranoc and Ellyrion are peaceful paradises. Avelorn and Chrace are sunny and verdant. Vauls Anvil is vulcanic. Saphery has a more magical feel. Cothique is misty and with light rain. Yvresse is shrouded by a thick mist. 

[b] Naggaroth [/b]
Titan Peaks are vulcanic. The coastal and central areas are gloomy and under moderate/heavy rainfall. Obsidian peaks are ashy and vulcanic, Iron Mountains are cold and with light snowfall. The western deserts are bright and dry. The northern tundra is blinding and under heavy snowstorms and blizzards. 

[h1] THE EAST [/h1] 

[b] Darklands [/b]
North and centre have a hellish, industrial feel.  The south is more arid, with ashfall. The Mouth of River Ruin is putrid. 

[b] Nagashizzar [/b]
Dark, rainy, with ghostly spirits and bats.

[b] Dragon Isles[/b]
Under intermittent tropical rainfall.

[b] Mountains of Mourn [/b]
The south has slight snow. Central Mourn have heavier snowfall and violent gusts of snowstorm. Firemouth is vulcanic. The Great Maw has a putrid feel. The north has a glacial, ice-age feel, under a perpetual blizzard. Down south, the Haunted forest and Gnoblar country are gloomy.

[b] Cathay [/b]
Warpstone desert is a green-tinted wasteland. Weijin has magical sparks, the Celestial Riverlands and Basin are a bright and sunny. Eastern coast is foggy and gloomy, with intermittent rainfall. The Forest of the Moon is a peaceful paradise, with floating leaves and magical embers. The Broken Lands of Tian Li are a cold plateau with slight snowfall. The southern jungles are steaming and rainy. 

[b] Khosun (IEE)[/b]
Has a colder feel than Cathay. The north has some light rain. 

[b] Eastern Colonies[/b]
Sunny and tropical. Tor Elasor has intermittent rainfall. 

[b] Ind (IEE) [/b]
The Mountains of Heaven are under heavy to light snowfall. The Delta has light fog and intermittent rain. The deserts are dry and scorching. The southern jungles are lush, verdant and steamy. 

[b] Khuresh (IEE) [/b]
Northern mountains are foggy, wet and with intermittent tropical rain. The Girdled Grounds are sunny. The central jungles have a dark, fetid feel. The Acid Rainforest has intermittent blood rain. The western swamps are shrouded in thick green mist and under heavy tropical monsoons. The eastern jungles are cold, with some snowfall in the Dreaming Snarl. Coast of Calamity is in oceanic mist, the south has an ashy volcanic feel.

[b] Gates of Calith [/b]
The far end of the world, under a perpetual, violent monsoon. 

[b] Nippon (IEE)[/b]
The north is foggy and rainy. The south is bright, verdant and sunny. 

[b] Lost Isles of Elithis (IEE)[/b]
Remote islands shrouded by mists. 

[h1] OCEANS [/h1] 

[b] Galleons Graveyard[/b]
Under a violent, windy, oceanic storm.

[b] General[/b]
Areas of the Great Ocean, Far Sea, and Sea of Dread have varying degrees of mist and rain

3368217482.title: Battle Weather Overhaul
3368217482.description:
[h1] INTRODUCTION [/h1] 
This mod is a massive, complete overhaul of battle map lighting and weather effects for every single map in the game, including every custom map added by Waka's Campaign Battles, GCCM BETA and Custom Siege Map Compilation mods. I've created several hundreds of different environment presets, with unique lighting-weather-skybox combinations, new weather effects, a new moon texture and a lot of brand new skyboxes not utilized in vanilla. 
In general, every main environment of the WH world (eg. Empire, Sylvania, Lustria) will have approximately 11 to 14 different environment presets randomly selected before every battle, sometimes more, somtimes less. Out of these, i've decided to keep the Night environments to a total of 3, so they will be much less frequent than day maps, unless Vampire Corruption is high. I’ve tried to make every part of the WH world feel as unique and distinct as possible, with their own feel and visuals. As a result, there are only a few instances of identical environment presets being shared between different geographical areas, and even then i tried differentiating them with weather effects and lighting.

[b] The primary goal of this mod is to provide varied, dark, atmospheric, more loreful and immersive visuals to the game, bringing it closer to the lore and to my vision of the WH world. This means that visual clarity and gameplay is not a priority and takes a step back, which means this mod may not be for everyone. This also means that nights are...nights.[/b] 
This mod is a more gritty and ‘grimdark” alternative to the very popular and amazing Ultimate Lighting mod, which puts visual clarity and gameplay very much in the forefront. You can freely switch between the two based on your preference! And truly a huge thank you to Mazisky himself for his invaluable help, especially when I first started working on this! 

This mod is intended to go alongside the visuals provided by my Campaign Weather Overhaul mod. 

[b] This mod MUST be played with VFX Detail set to Ultra.[/b]  Anything less will significantly affect the visuals, reducing or outright removing a lot of the weather effects. 

I'm aware this mod is currently very big in file size. The reason is that i currently chose to retain in the mod every skybox i utilize, and these are huge files. CA has occasionally removed entire skyboxes from the files in between patches, or has switched up file names and such. So i'm a bit scared this might happen again between the major patches, messing up big parts of the mod if it were to happen. As of now, i'm keeping it this way but i'm still considering tweaks to make the mod smaller.

[h1] ENVIRONMENT VARIETY [/h1] 

There is a gigantic of variety environments, weathers and presets, impossible to describe by text. I could try giving a breakdown of each geographical area and corruption type, but that would become a huge wall of text. There are countless environments that, due to RNG, you might not even ever see in a campaign, but I wanted to provide a lot of variety and uniqueness to each area, so this is the way! You can expect tropical monsoons, violent blizzards, gloomy nights, golden sunsets, intense sandstorms and much, much more. 

To help give a clearer and quicker impression of the vibe and visuals this mod provides, I provided a lengthy gallery with loads of screenshots for each area. But even these are just a small part of it all. 

[h1] CORRUPTION [/h1] 

Since there's currently no corruption screenshots in the gallery, i'll give a quick rundown of what you can expect. 

[b] Skaven Corruption [/b]
Fighting with high Skaven Corruption currently cycles through 2 unique environments. One is a day environemnt, cloud and foggy with a minimal green tint. One is a gloomy cloudy night with a green Morrslieb shining bright through the clouds. Depending on the region you're in, both can have green warp sparks in the air as well as warp tainted ash, rain or snow falling from the sky.

[b] Vampire Corruption [/b]
This corruption cycles through all the regular, natural night presets i created for the region + 3 unique environments visibile only when this corruption is present. One is a day shrouded in thick vampiric mist, one is a green tinted night, with an abnormally big Morrslieb shining bright, one is a bright night with a cloudy sky (inspired by Nosferatu). You'll also see bats and ghostly spirits flying about. Rain or Snow can be present too. 

[b] Undivided Corruption [/b]
Cycles through 2 possible environments, one dull and cloudy one with a more apocalyptic sky. In both, ash will be falling from the skies, either gently or violently. Snow or rain may be presente depending on the region. 

[b] Khorne Corruption [/b]
Red tinted, with red sparks and possibly bloon rain of varying intensity. Regular rain or snow may be present. 

[b] Nurgle Corruption [/b]
Fetid, corrupted, dark, full of toxic spores and flies flying in the air. Rain or snow may be present.

[b] Slaanesh Corruption [/b]
No real unique weather effects for now (WIP too here). Expect pink-tinted skies and lighting, and ash fall too. Rain or snow may be present.

[b] Tzeentch Corruption [/b]
Blue-tinted, with magical embers and blue sparks in the air, as well as magical floating rocks in the distance. Rain or snow may be present. 

[h1] COMPATIBILITY [/h1] 
Compatible with the main map mods on the workshop: Waka’s Campaign Battles, GCCM Beta and Custom Siege Map Compilation. I will keep adding their maps as they keep adding new ones.
Compatible with my Campaign Weather Overhaul mod. 
Should be compatible with everything else.

[b] Obviously not compatible with Ultimate Lighting 2.0, since both do the very same thing. You’re free to switch between the two depending on your taste![/b] 
The mod is probably not compatible with Seasons and Holiday mod. I don't think anything crashes when using both, but I'm pretty sure they won't work proper

3393253521.title: Run 'Em Down - Units Actually Damage Routing Units
3393253521.description:
Don't you just love when you have a unit surrounded but it just wont take any damage BECAUSE its surrounded, so the attack animations cant play?  Because I don't.
Simply put, I disliked that units couldn't be ran down by cavalry effectively and that encirclements were useless beyond the initial break, so I made this.  Units should be able to actually damage and kill things they have surrounded.  It worked at Cannae, why not Verdanos?

Only works in campaigns, not custom battles

------

Here's the secret, this doesn't actually do any hamfisted edits to animations.  It just makes it so that all units in the game, when *very* close (basically inside another unit) to a broken or shattered unit, like when surrounding or when chasing down when much faster than the other unit, do tiny bits of chip damage via a super short range hidden attribute.

Want to see under the hood?  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3393253412]Here[/url] is the version that shows the effect that I use to make this work.  It will probably get pretty redundant having the same ability on the unit card of every unit in the game, thus why the mod on this page is the default reccomended version.

------

Thank you to the people that helped me navigate some of these files to get this working

Compatibility:
Save game compatible
Mixed reports on multiplayer compatibility, works fine for some, but rare reports on desyncs
Compatible with I assume everything, even modded units

3442905174.title: More High Angle Fire (includes Stop Idling and True Sight features)
3442905174.description:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
This mod increases the probability of curved-shot ranged units [b]using high-angle fire when there is a risk of hitting allies[/b]. As a result, you no longer have to worry about your frontline infantry getting their backs filled with friendly arrows. Additionally, since high-angle fire is prioritized, this mod also greatly reduces the chances of ranged units being inexplicably obstructed from shooting.

In the base game, curved-shot ranged units (such as archers) have two firing modes: low-angle fire and high-angle fire. However, the vanilla game makes arcing units choose low-angle fire most of the time, often resulting in frontline infantry getting filled with friendly arrows from behind. My mod prioritizes high-angle fire for arcing units, significantly reducing friendly fire incidents.

This mod also affects units engaged in melee combat: units using melee weapons will engage enemies more aggressively than in vanilla. However, units equipped with ranged weapons will now behave more defensively, are more likely to maintain formation, and can more reliably continue firing even when a small number of models are engaged in melee.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
This mod is savegame compatible. This mod is compatible with all other mods.

If this mod and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3628832922]True Sight[/url] are enabled at the same time, only this mod’s effects will apply regardless of mod load order, because True Sight is actually trying to modify the same parameter that this mod already modifies.

[h1]Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]
[h3]Will this mod make arcing units always use high-angle fire mindlessly?[/h3]
No, it won’t. Arcing units will still choose low-angle fire when appropriate—for example, when targeting large enemies or when there are no obstacles, as low-angle fire provides higher damage efficiency in those cases. They will only switch to high-angle fire when low-angle fire would result in friendly fire. [b]I highly recommend subscribing and trying this mod out for yourself—in the vast majority of cases, the benefits outweigh any downsides![/b]

[h3]Will this mod turn direct-fire units (such as gunners) into curved-shot units (such as archers)?[/h3]
No, this mod does not affect the projectile trajectory of any units.

[h3]Will there be improvements when shooting at enemies on walls during siege battles?[/h3]
Yes, but it requires some small tricks. First, it's best to keep your archers in a square formation. Then, place another unit (preferably cavalry or monstrous infantry) in front of the archers. This will make the archers perceive an obstruction, forcing them to enter high-angle fire mode.

[h3]Does this mod work for new units added by other mods? Does it work for AI?[/h3]
Yes. This mod changes the game’s global logic rather than modifying individual units.

[h1]This mod will be continuously updated, made purely out of passion. All I ask is for your support—please leave a like! Thank you all![/h1]
My other interesting mods:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3440143038]More Legendary Heroes[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3456405479]Proactive Garrison Attack: All-Faction All-Region[/url]

3642222276.title: [Dark Elves]+20 Range for Crossbows and Handbows
3642222276.description:
This mod simply adds 20 range to DE crossbows and handbows and 10 calibration distance since the range increases.

Also added 10 range to DE bolt-throwers(350 to 360 range) to normalize it with most other artilleries with no calibration distance increase.

Personally don't like a range unit having tiny 5/10 range difference with most other units.

------------------------------

Compatible with sister mods:

Black Ark Corsairs(Repeater Crossbows):
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3623496262

Repeater Crossbows for Devotees of Slaanesh and Rebalance:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3620492799

The Cult of Slaanesh:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3027059730

------------------------------

Some ramblings:

In Tabletop DE crossbows and HE longbows have the same range(while WE have even longer).
And DE bolts are AP while most HE arrows are not(for 8th Ed. but ToW).
I like CA reduces the range of the crossbows while keeping the AP capability to balance things out.
It also makes sense, at least in reality, a repeating/repeater crossbow would have a lower range.
I just think that 125 range is a bit too low(Darkshards already have slow reload) while comparing it to the usual 180 range of bows and other missile weapons like guns. Even Empire crossbows got 160.
Now with a longer range in campaign, you can also have around 180 range with technology bonuses, which is comparable to bows and kinda acts as a reference to Tabletop.

2817813739.title: Miao Ying vs Slaanesh face off (campaign balance) [Immortal Empires & Realms of Chaos]
2817813739.description:
[h1] A campaign balance of the game's "potential" system to strengthen all Slaanesh aligned factions if you are playing as Maio Ying, and Strengthen Maio Ying if you are playing as N'Kari/Azazel/Sigvald.  
相爱相杀（雾）的妙影和色孽 [超凡帝国和混沌魔域的两套战役平衡] : 基于全战战锤的“AI敌意系统”，加强了和玩家敌对的妙影或色孽传奇领主（色孽迷魂者，欣狂军团，颓堕大军）及其仆从国。如果玩家是妙影，则加强色孽和昭明（作者认为混沌魔域的昭明太菜了……）。如果玩家是色孽传奇领主，则加强妙影。PS:加强包括初始领土，经济和兵力。
[/h1]

Check out my other mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2860381227] Miao Ying vs Slaanesh (Immortal Empires start positions) [/url] for altered start positions to place N'kari, Azazel, and Sigvald closer to Miao Ying.   [/b] 

[h1]What "potential" is[/h1]
To understand what the mod does you need to understand the "potential" system and  how the base game buffs certain factions. A faction's "potential" equates to the strength of its economy cheats. In the base Realms of Chaos campaign: [list]
[*]All WH3 races get buffs
[*]All playable WH3 races get a 2nd buff
[*]Certain playable WH3 races get a 3rd "hostility" buff depending on the human player faction. If you play Cathay/Kislev, all Ogres and Demons get a buff. If you play Demons, Cathay/Kislev get a buff, along with sometimes Ogres and whatever Demon faction is ideologically opposed to yours.  [/list]

This mod only messes with the 3rd round of "hostility" buffs, and is compatible with anything that doesn't change the values shown in the "faction_potential_difficulty_overrides_tables". SFO now modifies the same table, so If you want to make sure this mod works, load it above SFO or any other overhaul mods. The diplomacy, starting treasury, and extra territory buffs are scripts that will be compatible with any mod.

[h1] What this mod does exactly[/h1]
[b] If the player is N'Kari/Azazel/Sigvald[/b]  [list]
[*](RoC only) Start with diplomatic contact (war) with Northern Provinces.
[*](RoC only) The Northern Provinces start with control of extra territory in Cathay and the Chaos Wastes.
[*](IE & RoC) The Northern Provinces get significant "potential" bonuses scaling with campaign difficulty.
[*](IE & RoC) Northern Provinces bonus starting treasury
[/list]


[b] If the player is Maio Ying [/b]  [list]
[*](RoC only) Start with diplomatic contact (war) with Seducers of Slaanesh.
[*](RoC only) Seducers of Slaanesh start with control of a large swath of the Chaos Wastes.
[*](IE & RoC) Sigvald/Azazel/N'Kari, Subtle Torture, and Exquisite Pain get significant "potential" bonuses scaling with campaign difficulty.
[*](IE & RoC) Sigvald/Azazel/N'Kari bonus starting treasury
[/list]

[b] If the player is Any Faction [/b]  [list]
[*](IE & RoC) Diplomatic affinity boost between Slaanesh, Warriors of Chaos, and Beastmen  [/list]

The thumbnail is based on the thumbnail from Tarriff's very funny YouTube video that was partially the inspiration for this mod. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DwnM0XEGA9s

2855365665.title: Zoat Elder - Generic Lord + Hero for Wood Elves
2855365665.description:
This mod adds the Zoat Elder as a generic lord and Zoat Warden as generic hero to all Wood Elves factions. On turn start each wood elf faction holding any magical forest region will be granted one Zoat Elder per region, available in the lord recruitment panel. This can only occur once per magical forest, so each of the wood elves factions could (in theory) have up to 10 Zoat Elders. This also means that you won't be getting new ones if they die before becoming immortal. Also works for AI.

This mod was created by [b]Ubermorgen[/b] and [b]Skørne[/b] as a submission for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/jz6vhQX3FU]Modding Den's[/url] [b]January 2021 Mod Jam[/b] for WH2, themed "Elf?".


[h1]Mod Features[/h1]
[b]- Generic Hero: Zoat Warden[/b]
[b]- Generic Lord: Zoat Elder[/b]
[i]It is said that Zoats are powerful magicians, and that they strive to protect the ancient forests of the Old World. In the ordinary run of things, Zoats are seldom encountered outside their woodland homes. Indeed, even within such places, it is rare to catch a sight of one. They seem to be well intentioned creatures, unwilling to interfere in the affairs of others. This does not stop them from destroying their enemies or protecting their homes. When intruders close or danger threatens, Zoats prefer to rouse the trees and undergrowth to crush and strangle interlopers, rather than take direct action themselves. In this way, Zoats can avoid detection, and even a single such creature can imbue a forest with a reputation so dreadful that even marauding Orcs and rampaging warherds will give the area a wide berth. Where sorcery alone is not sufficient, the Zoat will leave the shadows to enter the fray personally, knocking the invaders to the ground with sweeping blows.[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021][img]https://i.imgur.com/1Vglg7c.png[/img][/url]
There's one setting adjustable via [b]Mod Configuration Tool - MCT[/b]:
[list]
    [*][b]Availability[/b]: Specify which agent types are available. Either Lords only, Heroes only or both. (default: both)
[/list]

Keep in mind that changing these setting mid campaign may not bring the expected results - please read the tooltips in MCT before posting any "bug" reports about this!

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fully compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3081800026]The Old World[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493]Immortal Empires Expanded[/url].
    [*]Supports [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888171970]Variant Selector[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/marthenil/myworkshopfiles/]Marthenil[/url].

Most of all, Slaanesh thirsts for elven souls. The ones bound to Ulthuan's waystones and Athel Loren are tease the Dark Prince, just out of reach. Perhaps you could come to a mutually beneficial arrangement? Your dilemma decisions will have consequences, so do take care to not lose yourself in dealings with Chaos.

(this mod is her model after stage 1; the visible black chaos taint from her extremities were removed as part of her body's rejuvenation. The less intimidating appearance will aid her quests of seduction.)

[*]first stage will require capture of Alith Anar, the one who spurned her before and stole her Stone of Midnight

3376917062.title: 堕落升魔 (Corrupted Ascension)
3376917062.description:
[h1][b]前置需求[/b][/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3376886102]通用框架 (Generic Framework)[/url]

[h1][b]如何开始[/b][/h1]
当游戏开始时，妙影所在派系将获得色孽之剑的神器任务，完成此任务即可开始堕落之旅。
玩家游玩非妙影派系时，由AI控制的妙影将自动推进堕落阶段，并根据妙影当前的堕落阶段给予玩家事件播报。当妙影达成第六阶段（色孽帝国）后，将出现提示玩家前去击败妙影的特殊事件。击败妙影后触发合邦事件，玩家可以选择合邦或者仆从妙影所在的派系。
  
[h1][b]独特机制：色孽亲随[/b][/h1]
妙影的行动能够提升色孽亲随，可用于扩建欢愉宫殿以及解锁力量。效果包括：部队升级，玩家可以消耗色孽亲随将低阶凡人部队升阶为色孽的强大奴仆。荣耀之路，领主与英雄亦可一路擢升，直接为黑暗亲王效命。

[h1][b]独特机制：色孽霸权[/b][/h1]
色孽霸权主要通过欢愉宫殿建筑获取，通过不断积累色孽霸权为妙影解锁各种强大的战役加成、独特的人物特性、以及神器装备。霸权等级抵达第六阶段时，妙影将获得变身成为恶魔、以及生育恶魔领主的能力。

[h1][b]独特机制：欢愉宫殿[/b][/h1]
随着妙影的霸权等级提升，将逐渐解锁城镇内的欢愉宫殿序列，以及散落在震旦各地的独特地标。这些建筑或是能够招募高级部队，亦或是强大的经济建筑。

[h1][b]重要更新[/b][/h1]
2026.6.13
修改了神器战斗的地形。

2026.6.6
新增若干随机事件。

2026.5.22
傅远山、侯倩新增二阶段任务、特性。

淫欲炮由单模组改为4模组，现在拥有招募容量限制。
魅舞者现在可以享受部分对步兵加成的科技与红线。
欲龙马骑兵招募序列由5本下调至4本。
修复部分模型的穿模问题。
修复部分文本的语病。

2026.4.25
妙影新增3个怀孕特性，在怀孕1、3、6次后获得。
娼龙后裔新增独特背景特性。
修复部分模型的穿模问题。
修复部分文本的语病。
新增领主：淫虐使。

2026.4.9
当妙影抵达第一阶段后，妙影所在派系解锁欢愉行动。

2026.1.1
魅舞者溅射数量由1改为4，增加25远程抗性。
堕天将军新增坐骑：恶魔战马。

2025.12.31
完全重做妙影的堕落机制，不再支持卡捷琳相关的内容。
傅远山和侯倩新增合邦任务（即使她们的派系覆灭），不再通过战败招募。
不谐宁和：阴、阳现在可以与武道宁和：阴、阳叠加使用。
妙影诞下的恶魔领主新增坐骑：色孽战马、恶魔战马。

欲龙马骑兵的坐骑改为恶魔战马。
新增领主：堕天将军。

妙影怀孕的概率现在将根据当场战斗的杀敌数计算，当杀敌数达到3000时概率为100%。

3465580284.title: Slaanesh Vassal Cults
3465580284.description:
[h1]Background[/h1]
Ever since the launch of Game 3 and the introduction of the Slaanesh race, I have felt more than ever how lackluster vassals feel, particularly since they are one of the core aspects of the Slaaneshi race with their Domination mechanic. However, vassals don't contribute much in either offense or defense and don't provide any substantial income bonuses. This mod offers the solution of letting the player develop the vassal cities as if they had conquered them, while the vassal still provides all the flavor of being alive and owning its own land.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
   [*]When a Slaaneshi faction gains a new vassal, a new type of cult is immediately created in every one of the vassal's settlements.
   [*]The cult functions like a normal Slaaneshi settlement, with the ability to recruit lords and heroes, a main settlement chain that unlocks new tiers of buildings as well as other buildings that provide unit recruitment, income, and additional garrison units. It is as if the settlement had been conquered instead.
   [*]The cults are destroyed and created dynamically as the vassal loses and gains territory. If a settlement is lost, so is the cult, but if a settlement is conquered a new cult will immediately be formed.
   [*]The cults allow for the owner to take control of the garrison should the settlement be attacked. This feature functions for the vanilla lords, but requires submods for any modded factions.
   [*]When a vassal cult is created it starts at the same tier as the settlement it spawned in. It also tries to fill the cult with buidlings that are vaquely the same as the ones in the settlement. Some slots will however be empty. Additionally, when a cults main building is upgraded new building slots will automatically be added to the cult. 
   [*]A new resource called "Cult Growth" is added to all Slaaneshi factions. It functions like normal growth, but for your vassal cults, and is treated as a global resource. [i](This is largely because the game does not allow buildings to cost province-wide resources. If anyone knows something I don't, please let me know)[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Notes:[/h1]
   [*]Some buildings have had their effects slightly changed compared to their standard counterparts, either because of the restrictions that come with being a cult in a foreign settlement or for balancing reasons. 
   [*]If the Slaanesh faction already controls a normal cult in a settlement that is then made into a vassal settlement, either through vasilisation or conquest, that cult will be removed in favour of the vassal cult. 
   [*]This is only for the Slaanesh race, not Slaanesh leaning Warriors of Chaos. That means that it currently only works for N'Kari, the Masque and Dechala, not Sigvald or Azazel. It also works for any other Slaaneshi faction unlocked by other mods.
[/list]

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
   [*]The building browser sometimes shows all buildings with red X that marks the building as unbuildable. This is only a visual bug, clicking on the building will still construct it.
[/list]
If you find any problems, please let me know! Even reports of spelling errors are greatly appreciated.

So a long long time ago before I knew anything about modding during the early days of Warhammer Total war 3 the one of the first mods I played was Imrik Dragon Taming. It was created by Seu with writing from multiple talented people. 

Sadly when I returned to the game years later this mod was abandonned. Having gotten some modding experiance under my belt I decided to revive it. It's in the exact state as it was years ago, I've added nothing to the mod exept for some tables and script to make progression more smooth. 

Jump in a new Imrik Campaign and get the opportunity to romance or dominate Miao Ying the storm Dragon as the one true Dragon Tamer. 

It should have 0 compatability issues as it only works when playing as Imrik.

3815990781.title: Dusts Corrupted Heroes
3815990781.description:
[h2]Dust’s Corrupted Heroes[/h2]

An urgent letter from Caledor. An unexpected visitor beneath Avelorn’s sacred boughs. A missing mage whose fate may draw the Everqueen into an alliance few would willingly accept.

Follow the intertwined lives of [b]Pulvis[/b], a stoic Druchii Dreadlord; [b]Mikaela[/b], an Asur mage transformed into a half-dragon; [b]Joespharilis[/b], Alarielle’s fiercely loyal Handmaiden; and [b]Nicola[/b], a cunning Slaaneshi cultist whose deepest loyalty belongs to someone considerably more mortal than her god.

Bound together by corruption, loyalty, desire and uneasy alliances, their paths collide as old hatreds begin to blur. Offering sanctuary is one thing. Living with those you have sheltered is quite another.

[h2]An Unfinished Story, a Playable Mod[/h2]

The story remains a work in progress, but the mod is fully playable in its current state. All four characters are implemented, with custom progression, abilities and a questline beginning on [b]Turn 1 when playing as Alarielle/Avelorn[/b].

Follow the unfolding events through missions and dilemmas, from the first troubling reports to the arrival of some decidedly unconventional guests.

Playing another faction? Avelorn’s AI has its own recruitment progression, allowing these characters to appear without the player leading the story. Confederating Avelorn can bring them into your own faction.

[h2]Adult Content Notice — Now NSFW[/h2]

[b]Dust’s Corrupted Heroes is no longer safe for work.[/b]

With this update, the story moves into explicit sexual content and darker adult themes. This release and future story updates are intended for adults aged 18 and over.

[h2]Pulvis Libinde — The Dreadlord Who Chose Avelorn[/h2]

Forged by the cruelty of Quintex, Pulvis has learned to meet the world with discipline, few words and an expression that gives very little away. Beneath that restraint lies a man willing to risk Morathi’s wrath for someone others have already abandoned.

His bond with [b]Shackolot the Calamity[/b] rests upon mutual trust. Unfortunately for Avelorn’s gardeners, the ancient Black Dragon’s understanding of restraint remains somewhat negotiable.

On the battlefield, Pulvis brings Druchii precision and Asur discipline together, strengthening his mixed elven host and protecting those closest to him. Shackolot’s Miasma sustains him while spreading ruin among his enemies, and the Calamity himself provides a persuasive answer to anyone still questioning the Dreadlord’s presence.

[h2]Mikaela Luna — The Half-Dragon[/h2]

Once a mage of Hoeth serving alongside Imrik, Mikaela sought to prove herself beyond the safety of the White Tower. Captivity beneath Morathi’s shadow left her transformed, carrying the remnants of her beloved dragon Lycanthos within a body she must learn to call her own.

Her rescue begins a struggle for recovery, belonging and control over powers that no longer behave quite as her tutors intended.

Mikaela combines fire sorcery with draconic resilience and the unsettling influence of Slaanesh’s mark. The [b]Embers of Lycanthos[/b] endure within her, while her skills strengthen dragons and Dragon Princes, kindle her allies’ attacks and shelter Pulvis and Nicola beneath her wings.

She has lost much. The flame has not gone out.

[h2]Joespharilis Dalterion — The Everqueen’s Watcher[/h2]

Alarielle’s trust is an honour. It is also an excellent way to acquire responsibilities nobody else particularly wants.

Joespharilis is charged with watching the Everqueen’s unusual guests, protecting those placed in her care and ensuring that Avelorn’s hospitality is not mistaken for carelessness. Her loyalty is fierce, her discipline exacting, and her patience faces increasingly inventive tests.

A deadly archer and hunter, she can learn to stalk unseen, strike without revealing herself and pass her lessons to the Sisters of Avelorn. Her connection to the Everqueen also strengthens the Handmaidens who serve beside her.

[i]Keeping an eye on two Druchii, a half-dragon and the Calamity was not mentioned during her training.[/i]

[h2]Nicola Nuvia — Loyalty Beneath the Silk[/h2]

Nicola knows the ways of Quintex: when to smile, when to flatter, when to disappear, and exactly where to place the knife.

A cultist of Slaanesh, she wears her confidence openly and treats solemn occasions as invitations to misbehave. Yet beneath the teasing and calculated charm lies a loyalty strong enough to carry her into Avelorn itself, bearing a message its guardians would rather never have heard.

She came because Pulvis asked. What follows becomes far more complicated.

In battle, Nicola feeds upon wavering courage, undermines enemy resolve and turns close combat into a deadly performance. Her [b]Dance of Blades[/b] makes standing too close an unfortunate decision, while her personal skills reward fighting alongside those she values.

[h2]A Black Ark Between Two Shores[/h2]

Recovered from the wrecks of the Galleon’s Graveyard, Pulvis’s old Black Ark becomes a home for those with nowhere else to go.

Rebuild it from a damaged vessel into the [b]Black Citadel of Harmony[/b], with its own building chains, recruitment and progression. Barracks house former enemies beneath the same roof. Healers tend wounds without asking which shore their patients came from. Asur mages and Druchii sorceresses attempt to share a tower without sinking the vessel beneath them.

Shackolot has claimed the upper decks. Sharing them remains an ongoing discussion.

Its custom roster includes:

[list]
[*][b]Cold One Dragon Princesses[/b]
[*][b]Black-Silverin Guard[/b]
[*][b]Sister Shades of Avelorn[/b]
[*][b]Corsair Rangers[/b]
[*][b]Redeemed Medusa[/b]
[/list]

Together, these units give Pulvis a force shaped by the unlikely community growing aboard his Ark.

[h2]Playing with Kerberos’ ATB[/h2]

For the fullest narrative experience, I recommend playing alongside [b]Kerberos’

3829276482.title: Citadel of Dusk Standalone (Dust)
3829276482.description:
[h2]Citadel of Dusk - The Southern Watch[/h2]

Originally created as an expansion for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3815990781]Dust’s Corrupted Heroes[/url], this mod grew into something of its own. While sharing progress screenshots on the LazyIcarus Discord, several people asked for a standalone release, so here it is!

Take command of the now fully playable [b]Citadel of Dusk[/b]. At the southern tip of Lustria, Melvina and Alluna stand watch over the sea, guarding against the forces of Chaos gathering beyond the strait.

[h2]A Citadel Hidden in the Mists[/h2]

Hidden behind banks of mist, the Citadel combines the traditions of Yvresse’s Mistwalkers with its own seafaring ways. Powerful Dragonships serve as mobile strongholds, carrying warriors and shipboard recruitment across the southern seas. Archmages can answer the Invocation of Ladrielle to captain additional vessels, expanding the reach of the Southern Watch.

On land, concealed armies strike from the mists while Great Eagles, Frostheart Phoenixes and Lothern Skycutters patrol overhead. Mistwalkers hold the line, supported by Eagle Claw Bolt Throwers and the magic of the hidden sea.

[list]
[*]A fully playable Citadel of Dusk with a custom opening campaign.
[*]Two unique legendary characters with personal skill lines and equipment.
[*]Dragonship construction for Melvina and Archmage captains recruited through the Invocation of Ladrielle.
[*]Mistwalker recruitment and capacity through unique settlement and Dragonship landmarks.
[*]A focus on Mistwalkers, Eagles, Frostheart Phoenixes, Skycutters and Eagle Claw Bolt Throwers.
[*]Stalking armies, concealing mists and a campaign facing the threats of the southern Chaos Wastes.
[/list]

[h2]Melvina - Warden of the Southern Passage[/h2]

A warrior and spellcaster, Melvina combines sword and spear with the thunder of the Heavens and the concealing power of Mist. Her talents strengthen the Citadel’s Mistwalkers and airborne forces, while her sharp eyes uncover enemies who believe themselves safely hidden.

Melvina commands her own Dragonship and can eventually ride [b]Buckbeak[/b], her imposing black-feathered, white-furred griffon. A dedicated personal skill line and a collection of unique items let her grow into a formidable commander both on the battlefield and across the campaign map.

Every returning sail is counted. Every shadow above the waves is watched.

[h2]Alluna - Loremaster of the Mists[/h2]

Alluna is Melvina’s most trusted companion. Her education at Hoeth was hardly the triumph her tutors had hoped for. The separate Winds of Magic resisted her efforts, yet where those currents mingled, her gifts flourished: mist gathered at her call, tempests answered, and bitter frost formed beneath her blade.

Rebuffed by peers who saw only imperfect discipline, she found a welcome in the Citadel of Dusk. Melvina recognised a talent worthy of the Southern Watch and received her with open arms.

Alluna combines a Loremaster’s swordsmanship with the Lores of [b]Ice, Tempest and Mist[/b]. Her skills support her accompanying lord and army, while her unique equipment strengthens her magic and keeps nearby allies fighting.

In time, she can take to the skies upon [b]Skylar[/b], her Frostheart Phoenix, and unleash [b]Frostwing Convocation[/b] upon the enemy.

[i]There is even hope for her studies at Hoeth. Eventually. Probably.[/i]

[h2]Friend, Ally or Enemy?[/h2]

Will you lead the Southern Watch yourself, or encounter it during another campaign?

Forge an alliance, bring these defenders into your own faction through confederation, or test whether your armies can break through their mists.

[h2]Join the Community[/h2]

Follow development, share your campaigns and find more information about ATB here:

[url=https://discord.gg/ky7NeuKS5Y]Join the Discord[/url]

[b]Enjoy the Citadel of Dusk![/b]

3258529495.title: High Elves Expanded Hero Skill Trees
3258529495.description:
This mod adds some additional skills to each of the High Elves Hero's skill trees.  It is intended to fill out the skill trees a bit and make them more interesting/loreful.  Does not affect Lords.


[b]Mage[/b]
- Each lore has different passive bonuses and gains a bound spell from their lore.
- Three spell casting styles:
[olist]
[*] Arcane Duelist - On-cast passive abilities that protect allies from spells and increase enemies' cooldown time and miscast chance.
[*] Battle Scholar - gain increasing bonuses when allies or enemies cast spells
[*] Arcane Priest - gain a passive aura that increases ward save and leadership, and an on-cast passive that gives magical weapons and vigor to allies
[/olist]

[b]Handmaiden[/b]
- Expanded "- of the Everqueen" lines
[olist][*] Diplomat  - gain stalk, armor and leadership for army, and Stand Your Ground!
[*] Protector - gain improved version of Entangle, and a passive healing aura that increases intensity with friendly deaths
[*] Lieutenant - bonuses to ranged and melee attacks, and Volley of High Arrows[/olist]


[b]Noble[/b]
- Champion an Elven god (includes the same gods Lords can dedicate to, plus Ladrielle, Loec, and Lileath)
- Four backgrounds
[olist][*] Courtier - gain influence and leadership bonuses, gain Prodigious Orator that gives cycling passive bonuses to allies and penalties to enemies
[*] Explorer - Battle movement speed, campaign army movement bonus, and cooldown for Foe-Seeker
[*] Marshalled Artist - Magic item drop chance, melee attack and defense bonuses, and three situational passive abilities
[*] Fortress Veteran - Bonus to defensive stats, army armor bonus while defending, passive aura that increases leadership, melee defense and bonus v large [/olist]


[b]Loremaster of Hoeth[/b]
- Pick one from various other character's abilities including Colossal Strike, Stand Your Ground, Arcane Conduit, or a bound spell
- Pick an additional on-cast Lore passive from the other remaining Lores


Also adds skills for Mist Mages and Caradryan.


[h3]Compatibility[/h3]
Mods that change skill trees for High Elf heroes will not be compatible if they use the same space on the skill tree as this mod.

2789855135.title: Artists' Guild - Get your faction items
2789855135.description:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Add a forge for all factions that [b]vanilla[/b] game exist, to get all [u]transferrable items that vanilla game allows[/u]. [b]It is a way to get vanilla items, instead of I made these itmes.[/b]
The "I,II,III" prefix indicates which game the item came from, the "caravan" indicates it is caravan item for cathay.
This is EN interface version. 中文界面版→[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789850920]CHS interface version[/url]
Only work for players.
[b]Special thanks for the help of "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/SyntheticMan]Synthetic Man[/url]".[/b]
[b]Special thanks for the picture resource come from "Flaticon"[/b]

[h1]Different from the previous generation[/h1]
No longer edit "ancillary_included_subcultures". One is too much item (400+) cause game lag in old computer. Another is this table is merged into "ancillaries", edit it will affect compatibility with other mods.
Because every races have different items, they will use independent Artists' Guild instead of the same one. Actual usage will not make a difference.

[h1]Compatibility with other mods[/h1]
Compatible with most modules, necessarily incompatible with similar modules.
Work fine with SFO and Radious.

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 • [b]Not getting item after pressing option[/b]
Artists' guild is made according to the original game data, any mods that change the vanilla data of ancillaries_tables will overwrite the Artists' Guild reference data, if you don't get the item after pressing the option, I won't be able to fix it, check other enabled mods.
 • [b]Obtained non-factional items, eg "Vokmar got the Mark of Chaos" "Dwarf got arcane item"[/b]
No such changes were made, item data is not included in the Artists' Guild files, please check other mods.
 • [b]Followers and banners are too cheap[/b]
Unfortunately, we don't have the time to examine the effect of each item and define a cost for it that is worthy of its value, so the price of [b] all items[/b] is determined based on its unique score (i.e., white-green-blue-purple). The unique points of the retinue and banner have nothing to do with their value, making them too cheap or expensive.

[h1]Sheet[/h1]
The sheet that integrates the data required by the Artists' Guild: [url=https://wwbui.lanzouv.com/i0qqV3cwb63i]File Sharing[/url], password: 1sjo.
The mod is made according to the data in this sheet, collected from the game's database.

[h1]Compatibility with Savegames[/h1]
Unfortunately, saves which have loaded this mod cannot disable this mod. I'd like to make it uninstallable mid-campaign, but it's probably not possible.

[h1]Submod[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794192760]Artists' Guild - More Ancillaries Submod[/url]

[h1]Other Choice[/h1]
You can also try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3253398688]Equipment Manager[/url].

2790029103.title: Better Alliance
2790029103.description:
[h2](Updated to 9.0 + Alliance Lords)[/h2]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
1. [b]More Allied Units[/b]: Allied unit cap increases from 4 to 20, so is Ogre mercenary.

2. [b]More Favor Points[/b]: Doubled favor generation per turn, with max favor increased to 900 (from 100).

3. [b]Borrow Army Longer[/b]: Ally army can be borrowed for 20 turns (instead of 10). Slightly increased base cost to compensate.

4. [b]No Alliance Breaking[/b]: Refusing to join war no longer breaks alliance nor vassal. 

5. [b]Universal Elite Unit Skills[/b]: The four elite-unit skills of every race receive an extra level. The extra level buffs units of same type across races, not just faction units above level 7. Combined Chaos / Nagash achieves so at level 1 elite, as intended by vanilla.

6. [b]Allied Lords[/b]: Generic lords from alliance culture will join player faction. This only works for player faction. Once allied with (or vassal) a faction of another culture, player faction will have their generic lords in pool the next turn. Happens only once per culture upon alliance, and they leave your pool after a few turns.


[h1]Other mods:[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826510909]Alliance Savior[/url]: reinforcing outposts city, and teleport to eligible ally cities.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2891886534]Allied Agents[/url]: allows player to recruit allied agents via outpost. Limited to major factions.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3244295546]UI sliders[/url]: the elite skills display is limited to faction units in vanilla (but effective across all same type units). If you have other mods enabling too many unit permission, the slider helps avoiding display out of screen.


[h1]Compatibility:[/h1]
Should be compatible with everything, such as SFO, Radious, units add by mods; and safe to add and remove mid-campaign, and works for co-op.


[h1]Misc: [/h1]
I don't always check Steam comments. For time-sensitive request, please contact me on discord, either via modding den or my own [url=https://discord.gg/NU5t9CK8eF]channel[/url].

And I always welcome [url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=WHEF2PNWVCQD4]a cup of coffee[/url] for my work.

2798804755.title: Tabletop Caps - Unique Lord & Faction Rules - Submod
2798804755.description:
Submod to Tabletop Caps that addes special rules to all standard Lords and some Factions.

See above collection for supported modded LLs and recomended mods.

Some special rules are applied to lords and/or factions, but they never stack. For example, Boris LL in Boris Faction doesn't get double discount on War Bear Riders. All lords in his Faction gets the discount, or if you recruit Boris by another faction, then only Boris gets the discount.

Since the question has come up several time. When there is a lesser and a greater thematic unit to choose from, I rather make the lesser unit core, than to make the greater unit cheaper. Basically, I want you to use both units, if the greater unit cost the same as the lesser unit, you would never build the lesser unit. I think that even without reduction, chances are you will build some the greater unit anyway, than add in some lesser units as core.'
Examples; Slayers & Giant Slayers, Kroxigors & Sacred Kroxigors.

Credit to Drunkflamingo for Tabletop Caps mod and providing easy documentation to make submods.

Translations;
CN: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2861030555
FR: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3190529954

Some units that are reduced can not be recruited after confederation, you can use mods to get around that such as;
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853185162
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853652213
If you know other good mods that does this please let me know in comments.

2815354316.title: Mod Configuration Tool [LEGACY]
2815354316.description:
Welcome to one of the final instances of Vandy releasing a Beta!

[b][h1]MULTIPLAYER UNSUPPORTED LEGACY VERSION. Use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021]the New Version[/url] for multiplayer and other goodies![/h1][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jYDc60V.png[/img]
The Mod Configuration Tool is a user interface, and a rich backend system, which enables modders to create settings for their mods, which can be edited within the Mod Configuration Tool. [b]In short, if a mod you use doesn't use this, you don't really need it.[/b] That said, I'd love to have you!

These settings are grouped together in "Profiles", which are basically a grouping of settings that you can hot-swap at any time. Say Mod A has a checkbox called "I'm Cool", which you tick to 'true'. You might want to bounce between two different campaigns, one where You're Cool, one where You're Not - you can swap between these Profiles at any point, and their changes will take affect and persist between games.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jk7c87I.png[/img]
As mentioned twice now, this upload I'm considering a "beta" release. For all intents and purposes, it's functional, but there are three major things I have to sort out, in order of priority:

- [b]Multiplayer is currently not supported.[/b] I went back and forth a lot on this one, but in the end I was more interested in getting a functional version out for singleplayer than delay MCT release for potentially another few months. We'll see how long it takes to get MP working - hopefully it's not too painful!
- [b]The UI redesign is unfinished.[/b] I'm happy with a lot of the changes I've made to the MCT layout for this release, but it's not as nice as I'd like it to be. Primarily, I'm looking to rework the actual edit-the-settings side of the panel, which is very dated and probably one of the oldest pieces of code from my original rewrite of this mod over 2 years ago. Specifically, I don't like the assumed three-columns layout, and I don't like how strict everything is in general.
- [b]Profiles are not where I'd like them to be.[/b] They're an interesting design challenge, because normally settings don't allow you to hot-swap between different settings states. One major thing I'd like to do are "link" a Profile to a save file, so those settings persist a bit better, and to make swapping between Profiles a more aware experience.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZCKJzZ3.png[/img]
All you have to do is click the button at the top left corner that now exists, and edit the variables within that panel that opens up. All of the currently enabled "MCT Mods" - that is, mods that have hooked up into MCT - will be listed on the left. Click through them and edit the settings to change up your experience!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/lP98GkG.png[/img]
Fully compatible with anything on the Workshop!

Only known issue is [b]the lack of multiplayer support![/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/mc46vDa.png[/img]
An old (but mostly still valid!) manual can be [url=https://chadvandy.github.io/mod_configuration_tool/topics/manual.md.html]found here[/url]. I have to get around updating it, yes, I know, I'm just a programmer.

If you'd like to include a banner for your mod saying it's MCT enabled, use the following in your mod description!
[code][noparse]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815354316][img]https://i.imgur.com/1Vglg7c.png[/img][/url]
[/noparse][/code]

[url=https://github.com/chadvandy/van_mct][img]https://i.imgur.com/fy0erGx.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/dd4TUDm][img]https://i.imgur.com/R4kQ0hO.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://tw-modding.com][img]https://i.imgur.com/72KhAbE.png[/img][/url]

2822827945.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bRApXUg.png[/img]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/kinggelbe/?hl=en] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Qhiyg6a.png[/img] [/url]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4wfAuBT.png[/img]
[b]Looking for modders who know how to edit/change/add animations to allow units to play visually correct animations, and fix T-pose issues that exist in other formations like spear square so I can finally add them[/b]

[b]Important note:[/b]
Because of the weirdness of Warhammer formations there is one oddity I can't fix because it seems to be hardcoded, however there's an easy work around. For foot soldiers with the formation activated if you right click and drag and you go to far the formation will glitch and the soldiers will form a circle near the edge of it. When you see the formation start to glitch up when dragging out, reduce the drag amount until the formation preview stops flickering. There should be no mini lines in the formation, just normal straight even lines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wGfbEz5.jpg[/img]

This mod builds off of Crynsos' mod in Warhammer 2 by simplifying the amount of formations each unit has and making it more light weight and compatible with other overhaul mods.

Most Spearmen with shields have Spear Wall, Spearmen without a shield have Pike Wall, and units with swords, maces, etc. and also have a shield get Shield Wall.

Most cavalry now have Wedge formation, and flying cavalry have Flying Wedge. In addition, missile cavalry units have Swooping Crane.

Also, you can easily exit a foot soldier formation in combat if you right click attack an enemy. It might take a few tries to get the charge to happen.

There are also variants of most formations to make it fit more in line with that faction.

For those asking for more formations, the main reason I don't want to add anymore is because Warhammer is very finicky with formations. The ones in this mod work well, but other formations like pike square are very broken and feature T-Poses. If CA ever fixes these I will add them, but until then I won't be adding them.

2831594644.title: Cultist Expansion: Brass Sisters of Khorne
2831594644.description:
[h3]Adds the Cultist of Brass Hero to Khorne Daemon and Valkia's factions.  Wielding an axe and shield like the default Cultist of Khorne, she is slightly more defensive, and comes with her own unique summoning abilities (Furies and Soul Grinders of Khorne).[/h3]

Recruiting for Valkia [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660]REQUIRES MIXU'S UNLOCKER MOD[/url][/b], but the mod works for Skarbrand and the minor Khorne factions without it.  I marked the mod as required so people would not mistakenly try to play Valkia without it, but nothing has changed: Mixu's Unlocker is OPTIONAL if you do not need Valkia recruitment.

[h2]New![/h2]
The Brass Sisters are now included in a combined mod collection entitled [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2984641517]Alshua's Cultists[/url][/b].  This permits Valkia recruitment without the use of Mixer.

[h2]Lore[/h2]
[quote][i]There are three main types of Khorne cultist.  The first is the warrior who comes to enjoy battle and killing too much, and begins to desire it for its own sake.  The second is the mad killer, who you will meet in a future mod in this series.  The third and most tragic is the normal person who becomes violent in order to survive a violent world, and finds themselves going much, much too far. 

The [b]Brass Sisters[/b], found in the Warhammer Fantasy "Tome of Corruption" sourcebook, are this unfortunate third category of Khorne cultist.  Residents of the far-flung outskirts of the Empire, their villages were ravaged by the merciless Marauders from the north, who put every man of fighting age to death, leaving only the women and a few children.  Their families killed, their homes burned, they trusted their lives to Maegin, wife of their slain constable.

Maegin was well-trained in combat, and she taught the surviving women well.  As word spread of their resistance to the Marauders, other survivors flocked to join them.  But Maegin's true vendetta was with the Empire, which had in her mind abandoned them to serve the interest of the corrupt nobility.  Under the pretense of strengthening other villages by culling the weak, Maegin's warband began assaulting their own countrymen.  With every raid growing more barbaric, soon these "Brass Sisters," as they became known, were no better than the Marauders that had created them.

The Heroes in this mod represent strong champions of the Brass Sisters, who are on the same path as so many other corrupted warriors, seeking glory in the name of their dark god and hoping to be rewarded with his Mark.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Design[/h2]
The Cultist of Brass has eight unique heads and four unique bodies.  There was no muscular female unit to base them on, so I had to put together a muscular female body myself.  I did not go in as hard on bodily variety here, but I tried to cover a wide range of hairstyles (as well as varying facial shape, eye color, etc).  Those who like more conventional beauty and those who want rough, violent killers should both find something they like.

In addition, I [b]added 68 female forenames[/b] and a few dozen themed last names, all used only by this unit.  The Cultists of Brass will spawn with a mixture of "normal" women's names, fearsome nicknames, and some more demonic-feeling names from the base game (intended to represent those who have chosen to go by Khornate names from now on).

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
This Hero unit is designed to appeal to those who value a balanced, vanilla-like experience.  It is a close variant of the vanilla Cultist of Khorne, and they share a recruitment limit (so, this mod [b]does not increase the total number of Heroes[/b] Khorne can recruit).  The "Cultist of Brass" trades a very small amount of her offensive stats for equivalent amounts of defensive stats, creating a slightly tankier choice.

[b]The Cultist of Khorne is renamed "Cultist of War,"[/b] to distinguish him from his new sisters-in-arms.  No other changes have been made to him.

For fun and variety, the Cultist of Brass can summon [b]Chaos Furies of Khorne[/b] (instead of Bloodletters) and [b]Soul Grinders of Khorne[/b] (instead of Bloodthirsters).  Since these summons are both slightly weaker than the vanilla alternatives, they have been made easier to use: the Furies have no initial cooldown, and the Soul Grinder's is reduced.

[h2]Thank-Yous[/h2]
As always, huge appreciation goes to the RPFM team, and to Ole for the Asset Editor.  I also want to make sure to thank prop joe for his console mod, that saves me enormous amounts of time while testing.  Finally, I owe thanks to someone I'm not sure of, for a muscle texture I used but can't find the origin of.

[h1]Description[/h1]
This mod gives the Cathayan dragonlords a dragon breath ability when they are in dragon form. This ability has infinite uses but the cooldown only decreases when you have at least 15 winds of magic. The abilities between Miao Ying and Zhao Ming are quite different. Yuan Bo can now use a devistating jade boulder to crush his enemies. Upon impact, the boulder will burst into shrapnels with big area of effect damage and knockdown. This attack will be especially strong against unarmored and large entities.

2853058175.title: Loyalty Removed
2853058175.description:
You may now trust even yourself, and skaven piles are (relatively) safe. Mostly just made as an alternate option to a tweaked loyalty system, this mod removes it entirely from Skaven, VCoast, and Dark Elves. There's not much else to the mod, loyalty's just gone. The chance to spawn any dilemmas (positive or negative) or rebel on low loyalty have also been removed, just in case oddities manage to happen. 

If instead you don't want to remove the loyalty system entirely due to the dilemmas and whatnot, and just make it much more forgiving, try this alternate mod in More Forgiving Loyalty: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853057944

If there are any issues, please let me know. Modded factions should be covered unless they have a specific exception for loyalty in their files.


[h1] QUESTIONS: [/h1]

Is this savegame compatible?
-It can be added, but not removed without issues.

Mod conflicts?
-This only touches a few strings relating to loyalty campaign features and variables, so should be relatively safe. It's not compatible with More Forgiving Loyalty, for obvious reasons.

======================

2853254034.title: TW Millennium: Modern Warfare
2853254034.description:
We now have an official [url=https://discord.com/invite/K8Frvq4GfY][b]Discord Server[/b][/url]!
Huge thanks to Nathan the Dwarven Shark for creating it !

With this Mod a new age of warfare has dawned in the world of Warhammer:

The [b] Empire [u] (YOU HAVE TO OWN AT LEAST ONE EMPIRE FACTION!) [/u] [/b] has entered a new age of technology and received new units, buildings technologies and much more.

This Mod is the first part of a project to rework all factions. We decided to release it here in the workshop to let people have fun with it and get more feedback from the players.

[b] IMPORTANT!!! [/b]
To use the Imperial Skydestroyer, you must set the buildings quality setting to [b] Ultra [/b] or [b] High [/b] otherwise the game will crash in the loading screen!

Don't use more than one unit of Imperial Base Engineers in the same army! Using more than one will lead to inevitable crashes and bugs. Additionally depending on the type of battle and other currently unknown factors the buildings will sometimes not be able to spawn units as intended.

[h2]THE UNITS[/h2]
63 units are added to the Empire:
[list]
[*]25 Infantry units
[*]2 Cavalry units 
[*]13 Artillery units
[*]14 Vehicles
[*]9 Aerial units
[*]8 RoR units
[/list]
The descriptions of the units have been moved to a discussion thread, to reduce the textwall on the main site.

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
The stats of the units are orientated on the vanilla values, but due to their modern nature they may be considered slightly overpowered. (Especially the Tanks and Zeppelins!)

[h2]COMPATIBILITY[/h2]
Since Update 1.6 overhauls the Empire as a whole faction, every other mod that adds content to it will most likely not be compatible and will require a compatibility patch. For other mods it is simply hard to predict, if it will be compatible or not. In most cases it is advisable to try the mod in question with this mod and nothing else activated.

Keep in mind that especially other tech tree mods for the Empire will most likely cause problems.

[h2]KNOWN BUGS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Electorial Machinations have the wrong name and tooltip (Colleges of Magic)
[*]Willhelm is missing his 2D porthole picture
[*]Some 3D portholes are not displayed correctly
[*]Due to the startpos all generals and lords that exist at the start of the campaign will have no bodyguard until they get their first mount.
[*]Light Machine Gun Teams are not able to fire while they are in their packed variant.
[/list]

[h2]CREDITS[/h2]
Huge thanks go to [b]MPD[/b] for creating some amazing unit cards and loading screens in the same style as the vanilla units.

This Mod wouldn’t be possible without [b]Frodo45127's RPFM[/b] and the [b]AssetEditor[/b]

I also want to thank [b]Apache49[/b] for providing descriptions for all new technologies, [b]The Broken Vox[/b] for providing descriptions for most of the new buildings, [b]Poxmaker[/b] for providing the descriptions for all the resource buildings and [b]Admonitor[/b] for providing most of the skill descriptions.

The inspiration for the modern units stems partly from a fanfiction we recently read "[url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/10909184/1/An-ISOT-in-Grimdark][b]An ISOT in Grimdark[/b][/url]".

2853974146.title: Unnatural Selection Ultimate
2853974146.description:
[h2]Currently not actively maintained - but probably still works[/h2]
I do not currently keep my mods updated. That said, most of my mods basically never need actual updating after patches. So this mod will very likely still work, just not affect recently added content.


[h1]Overview[/h1]
The popular mod from WH2 is back for WH3 Immortal Empires. With this mod you can apply a buff or debuff to almost every AI-controlled faction in the game that will increase their chances to do well against other AI, and also affect their economy, upkeep costs and other bonuses. Battles against the human player are unaffected.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
    [*]via the Mod Configuration Tool (MCT), you set buffs or debuffs to individual AI factions
    [*]these modifiers adjusts the faction's "faction potential", a value that determines their bonuses/cheats as well as their autoresolve odds against other AI factions (but not against the player)
    [*]the buffs can also be randomized to get a fresh and unpredictable campaign experience
    [*]setting a buff to -4 will kill the faction and remove them from the map
    [*]with the parameter for personality switch threshold you can give minor factions the personality of a major faction
[/list]

[h2]Tips & Details[/h2]
[list]
    [*]buff levels 1-3 should be enough to ensure that the buffed factions do much better
    [*]stronger buffs may lead to very unrealistic outcomes, like small garrisons wiping out full elite AI stacks
    [*]the settings for randomization can only be used on the first turn of a campaign, they have no effect afterwards
    [*]killing factions by setting them to -4 also only works on the first turn
    [*]if randomization is active, the buffs for eligible factions are set randomly according to your settings after the first turn, you can manually adjust individual faction buffs at any time afterwards
    [*]a few factions are not on the map on turn 1 (hordes), so they can't be killed or randomized, you can only set their buffs manually
[/list]

[h2]Rewrite for patch 2.3[/h2]
Although it looks the same and mostly still does the same thing, the mod works completely differently internally since the patch 2.3. Thanks to fellow modder Agemouk who made me aware of a post by a CA dev in a random Discord conversation where he described two undocumented functions, I now know how to manipulate the faction potential directly. So now the mod does that instead of going the more complicated and less effective way of applying stat bonuses to AI armies.

This also allows to effectively debuff factions instead of only buffing them.

A side effect however is that buffed factions will also generally have bigger AI cheats, so they will have more money and lower upkeep costs. If you buff a lot of hostile factions, you effectively raise the difficulty of your campaign. Conversely, if you debuffed every faction with -3 setting, you would effectively play on Easy even if you chose VH campaign difficulty. In a typical randomization setup, I'd recommend to distribute a mix of debuffs and buffs so that factions fall between -1 and +2.

Because debuffs now exist, the value to kill off a faction is no longer -1, but -4!

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Savegame compatible: Yes
    [*]Multiplayer: Now that MCT supports MP, it may work
    [*]SFO, Radious: Yes
    [*]Other mods: Will conflict with any mod that adjusts faction potential via script
[/list]

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
Before reporting issues, make sure that you have the current version of the mod. Steam quite often fails to actually pull the newest version after a mod has gotten an update. To make certain that you have the current version, unsub from the mod, then wait a few seconds. Steam will then delete the mod file from your hard drive. Then resub to the mod and Steam will download the current version to your hard drive.

[h2]Read before posting a comment[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Make sure to use the newest MCT. The 0.9 beta is much better than the previous version that is now called "Legacy"
    [*]If you are a long-time user of this mod, you may think it doesn't work anymore because you don't see the effect on AI armies. That is not the case, in the current version there are no visible effects on anything, the mod still works. It affects the AI factions directly, so the effect is not visible except by the result, them being stronger and more successful
[/list]

2858308116.title: Lily's Bretonnia Overhaul: Definitive Edition - 9.0
2858308116.description:
[b]Sons and Daughters of Fair Bretonnia! At last, I give you the TRUE Definitive Edition version of my Bretonnia Overhaul![/b]

This mod is a rework of Bretonnia, adding new units, technologies and balance changes to enhance your feudal-over-lording experience.

This overhaul experience was designed to allow for more effective use of melee infantry, whilst still adding new features and changes to enhance the noble knights. Overall, Bretonnia may have a steeper challenge in some areas due to the weaker economy, but having more options and play-styles at hand will radically change how you play each campaign.

Try your hand at peasant mob spam with the Fay Enchantress, an army of royal men-at-arms with Louen or hard hitting regiments of foot squires as Alberic!

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Sz2nmjOccZVsPq7Q8mmkVkEHsydY8OqJ[/img]

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Jh15tXkuA_P0FQw0CFWdyzbx5Dad20x_[/img]

• [b]Knights no longer have their upkeep increased without vows, and have unit Caps instead.[/b]

• Modified starting armies for King Louen, Duke Alberic and The Fay Enchantress.
• Questing Knights and Grail Knights have smaller unit counts but improved stats to compensate.
• Foot Squires are buffed and can be recruited at Tier III. They can be recruited by Alberic from Ports.
• Men-at-arms (Polearms) recruited at tier II.
• Peasant bowmen and Peasant mob recruitable from the settlement chain.
• [b]Farms and Industry can be upgraded without needing a Mill or Storage.[/b]

• New units: Royal Men-at-Arms, Royal Spearmen-at-Arms, Royal Men-at-Arms (Skirmishers), Royal Men-at-Arms (Hammers), Royal Men-at-Arms (Longbows) and Royal Men-at-Arms (Polearms)
• New Regiment of Renown: Swords of Couronne (Royal Men-at-Arms)

• New Building: Almshouses. They are used to increase peasants in the peasants economy.
• New Building: Guilds. They improve your economy and increase your knight caps.
• New Building: Royal Chapter Barracks. They allow you to recruit Royal Men-at-Arms.

• 19 new technologies and changes to many existing technologies
• 14 New skills, with a unique skill for each Lord, Hero and Legendary Lord.

• Redesigned Traits for each Faction.
• Changes to dilemma events.
• Starting peasant limit increased.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Mna7f-uJ7aD_3m3N9-M87YBH9pATV1t4[/img]

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1_nAM3d_1HztpY6HgQQTLPpTm-EI9tsn9[/img]

• A Core Royal Men-at-Arms choice

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1p6dzbyxMK6GDGwfXGvryeevNE4NP1RdZ[/img]
[b]Royal Spearmen-at-Arms[/b]
