• Armed with shields and spears, they are able to take a direct charge and dish out more damage than regular spearmen-at-arms!

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1DLG61GmNPE8riuMzdN1k4MrpWhMyKRmv[/img]
[b]Royal Men-at-Arms (Polearm)[/b]
• A Core Royal Men-at-Arms choice
• Armed with polearms, they deal great armour piercing damage to large enemies, much more so than regular Men-at-Arms.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Xl0RJZsnb5z7nv4zweI2AQd4JyqDh0qE[/img]
[b]Royal Men-at-Arms (Longbows)[/b]
• A Special Royal Men-at-Arms choice
• Ranged Infantry armed with longbows.
• They have increased ranged damage, accuracy and ammunition compared to peasant bowmen, as well as slightly improved melee stats, leadership, health and armour.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/19DhUfDGUQgm-tJktZPeVgj7IJGfE9RC1[/img]
[b]Royal Men-at-Arms (Skirmishers)[/b]
• A Special Royal Men-at-Arms choice
• Highly skilled melee infantry (for Peasants)

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Vn_NL7fCh3XaqQntlpcb6gUQ8RIMgvMp[/img]
[b]Royal Men-at-Arms (Hammers)[/b]
• A Special Royal Men-at-Arms choice
• Highly skilled melee infantry (for Peasants)
• Large armour-piercing attacks that reduce leadership and armour.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/15lN7A_osHqbVEYHaT-rHVpDW5kEosYPd[/img]
[b]Swords of Couronne (Royal Men-at-Arms)[/b]
• Regiment of Renown, unlocked at level 6
• Melee Infantry armed with dual swords, they deal high damage to enemy infantry.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/10UP-Bw_9tDUhguP2VPYOsoqCwmHtbXc4[/img]
[b]New Technology:[/b]

Nineteen New Technologies!
• Improve your Mounted Yeomen and Men-at-arms with technologies such as Warden, Banner Carriers, Expert Blacksmiths and Heavy Armour!
• Bring your knights to new levels of power with Blessed Blades and the Blessing of the Grail!
• Improve your economy with Sacred texts, Herbalists, Improved Mills and Bountiful Harvest!


[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1TRdIRcJ16AiXGx1YXbRzKiHPo3vfLKVK[/img]
[b]New Lord Skills:[/b]

• Fourteen new skills in total, some of which are unique to certain legendary lords.
• Six new skills available to all lords that follow three mutually exclusive trees: Noble Steward, Peasantry Commander and Noble Commander.
• Noble Steward and Bureaucrat skills improve the economy and work best when fielding mixed armies.
• Peasantry Commander and Logistician are ideal skills for leading large peasant rabbles to war.
• Noble Commander and Heroism are ideal skills for commanders that lead mighty hosts of knights from the front.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Sz2nmjOccZVsPq7Q8mmkVkEHsydY8OqJ[/img]
[b]FAQ[/b]
Q: Why are my units taking so long to recruit?
A: That's because you installed a mod called Immersive Bretonnia, its not being caused by this mod.

Q: Is this mod compatible with such and such mod?
A: If the mod alters vanilla Bretonnia units, buildings, effects or changes the peasant economy in any way, then you will likely experience issues. I don't plan to continue to support and create compatibility mods, you are free to make them yourselves for the mod combination you want to see.

2867500791.title: Cult of Pleasure mechanics for Morathi
2867500791.description:
[h1][b][u]What does this mod do[/u][/b][/h1]
This mod gives the faction Cult of Pleasure the Seductive Influence mechanic, a custom cult and a new custom hero. Seductive influence thresholds for the various races have been ~doubled to compensate for having more tools to influence a faction. You now also have the ability to subjugate and liberate as settlement occupation options.

Also check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878134329][b]Seductive Influence *all races[/b][/url] if you wish to expand the list of races Morathi can seduce and vassalise.

Summary:
[list][*]A unique type of cult settlement providing 4 building slots, with a discoverability system and dynamic building effects.
[*]82 different cult buildings, divided into 19 building chains
[*]A new cultist hero with 40 different skill keys + an inbuilt HP skill dump unlocked at level 50 for those who play with an extra skill points mod
[*]55 unit capped units from Slaanesh, Norsca, High Elves, Wood Elves, Empire, Cathay, Kislev and Bretonnia that can be unlocked via context specific cult buildings[/list]

[h1][b][u]Special credits[/u][/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2860203054]JFred's [u]Cultist of Slaanesh - Reborn[/u][/url] Some of the custom heroes are taken from his excellent mod.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790007728]Spartan VI's [u]Building Progression Icons III[/u][/url] A lot of the cult building icons are based on his art.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198306697989/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1142710][u]FortheEmperor[/u][/url] for being amazing at helping out with retexturing the elven horse fur.[/list]

[h1][b][u]My other mods[/u][/b][/h1]
[olist][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2851836469][u]Less Red more Art[/u] A mod the brings more art into the campaign UI alongside new main menu backgrounds with music[/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859601563]Looking for Vampire Coasts sea shanty and other background movies? [b][u]Menu Movies Expansion 1[/u][/b][/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859602670]Looking for the Ogre Chant and other background movies? [b][u]Menu Movies Expansion 2[/u][/b][/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878134329][b][u]Seductive Influence *all races[/u][/b] A mod the expands the number of seducible races[/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2879440728]Tired of all the vent pop ups? [b][u]Event Suppression[/u][/b] allows you to suppress event messages.[/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878065962][b][u]Katarin always win the supporter race[/u][/b] A mod that ensures Katarin always win the supporter race and confederate Walmart Rasputin[/url][/olist]

[h1][b][u]FAQ[/u][/b][/h1]
[b]Q:[/b] The buildings doesn't appear
[b]A:[/b] Certain mods like the UI improvement mod by Addan Deith edit the same file as this one. You can [b][u]put this mod at the top of the load order[/u][/b] to overwrite whatever mod causes the issue. Alternatively you can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789999718][u]Unique Faction UI mod by Müsliriegel[/u][/url] that incorporates the same changes as the UI improvement mod, but doesn't clash with this one.

[b]Q:[/b] Why is the seductive influence tracker above my own armies/settlements?
[b]A:[/b]It's a byproduct of Dark Elves being seducible, it have no practical effect on the campaign and I've yet to find a way to remove it from a specific faction.

[b]Q:[/b] Is it save game compatible?
[b]A:[/b] It's a one way street, you will probably be fine adding the mod to an ongoing campaign, but I wouldn't remove it from a campaign.

[b]Q:[/b] Does this mod support multiplayer?
[b]A:[/b] I don't know as I don't have anyone to test MP with. The game utilises a fair few scripts so it might cause desyncs. Give it a spin and report back if it doesn't work.

[h1][b][u]Future Plans[/u][/b][/h1]
Possibly implement garrisons for embassy buildings. It was originally a part of the plan for initial release, but it doesn't seem to be as straightforward as with normal buildings

[h1][b][u]Known bugs[/u][/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Building an embassy, removing the embassy and then rebuilding it after 5+ turns will remove the periodic diplomatic bonus. I'm not quite sure why this is a thing, but if you didn't read this you would probably never know about the bug so I don't consider the bug critical.[/olist]

2880515805.title: The Jade-Blooded Vampires: Curse of Nongchang (9.0 Update - BETA)
2880515805.description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/wshCxWb/Banner.png[/img]

[h1][b]Jade-Blooded Vampires - Eastern Lords of Undeath[/b][/h1] 

The Jade-Blooded Vampires are an exotic bloodline of vampires in the far east sired by a long-lost spawn of Neferata thousands of years after she and the rest of the original vampires had fled the destruction of Lahmia. 

Commanding fearsome hordes of both skeletal foot soldiers and ethereal monstrosities, the Jade-Blooded Vampires are an implacable force on the battlefield against armies that mostly rely on more conventional weaponry and lack reliable offensive magical powers. They also possess a unique [i]Lore of Magic[/i], [b] The Lore of the Jade-Blooded [/b], which is derivative of Nagash's own art of necromancy; supplanting the invocation of ancient dark arts from Nehekara with their own mystical rites from Grand Cathay. While lacking in offensive spells, the Lore of the Jade-Blooded boasts severely harmful curses as well as being able to conjure an army of ghosts from the Cathayan underworld. 

This mod introduces the Jade-Blooded vampires as a unique subculture and faction in Warhammer 3, as interpreted and imagined by yours truly. Games Workshop and Creative Assembly's version of the race will definitely be different once released at a future date.

[h1]New Faction: [b]The Curse of Nongchang[/b] [/h1]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/FhhpK8Y/mon-256.png[/img]

The playable faction introduced in this mod is the [b]Curse of Nongchang[/b]. 
While not the seat of power for the Jade-Bloods in Cathay, this faction was wholly based on my interpretation of the current vampiric corruption that has taken hold in the Nongchang Basin in the game, with my own personal touches, mostly inspired by asian horror movies. 

In case you're wondering why I chose to take this direction, it's so that it only lightly touches possible hard canon and lessens the risk of it getting invalidated in the future once GW decides to expand Cathay's lore. This way this faction exists as a minor, local power with minimal global effect.

[b]Faction Effects[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3sDHG6Z/faction-effects2.png[/img]

[b]Other features and mechanics[/b]


Unlike other undead factions, the Curse of Nongchang has a unique raise dead mechanic called [i]Summon Spirits[/i]. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/w0WQv7b/summon.png[/img]

The faction also has a unique encampment-style stance that spreads vampire corruption and allows access to global recruitment where the player can recruit the rest of the faction's stronger undead units.

The Curse of Nongchang has access to its own Rites mechanic.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6sJq92M/rites.png[/img]



[h1]Legendary Lord: [b]The Maiden of the Black Lotus[/b] [/h1]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/yFCkVg0/frontend.png[/img]

A figure of many folk tales and horrific tragedies, the [b]Maiden of the Black Lotus[/b], sometimes simply given the vague name of [b]Hei Lianhua[/b] by locals, is an accursed entity that haunts the Nongchang Basin. It parades itself using the lifeless corpse of a young maiden sacrificed at the Nongchang Pool of Purification in order to cleanse the riverlands of the great evil permeating across the land and amongst its people. However, the ritual ultimately failed as the condensed evil proved too great even for the grandmasters who attempted to exorcise it. 

Now it continues to corrupt and rot Nongchang from within just by existing alone. 

[b]Lord Effects[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tb0XV12/lord-effects.png[/img]

[b]Other Notes:[/b]

Hei Lianhua itself is not actually a jade-blooded vampire, but a marionette being puppeteered by a concentration of all the evils of Nongchang. Barely sentient, if at all, the maiden of the black lotus doesn't speak and in battle, it moves about in place by the dark forces reanimating it and is capable of blasting foes with jet-black energies. 

The maiden of the black lotus' design and general concept is inspired by the stringy-haired ghost girls of asian horror fame, especially J-horror. She also resembles a japanese ningyo doll.

[b]Unit Roster[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/p0Hv6hR/Roster.png[/img]

For the full unit details, please go [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2880515805/3461605794221925912/]here[/url]. 

***

For my other [b]Jade Vampires mod[/b], please check out
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3032432016][h1]Islanders of the Moon[/h1][/url]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/d2HfRkv/20230706000115-1.jpg[/img]

***

[h1]CREDITS:[/h1]
Thanks to [b]Xoudad[/b] for developing script used to implement the custom raise dead mechanic used in this mod.
Thanks to [b]Not So Skelly Bones[/b] for some of the amazing screenshots.
Thanks to [b]Ole[/b] for developing Asset Editor.
Thanks to [b]Mixu[/b] for developing his faction unlocker.
Thanks to [b] Zahel[/b] for his script used to hide the bloodline mechanic.

2881916371.title: Cultist Expansion: Pleasure Cultist +
2881916371.description:
[h3]The Pleasure Cultist joins the Cultist Expansion!  
Upgrades my [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821600897]Cultist of Pleasure Reskin[/url][/b] reskin-only mod with gameplay and lore features.  Warshrine reskin, new mount and summon, skill flavour update, and more, with a focus on Dark Elven theme.

Adds recruitment for Azazel, Sigvald, Malus, and, of course, Morathi.[/h3]

This is a submod, so you MUST install the original [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821600897]Cultist of Pleasure Reskin[/url][/b].  
Contains NO NUDITY.  Not even on statues.

[h2]New![/h2]
Pleasure Cultist + is now included in a combined mod collection entitled [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2984641517]Alshua's Cultists[/url][/b].  

[h1]Lore[/h1]
[quote][i]Even after the rise of Chaos, life on the island paradise of Ulthuan was idyllic for many elves.  Comfortable longevity begets great achievement, but so too can it beget boredom, intrigue, and a yearning for novelty.  Is it any wonder that a people so in love with beauty and mystery would begin to transgress, within the safe secrecy of their salons and parlours?  Is it any wonder that the shadow crept in?

Not even the inquisitorial Blademasters who hunted these Cults of Pleasure expected the legion that teemed beneath the rock they overturned.  In haste the Cult launched an uprising that was meant to play out more subtly, but even so, the High Elves scarcely survived it.  Ulthuan spat the treasonous elven faction and its Cults the way a prizefighter spits a bloodied tooth, and lacked the strength to pursue them into the cold north where they fled.

Under the scorched metal fist of their new King, Malekith, the newly-dubbed Dark Elves were no welcome sanctuary for the Cult of Pleasure, however.  Hedonism is a blade with no sheath, and though the Cultists professed loyalty, Malekith knew they would begin to gnaw away at his new society the way they had done on Ulthuan.  He brutally proscribed the Cults that had supported him, putting many of the leaders to death in the public and agonizingly slow fashion that would become synonymous with the fledgling culture of Naggaroth.  There was one suspected cult leader that he was unable to execute, however.

She was his mother, after all.

Hundreds of years later, Morathi remains, intolerable but untouchable.  Her power and charisma are so vital to Dark Elf society that Malekith's punishments and exiles can never last.  The Pleasure Cultists under her patronage are an open secret to all, and though Malekith never hesitates to break Morathi's toys where he can, their numbers have only increased over recent decades.  Worse yet, the grim agents of Khaine have begun to see signs of the Cult's influence over the Chaos-worshipping tribes of Men that share their snowy northern exile.  Is it Morathi's bidding they do, so far from her perfumed halls?

Or is it someone worse?
[/i][/quote]

[h1]Dark Elf Theme[/h1]
[h3]Cult of Pleasure Painshrine[/h3] Identical in stats, but almost completely reskinned in a Dark Elven style.
[h3]Dark Steed[/h3] A new mount option.  Chaos Steeds are so burly, and their armour is human-styled.  The Dark Steed both permits a loreful visual option, and also a new strategic option, sacrificing barding for speed.
[h3]Skill Text Adjustments[/h3] Renamed from Cultist of Slaanesh to "Pleasure Cultist."  Many skill texts and names have been fixed; they used to refer to the Cultist as a male daemon, rather than a female elf. 
[h3]Mix of Dark Elf and Slaanesh Traits[/h3]  Cultists will generate either a neutral, Dark Elf, or Slaaneshi trait regardless of what faction they serve.  Inappropriate traits such as the Dark Elf Khaine-worshipping trait have been removed from their pool.
[h3]Hates High Elves[/h3] Now you can decide whether you hate Khorne or High Elves more.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
This mod is different than my other three Cultists in that it adjusts the existing Cultist of Slaanesh.  So, you will only see one Cultist variant available for recruitment.  But they will be a lot more interesting and loreful, as well as recruitable by new factions.  The power level of the Cultist is essentially identical to vanilla, as the few gameplay-affecting features are all "horizontal": they provide equivalent new choices that are mutually exclusive with old ones.
[h3]Morathi Recruitment[/h3]Morathi already has a Pleasure Cult building, so she recruits her Cultists from there.  They share a unit cap with Death Hags, so balance is not a significant issue.  As Dark Elves do not build cult buildings in enemy towns, Morathi's Pleasure Cultists instead damage enemy buildings, chosen because it is the subtlest Agent action available.
[h3](new!) Malus Darkblade Recruitment[/h3]Malus can recruit Pleasure Cultists anywhere (again with the Death Hag unit cap), but only when his Tz'arkan possession levels are high.  Their corruption is undesirable to him, but as a tradeoff, they help counteract the attrition it causes.
[h3]Azazel and Sigvald Recruitment[/h3]The Slaanesh-sworn Warriors of Chaos Lords recruit their cultists from the vassal tribute building, which means they will tend to recruit fewer of them than other factions.  I do not think they will create a balance splash in such a powerful faction, but at any rate, lore-wise giving them Cultist access feels almost mandatory.
[h3]Furies of Slaanesh Summon Option[/h3] In terms of game design, Summons are ideal for cool units that are hard to actually justify having in your army.  A lack of initial cooldown and the utility of pulling a flying unit from nowhere make them a fun strategic choice versus the more combat-focused Daemonettes.

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[b]Can Slaanesh still get a second Cultist Hero in the future?[/b]
It's kind of unfair that Slaanesh still just has one Cultist, right?  What may the future hold?

[b]Is it compatible with...?[/b]

2887139566.title: High Elves Tech-Tree
2887139566.description:
[h1]What does this mod do? [/h1] 
The mod adds over 70 new technologies and new Unit-Abilities and some more... to the High Elves Tech-Tree.


[h1]DESCRIPTION [/h1] 
Completely technologies with new effects have been added to the vanilla tech-tree.
New technology-tab were created (see pictures)
With many new Tech-Groups (Infantry, Cavalry, Monsters&Beast, Heroes and lords, Outpsot Units, Resistance, Banners ect) See Pictures.
As already mentioned new abilities and attributes were added.
Improvements have been added for economy and, of course, for the units.
Regiments of Renown geht upgrades too and get an increase capacity (+2 per unit).


[b] Abilities: [/b]
Add Ability: "Blessing of Elders" for most of the High Elve Infantry-units. 
(The Ability has only 3 stages)
Add Ability: "Elf Eye" for ranged Units (Eagle Claw too). .
Add Ability: "Alarielle's Shining" for Cavalery Units.
Add Ability: "Ithilmars' Power" for Dragons, Phönix ect.
(Perfect Vitality is to OP and muste be delated, reduced.)


[b]Banners: [/b]
Research these Technolgioes to get some epic-Banners.
The Banners will improve the hole army and can only bee used for Generals (Commanders).
Muffs for Missile Dmg, Puffs for spear Unit, for a Spear Army.

[b] Resistance: [/b]
Contains resistances for all units. (Physical-, Missile-, Magic-, and Fatigue Resistance)
As upkeep and recruitment costs are reduced in the mod tech-tree, small negative effects must be accepted for the technologies. (See pictures)

[b]Outpsot Units: [/b]
Improvements for Outpost Units.
Just like in my other tech trees (like the Empire Tech-Tree)

For a rough overview, please take a look at the images.


[b] Does it take forever to explore the tree now? [/b]
NO, if you want, you can research faster by quickly researching the technologis at the Tech-Group Developments to increase research speed ("Urathions Book","Urathions Decryption" and "Enlightenment") in the bottom of the end of the mod tech-tree.


[h1]Compatibility: [/h1]
The vanilla technologies have not been changed. Thus, the mod is compatible with all mod that does not create new technologies. Mods that, for example, only change the vanilla effects or add more effects (and no technologies) will work. 
The mod very rarely needs an update, because CA rarely changes anything in the technologies. (I'm not aware of any case so far.) Nevertheless, I will of course try to keep the mod always up to date.
But remember... technology mods almost never need an update.
The hole Tech uses CA-Unit Sets, therefore, custom/mod units should benefit from the technologies. 

[h1] Plans for the mod: [/h1]


[h1] Final word: [/h1]

I wish you a lot of fun with the mod. 


You can find more mods here:
https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198043919449/myworkshopfiles/

2890499031.title: Godslayer Overhaul by Mortrau
2890499031.description:
[h1]INTRO[/h1]
Hi everyone! This is the Godslayer aka Daniel overhaul. I was disappointed when he was introduced, because he looks like some kind of filler for future work. I didn’t want to wait, so decided to make Godslayer interesting to play. My main goal was to achieve an RPG-feeling during walkthrough.
 
Here is a list of major features of this mod.
___

[h1]CAMPAIGN OVERHAUL[/h1]
___

[h2]CHAOS UNDIVIDED CITIES[/h2]
Now you can dedicate your cities to Chaos Undivided. Yes, this is a new 5th choice introduced in 4.0, at last.

[h2]DAEMONIC AND MORTAL CITIES[/h2] 
Another 4.0 major change: [b]monogod[/b] cities now have 2 variants - for daemons (default) and for mortals. For second option you can rebuild capital sturcture and change city type or just capture t2+ settlements, they can be already built for mortals. So now you have [b]access to full chaotic roster[/b], but need to plan carefully what exactly to build in certain situations. Undivided cities are always for mortals (they do not have daemon units except base furies).

[h2]HORDE MECHANIC FOR GODSLAYER[/h2] 
Faction leader have access to horde buildings with full daemonic roster. It helps with early game economy. This allows you to change your gameplay from turn 1 drastically using [b]rifts[/b].

[h2]UNHOLY MANIFESTATIONS[/h2]
The most interesting part here is tzeentchian manifestation that allows you to make rifts (like Be'lakor) and travel around the world. You can get free uses of them by defeating daemonic armies. And your starting settlement is controlled by the tzeentchian forces, so you can get your first free rift at turn 1. With horde mechanic it allows you to start playing almost anywhere you wish. I added some new rifts here and there for this purpose. Need to mention one minor change - Khorne and Nurgle manifestations were buffed a little.

[h2]RAZE AND ADVANCE[/h2]
All lords have access to "raze and advance" occupation option similar to beastmen one. Legion of Chaos is here for ruination and mortal souls. Yes, for razing settlements of mortals you can get [b]souls[/b].

[h2]SOULS[/h2]
New resource. Godslayer's armies gain souls for slaying [b]mortal[/b] units (daemons do not have souls!). You need them to upgrade horde buildings and for your final [b]dedication[/b] (4.0 change). So do not spend too much time fighting other daemons, your goal is to ruin mortal realm after all.

[h2]CHANGED ROSTER[/h2]
Technically you can get access to almost all units of chaotic roster. But firstly you need to unlock them via glory. So your starting army could be unreplacable for a while. All daemons are available in horde buildings and for undivided dedication line. All dedication lines have some exclusive high tier mortal units including chosen. But last guys can be also obtained by [b]warband upgrade[/b] mechanic.

[h2]WARBAND UPGRADE MECHANIC[/h2]
Allows you to upgrade some of your experienced units to higher tier units of same type (for example chaos warriors to chosen). Or change weapon type regardless of exp. Also this is the only way to get [b]aspiring champions[/b].

[h2]MORTAL LORDS AND HEROES[/h2]
Mortal chaos lords and some heroes are available for recruiting. Heroes can be unlocked via glory. Lords can ascend to Daemon Princes.
[b]WARNING![/b] For new mortal heroes you will need [b]Mixer mod![/b]

[h2]TECH TREE REWORK[/h2]
Godslayer's "tech tree" is a mix of his own skills and glory boons. So they were fully reworked and standartized. 

[h2]LONGER PROGRESS[/h2]
You need more daemonic glory points to complete your way to dedications compared to vanilla. It allows to add more items and make them usable a bit longer before obsoleting.

[h2]DIPLOMACY CHANGES[/h2]
-30 debuff for relations with WoC factions. You are here to challenge Be’lakor and Archaon, ruin this world and claim godhood. Some item sets could also affect your diplomatic standings.
___

[h1]BODY PARTS OVERHAUL[/h1]
___

All vanilla parts were remade and rebalanced, dozens of new abilites, items and item sets were added (look for brand new ones introduced in 4.0!). Because of overlapping items in different sets it could be not so easy to find all of them in UI. Old-school pixelhunting skills could help. But the main part of this overhaul (and a most weighted one) is a [b]visual redesign[/b] (you can check it at screenshots). Most of new items have fully unique designs, also tons of minor changes here: handles, aligning and resizes for shields; aligning grip for 2-handers (still weird models of swords with huge handle but it is because of vanilla animation that I can’t change due to lack of skill); rid of identical or almost identical designs; rid of horribly ugly designs; all unique designs from Mirror of Madness were used in one way or another. I do not have best skills in making portholes and icons for daemon parts combinations, so there could be minor visual issues I guess.
___

[h1] KNOWN ISSUES & BUG REPORTING [/h1]
Please check special thread for this below.
[b]WARNING![/b] For this mod to work you now need to use the [b]Mixer mod[/b]: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660.
___

[h1]COMPATIBILITY[/h1]
Since mod at last does not have any datacored tables I do not know what to expect from using global overhauls - feel free to investigate this. It should be compatible with skill overhauls and roster mods, but I don't know what behavior to expect (depends on mod load priority I guess). Visual mods that do not affect Daniel are fully compatible I guess.

Victory Conditions Overhaul (VCO) is fully compatible. Also I guess Hecleas Grand Strategy too (at least if you play as the Godslayer), because it is still vanilla faction, not a custom one.   

[b]4.0 version of mod is not save compatible with old versions![/b]

I highly recommend to use Marthenil's Daniel painter mod (my screenshots were made with it): https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2800411

2891886534.title: Better Alliance - Foreign Agents
2891886534.description:
[h2]Updated to 9.0[/h2]
This mod enables foreign agent recruiting from ally or vassal, via the outpost. Works for both player and AI, new or save-game. (availability vary due to hardcoded agent type) 

Allied lord generation is in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790029103/]Better Alliance[/url].


[h1]How to recruit foreign agents:[/h1]
1. Establish an alliance or vassal.

2. After the ally builds an outpost, their generic agents are recruitable in that province. 

3. Each outpost raises agent cap by one.

4. The recruited agents stay with you even if alliance is later broken.

5. Your outpost at ally province also provides all your agents to them.

See screenshots for examples. Only major playable factions can access this feature, and only vanilla agents.

If you play minor factions via Mixu unlocker, or would like to add modded agent to any race, see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2891886534/6620894968758314054/]this tutorial[/url] on how to enable the agents to any faction.


[h1]Additional Notes on Agents:[/h1]
1. Not all agents are recruit-able to each faction. CA hardcoded agent types, e.g., factions already having male wizard cannot get female wizard. There is still a large enough agent pool for every faction.

2. Agents given by mission rewards is randomized. For example, Empire's initial mission reward gives a wizard, but instead of Empire wizard, you may get Elf wizard or Chaos sorcerer or another wizard.

3. Minor tweaks to allow cross-race recruiting: Ice maiden is enabled to foreign faction without background training (Kislev still have access to trained ice maiden); high-elf background now require 0 influence (otherwise it is all bad background as foreign agent); Daemon prince's outpost does not provide agent as it overlaps other factions.


[h1]Related Mods[/h1]
-- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2790029103]Better Alliance[/url]: prevents alliance breaking & universal elite skills & generic allied lords. 
-- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2843411818]All diplomatic option[/url]: not all factions can be allied due to race affinity. This mod allows any faction to vassal / liberate, so getting access to foreign agents is easier.
-- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853038542]Bretonnia auto-vow mod[/url]: Bretonnia paladin cannot get vow interface as foreign agents. This mod ensures they can get vows based on level.
-- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888171970]Variant Selector[/url]: If any agent arts mismatch, uses this to fix it on character screen.


[h1]Known Issue:[/h1]
There is reported conflict with Recruitment Pool Refresh, More Trait Choices (turn 1 ctd), and Radious.

Some undead agents are disabled for now, like liche priest / Lahmian vampire. Looks like some db interactions related to Nagash's mechanism, causing them to not be use-able. 


[h1]Misc: [/h1]
I don't always check Steam comments. For time-sensitive request, please contact me on discord, either via modding den or my own [url=https://discord.gg/NU5t9CK8eF]channel[/url].

And I always welcome [url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=WHEF2PNWVCQD4]a cup of coffee[/url] for the works.

LATEST BLOG POSTS: 
[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/teb-gone-camping-123298189]ON CAMPS[/url] ----- [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/teb-pork-lion-124921911]ON PIGS AND LIONS[/url] ----- [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/teb-buffening-123446092]ON BALANCE[/url]

[h2]Sorry, I will not be reading comments, as I got exhausted by those people who make no effort whatsoever to read the compatibility paragraph, troubleshoot their mod list, or consider/provide any kind of context, misleading others in the process and frankly disrespecting my free time.
 
Comments are not disabled to allow the pinned discussions.

If you want to communicate effectively, you're more than welcome to the [url=https://discord.gg/moddingden]Modding Den Discord Server[/url] where you can usually find me and helpful people![/h2] 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzZVrgtp/9Z6NC2T.png[/img]
[h1]WHO TEB?[/h1]
TEB stands for Tilea+Estalia+Border Princes, from their subculture in database and from when I didn't yet work on New World Colonies too. Anyway, TEB is a mod that has been overhauling these factions since what, 2016? Damn. The entire group is made of complete placeholders in the vanilla game, and here we flesh them out. With what? Here:

[h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1]
[h2]- Tilea, Estalia, Border Princes and New World Colonies made into a new culture with 4 subgroups and a total of 8 new factions, and as many starting locations, with their own new flags.
- 10 Legendary Lords and 1 Legendary Hero, from Borgio the Besieger to Gashnag the Black Prince to Piggolo II. 4 of these LLs being OC who developed their own personas through player campaigns. Most of them are starting LLs whether in IME or TOW (the modded campaign map).
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J0q5rcw6/N4PAQWY.png[/img]
- 5 generic Lords, 3 Heroes.
- More than 30 new units, spread and divided across the four rosters, only some units being shared.
- A bunch of Regiments of Renown, from the Alcatani Fellowship to Birdmen of Catrazza to Asarnil the Dragonlord.
- Another bunch of Regiments of Community, shaped from my players' campaign stories akin to some LLs.
- New name lists for Estalia and mixed Tilean+Estalian for NWC.
- New tech tree built from scratch, with variations for each subgroup.
- New building trees, with recruitment trees differing between subgroups, and some landmarks.
- Plutocracy mechanic.
- Mercenary camps.
[/h2]

Uhh, probably more stuff. I think it's important to know that as old as this mod is in concept, I had/chose to completely redo a bunch of stuff for WH3. SO MUCH has changed. [url=https://www.patreon.com/CataphTW]You can read quite a few design notes in the blog.[/url]

Note that this is not supposed to be a Dogs of War package. Many of those regiments happen to be in here because they fit, and not because they're in charge. The four rosters have some differences, but all of them do rely on units that are, lorewise, mostly mercs and with strong features favouring high-xp units.

And since the lore on these groups is fairly limited and never really updated, I had to add a healthy dose of OC, either to completely make up stuff or to expand on what little was there.

Oh, one more thing. [u][b]Due to WH3 limitations for the skirmish panel, enable army caps to be encouraged towards which units are roster-specific. E.g., Shieldbearers are Border Princes-specific.[/b][/u]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2927296206/3826414483639772131/]Go here for a list. Not the best, I know.[/url]

[h1]USE AND COMPATIBILITY[/h1]
- Always enable Mixer in any campaign with this. Mixer not needed for skirmishes.
- Not for Realms of Chaos. Works with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3081800026]The Old World[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3365380014]TOW classic[/url].
- MP is fine if you don't overload the list. Try it and see.
- [url=https://tw-modding.com/index.php/Troubleshooting]BEFORE you report issues, follow the troubleshooting guide[/url]. Who am I kidding, you're not even reading this.

- [u]Don't use with overhauls without submods[/u], [url=https://tw-modding.com/index.php/Tutorial:Submodding]and don't ask me to make them[/url]. If you are using an overhaul's submod, don't report balance issues to me. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2927296206/3763355849151124694/]Look in here for some known submods[/url].
- Supports [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789896406]TTC[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2888171970]Variant Selector[/url].
- Supported by Alshua's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2868273452]Favoured Regiments[/url] and Smokin's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2854819509]Recruit Defeated LLs[/url].
- Currently usable with Less Red more Art [url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/373754902608084994/1074364849695506432/image.png]ONLY IF YOU DISABLE THIS[/url].
- If you use All Diplomatic Options within IME/IMEE to liberate stuff, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789983784]GET THIS[/url].
- Dead Baron's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3237873696]texture project[/url] is good, but NOT its version with models! 
- Missing or glitched heads and stuff like that, go through your reskins. GunKing's Vermintide 2 Cosmetics Reskin is for example reportedly not compatible as of sept. '25.

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

2931087074.title: Heroes of Legend: Lords of Time Update
2931087074.description:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
This mod adds [b]35 new characters[/b] to various factions and [b]11 playable factions (3 in IE and 8 in TOW)[/b]. Most characters are recruited through landmarks added in my other mod, [b]Landmarks of Legend[/b], which is why it's a requirement (I elaborate a bit more on this in the FAQ section).

These characters can also be recruited by the AI and it's implemented through a neat system scripted by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/scehr/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1142710]scehr[/url]. The AI can recruit these characters under the following condition: the Player must be a faction that CANNOT recruit the character in question. This means that, the AI will not be able to recruit the LL/LH (even if the landmark is built) when the Player is a faction that can also recruit that character. However, If the Player isn't doing this, then, whichever AI faction constructs the landmarks first will recruit the character.


[h1]Features[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2931087074/3763356482608830927/]List of Playable Factions, Mechanics, Characters and Units can be found here[/url], along with how to recruit them.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8S1ogYX.png[/img]
[b][u]Playable Factions:[/u][/b]
- Principality of Luccini (led by [b]Lorenzo Lupo[/b]) starts in control of Luccini and has access to unique and thematic mechanics including a custom tech tree, bribery, landmarks and characters. This faction is functional but will recieve more content later. [REQUIRES CATAPH'S TEB TO PLAY]

- Broken Wheel (led by [b]Sheerargetru[/b]) starts at the Black Rock in the Northern Chaos Wastes with a narrative campaign focussing on the downfall of the Empire through cults, schemes, and betrayals.

- Wardens of the Living Pools (led by [b]Lord Xlotc[/b]) starts in control of the Sacred Pools and a formidable force of the blessed, ready to defend their holy Pools from those that would defile it.

- Clan Durazgrund (led by [b]Prince Ulther Stonehammer[/b]) starts in the Kislev Foothills with its champion, Borri Forkbeard, and the Dragon Company, ready retake Karak Ungor from filthy Greenskins and finally fulfill his promise. (ONLY in TOW FOR NOW)

- High Realm of Arranoc (led by [b]Amadri Ironbark[/b]) starts in Tal Esth with a mixed host of Tree Spirits and Asrai, defending against the expansionist tyrant, Viscount Augustine de Chegney. (ONLY in TOW)

- High Realm of Atylwyth (led by [b]Sceolan of the Hooked Blade[/b]) starts in Tal Amere with Eternal Guard legions leading an assualt out of the safety of their forest to combat Greenskin raiders. (ONLY in TOW)

- Children of Doom (led by [b]Be'la'krothrogor[/b]) starts at the Suiddock in Marienburg, eager to dismatle the Empire's false God and enlighten the feeble men with Grandfather's wisdom. (ONLY in TOW FOR NOW)

- Viscountcy de Chegney (led by [b]Augustine de Chegney[/b]) starts in control of Chegney and the newly-acquired Imperial fort of Schloss Drakenburg. (ONLY in TOW)

- High Realm of Cavaroc (led by [b]Edrael of Equos[/b]) starts in the Halls of Equos, poised to march against the greedy Dukes of Bretonnia. (ONLY in TOW)

- Spirits of Sussurrio (led by [b]Elatior the Enchanter[/b]) starts far from Athel Loren and the Silvam Dale after Elatior's exile. (ONLY in TOW)

- Soulbane Witch-Cabal (led by [b]Urak Soulbane[/b]) starts at the Twisted Pillars, fleeing from Zanbaijin with Tamurkhan in close pursuit. (ONLY in TOW)

[b][u]Other Recruitable Characters:[/u][/b]
[b]LL:[/b] [Emperor Wilhelm I, Matthias Volker, Crown-Prince Wolfgang Holswig-Abanauer, The New Emperor, Hothar the Fey]

[b]LH:[/b] [Hermit Knight of Malmont, Simaergul, Bannaga, Helmut von Carstein, Gorgivich Krakvald, Gunther von Grecht, Viscount d'Alembençon, Agravain de Beau Quest, Balkrag Grimgorson, Brunner the Bounty Hunter, Shi-Hong, The Black Crowe, The Black Mask, Elasir, Anurion the Green, Urial the Forsaken, Sabine Flamius, Orsini Sardus]

[h1]OTHER FEATURES[/h1]
- Custom settlement skins for: Luccini and the Sacred Pools
- Campaign map props/prefabs tied to character landmarks or lore at the following regions: Luccini, Tralinia, Wydrioth, Salzenmund and Tobaro
- Some units, lords, heroes and landmarks are exclusive to factions added in this mod


[h1]TO-DO[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2931087074/3763356482608850375/]List of Planned Characters can be found here.[/url]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
- No campaign animations for Brunner when his other weapons are equipped
- Some MCT options aren't working at the moment


[h1]FAQ[/h1]
Why is Landmarks of Legend required?
- Originally, these characters were going to be added to Landmarks of Legend, during the early periods of both this mod and LoL, but I decided against it for two main reasons: 1) This is out of the scope of LoL,  2) The whole packfile would become very messy and a hassle to update. So, I split this into its own companion mod and kept it dependent on LoL, as a good chunk of landmarks/units required for some of these characters are already in that mod.

Is this compatible with SFO?
- Don't know, I don't use SFO.

Is this compatible with Cataph's Southern Realms and his version of Lorenzo Lupo?
- Yes. In IE, Cataph's Lorenzo will be disabled in the Plutocracy mechanic and, in his place, the Guild Assassin generic hero from this mod will be present for all TEB factions. In TOW/TOWC, Both mods' Lorenzo Lupo  will be present and at war with each other. May the best [strike]Ro[/strike]man win!

Do I need to start a new game?
- Yes, you will need a new game for most characters/factions to work properly

Is this compatible with the map mods (IEE, TOW, TOWC etc.)?
- Yes

Can you make the TOW factions playable in IE?
- No, that would require new factions added to IE, whereas, TOW already has those factions which our characters are simply put in control of. Also, there is no lore-friendly locat

2978779730.title: DeepWar AI
2978779730.description:
[h1]NEWS:[/h1]

Improved the occupation logic for all factions. See changelog for details.

10/30/26

--

Please stop asking me about the AI breaking mid campaign. Vanilla bug from years back, CA cannot or will not fix, however, there is a sludgehammer you can take to the AI to get it moving again, without completely ruining the campaign.

See more: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2978779730/688619956215079572/

1/5/2026

[h1]Description[/h1]
DeepWar AI attempts to be the most comprehensive, best campaign AI on the workshop, directly inserting a Tzeentchian demon into the vanilla AI to fix its base flaws. Unlike other AI overhauls, DeepWar does not break any AI's or factions, and all AI's play intelligently from start to finish. DeepWar makes the AI much smarter by redesigning certain priorities and budgets, improving agent logic, increasing aggression, decreasing passivity, but not destroying the unique personalities of various factions.

Dwarves act like vengeful and defensive Dwarves, Dark Elves are ruthless, Vampires are cunning and opportunistic, Wood Eves care little about the world, Skaven are craven, Demons are insane, High Elves are imperial, Norsca are bloodthirsty, and Humans are trying to keep order in a hopeless world.

Other AI mods take a sledgehammer to the base AI, DeepWar uses a warpfire scalpel to carefully and surgically fix Camapign AI logic for each personality. This mod does NOT touch battle AI.

DeepWar will greatly increase the difficulty of your game, but not by cheating or with anti-player bias. All bias and AI cheats are removed, except on legendary difficulty which has a +20% anti-player bias, but because the AI is far more aggressive and intelligent with their money, you'll be under more attacks as you increase in strength rank.

If you still need more challenge, find mods that reduce AI upkeep, or mods that give the AI big handicaps.

[h1]COMPATIBILITY[/h1]
PUT THIS MOD AT OR NEAR THE TOP OF LOAD ORDER

Compatible with anything except other campaign AI mods, however, DeepWar doesn't touch recruitment mechanics so custom recruitment mods work fine (provided of course, the mod actually works). Nowadays, a lot of mods are messing with AI variables, so if you want to ensure DeepWar has priority, make sure DeepWar is at or near the top of your load order.

Is this mod Multiplayer safe? It should be but MP is an arcane science. DeepWar uses no scripts and touches variables unused by 99% of mods, so it is highly unlikely to cause MP issues. For those who try MP, let me know how it goes!

This is save compatible, however, the earlier this mod is active the bigger difference you will see (i.e. from turn 1).

Compatible with the Old World Mod, but, as stated, put Deep War at the top of the load order.

[h1]Details[/h1]
- General
-- Aggression levels increased tremendously, but adjusted depending on personality.
-- Personalities are major in DeepWar and are much more pronounced than in Vanilla.
--- All transgressions, such as trespassing penalties, are automatically adjusted (less punishing for friends, and vice versa) because Aggression levels directly impact how transgressions of all kinds are viewed by different personalities.
-- AI recruits bigger armies but not so big their early game is harmed, will recruit full stacks no problem after turn 20.
-- AI will group up more, but not if there are easy targets for single armies.
-- No Anti-player bias (this is for Campaign AI only, Battle AI is separate and not touched by this mod).
-- Minor Factions less passive, will attack if opportunity presents itself.
-- AI movement logic should respect the player's threat (i.e. won't move into your targeting range even if you aren't at war with them).
-- Empires expand more carefully and won't stray too far from friendly territory.
-- Weak factions are picked off faster.
-- Increased amount of total calculations per round so AI makes better choices.
-- Default AI spends 64% on military, 30% on buildings, 5% on agents, 1% on diplomacy.
--- These percentages vary significantly depending on personality.
--- All personalities now have customized savings pools that store up money for various buildings or expensive units, which is completely unused in vanilla or any other AI mod, and properly used allows AI to spend more on military without hurting their building progression.
-- All AI is much smarter about picking fights they can win, i.e. within 15% of their power range. This makes forever sieges far less likely.
-- AI considers the threat of the player more seriously

- Occupation Decision Improvements
-- Less random occupation decision making, 95% of AI will take the best option every time.
-- Factions that do not benefit from razing will not (i.e. Bretonnia)
-- Chorfs always build their capital Towers
-- Vassalization is considered seriously if it is an option

- Agent AI
-- Agent logic improved to look across provinces and not just regions. With more agents in the field, ambushes are tougher.
-- Agents actively scout for ambushes:
[url=https://ibb.co/10xbRJN][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZfCNc1r/20230601201535-1.jpg[/img][/url]
-- AI will remember ambush spots for longer, up from 10 turns to 20 turns.
--- AI Hordes no longer limited to one agent per 6 hordes


[h1]Support[/h1]
If you'd like to support my work, you can tip or donate to me here: [url=paypal.me/DavidESamra]PayPal[/url]

2989226363.title: Roar of the Jade Sea : Yin-Yin, the Sea Dragon
2989226363.description:
[i]The Sea Dragon of Cathay has returned![/i]

[b][h1]The Eastern Provinces[/h1][/b] - NEW playable Cathay Faction

[b]*[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2859968660]MIXER[/url] required to install this mod!!*[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QbQFt6s/mon-256.png[/img]

-[i]How they play[/i]-

Outside their faction effects as well as the lord army buff from Yin-Yin herself, the Eastern Provinces offer a more challenging start than your usual faction.

Immediately on turn 1, the player will be facing two dilemmas:

Yin-Yin has found herself stranded in Lustria, near the temple cities of Xlanhuapec, flanked by all sorts of monstrous beasts sent by the Lizardmen. Yin-Yin's remaining troops will be in for the fight of their lives to survive these initial stages.

There are four lizardmen factions to watch out during your stay in Lustria:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9N4gX8B/lzd-factions.png[/img]
Xlanhuapec, your initial foe, is the most desperate in trying to remove you from Lustria as Slann Lord Huinitenuchli himself had summoned 2 great dinosaurs from the depths of the jungle. 
The remaining other three lizardmen temple cities each boast their own great dinosaur prowling their lands so should Yin-Yin decide to venture further deep into the jungles, she and her army must be on their guard. 

Meanwhile back home in Cathay, Yin-Yin's appointed administrator of the realm, Yin-Tuan, was tasked in retaking the port city of Fu-Chow  along with the help of a small force of elite troops from the Celestial Loyalists, but their forces are engaged by a massive fleet of pirates led by the infamous pirate queen Zheng Shih. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/drgXYHG/prt-faction.png[/img]

Zheng Shih and her Nipponese pirate lords are a formidable presence in Yin-Yin's campaign, and one that the player should expect for a really brutal fight, as they come with their own unique variety of pirates, raiders and warriors hailing from all over the Jade Sea. 
To make matters worse, there are rumors of [i]Kaiju[/i], titanic creatures from the ocean depths, being spotted all over the coast. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KFrWM5x/kaijuteaser.png[/img]

It has now become apparent that the Sea Dragon doesn't have the luxury of men nor resources to take on two fronts at the same time. For the player, it will be quite a challenge to maintain Yin-Yin's expedition and escape from Lustria while also fighting off the mighty Jade Sea pirates from Cathay's shores.

Sacrifices will be made if Yin-Yin's eastern dominion were to last.

***

[b]Yin-Yin, The Sea Dragon[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/42PvTM9/yinyinbanner.png[/img]

Yin-Yin is a caster Legendary Lord and uses majestic water elemental powers in battle. On top of that, she of course has a dragon transformation ability much like her siblings.

While Yin-Yin is versatile and powerful by herself, even considering her dragon form, her real strength is without a doubt through her ultimate ability, which you can unlock by Lv22, [b]Queen of the Jade Sea [/b]. 
As mentioned above, this ability summons a special unit, her very own flagship, into battle.

[b]The Golden Heron[/b]

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AstonishingWellgroomedCamel-size_restricted.gif[/img]

The Golden Heron is a mechanical wonder and a flying behemoth capable of raining destruction upon everything in its path. As something befitting its captain, the Golden Heron operates like a fully functioning battleship that's armed with no less than 4 different guns, each for dealing with a specific type of enemy. It has a single shot firing cannon for single targets, a rocket launcher that can set enemy blobs aflame, a powerful main gun that shoots clusters of cannon balls that can tear through several enemy ranks with deadly force, and broadside cannons each on its port and starboard sides for dealing with enemies on the ship's flanks. 

However, despite this immense power, the Golden Heron is also a complicated beast that needs be used carefully especially in the presence of many artillery or high AP ranged units because it has 3 unique damaged state phases that could spell doom for the unit very quickly if left unchecked.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/grsX7FL/herondamage.png[/img]

In exchange, the crew of the Golden Heron have access to 2 charges of the "Damage Control" ability, which tries to repair the ship and prevent the ship's hull damage status from progressing into a severe state.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vXzsnDc/damagecontrol.png[/img]

[b]Destruction[/b]
But should salvage of the ship be deemed impossible, the Golden Heron will explode into a bright ball of fire, spewing flaming debris around and underneath its wreckage; so if the ship is about to go down, it would be wise to evacuate nearby units to not get caught up in the explosion. Likewise, it would be ideal to send the ship into enemy lines so that it may bring them down with her.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/VioletActualCowbird-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Finally, the player can later on further improve the Golden Heron and decide to select 1 of 3 very powerful upgraded versions upon reaching Rank 35*. 

[list]
[*]Golden Heron Mk-II adds more armor and a new rocket battery with homing missiles.
[*]Zhuque exchanges the warship's standard guns for extremely potent flamer ordnance.
[*]The Beidou, by a wide margin, is perhaps one of Cathay's technological marvels. Its dazzling arsenal is a sight to behold.
[/list]

[i]*Note - These versions are super powerful end-game units and not in anyway meant to be balanced around that part of the Campaign. It's okay if you think they are super OP. [/i]

[h1]Warriors of the Jade Sea[/h1]
You can view the full unit list and detail here: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2989226363/3816285189351209833/]Warriors of the Jade Sea Unit List [/url]

Centuries ago Xian returned to Cathay with vials of Neferatas blood after making a pact with the Lahmian Queen, in the midst of a civil war he all but disappeared... until now. At the head of an undead host and with the aid of his cadre of powerful Necromancers and Dark Magicians known as the "Tribunal of Night" Xian Ha Feng, now known as Yuwei Ha Feng, is raising the sleeping armies of long forgotten dynasties in order to dominate Cathay in the name of Harakhte.

Q: Will you make this mod compatible with X-Y-Z/make a sub mod for X-Y-Z?

A: No, this is the most annoying request for modders, please DO NOT ask for this, there are plenty of people who only do submods, please ask them. 

-

A: Please uncheck and check all of your mods, if this mod works alone then it isn't crashing your game it is conflicting with another mod editing the same tables. 2996698889.title: ATC 艾克的桌面数据大修 Arksaitace‘s Tabletop Codex Overhaul
2996698889.description:
ATC 艾克的桌面数据大修 Arksaitace‘s Tabletop Codex Overhaul

！！！【注】：本mod并非一个平衡向mod，而是一个基于军书数据的大修mod，所以在本mod中，有些领主，兵种的数据可能会十分的抽象。大家在游玩中有不适感觉时，请理解。本mod只是给玩家另一种选择，希望大家玩的愉快。

本mod是以桌面数据为参考，对全派系，全兵种，进行的一个全方位大修。具体问题可以在讨论贴留言

本mod目前已经总体完结，之后的更新也是在微调技能数值，建筑收入加成，适配dlc等方面。目前完工的内容有：全派系所有人物与兵种的数据调整；所有技能的调整，并新加了近百个技能；全派系红线调整；全兵种招募费与维护费的调整；巴托尼亚，恐虐，古墓王，基斯里夫，食人魔，矮人的战役调整；全部魔法的调整。


本mod核心是为了让玩家体验另一种战锤全战。强调兵种之间的配合，让玩家体验真正的全面战争，并且以改善玩家游玩体验为目标，不会去教玩家如何玩游戏；鼓励玩家寻找自己喜欢的玩法，让各个兵种都有存在的意义，上场的空间。

步兵为常规意义上的绝对主力，战斗力与价格的完美结合
骑兵为主要突击力量，高级骑兵的冲锋不可小觑
怪兽步兵之间虽然战斗力可能略有差距，但是大多物美价廉，同时输出也比较不错，且不是特别畏惧火炮
巨兽单位虽然普遍十分昂贵，但是不惧弓弩箭矢，近战输出极为可观
远程单位各有不同，虽然缺乏爆发性的输出能力，但是胜在持久
火炮单位堪称战场之王，终极的大杀器，直射类火炮对于巨兽是致命的威胁；抛射类机器对于步兵来说堪称毁天灭地（如果没有躲炮的话）

各个派系直接现在也有自己独特的特色了
混沌，高精堪称近战之王；矮人虽然不太灵活，闪避不便，但是坚如磐石；帝国以火炮立足，辅以钢铁，信仰；震旦步射空骑的立体作战；巴托骑士一骑绝尘；食人魔刚猛强悍；吸血鬼有独特的战斗方式，等等特色，请大家自行品尝

2998525410.title: Local Recruitment for Warriors of Chaos
2998525410.description:
*A word of caution for both players and modders alike*
This mod is based on an old form of recruitment for WoC that should be deprecated but was simply disabled and hidden instead.
There's the concrete possibility that CA could completely remove or break this feature with future updates related to WoC: in that specific scenario I will NOT be able to fix this mod.
You have been advised.

*Please consult the Known Issues and QA sections before commenting, thanks.*

This mod restores the Local Recruitment option for WoC (Warriors of Chaos) [EXCEPT for Glottkin, the mod doesn't work with him for some reason™], you'll be now able to recruit the vanilla WoC roster directly from the Dark Fortress' building chains.
Do note that this mod also allows this type of recruitment for custom WoC units: if you are a modder and want to use this method for your mod just follow this quick guide https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2998525410/3805027864674661182/
In fact: I mainly made this mod just to have a reliable way to put my custom WoC units in campaign without cluttering the Warband Ui.

*QA*

-"What about the balance?" 
Again: this mod was mainly made to have an easier way to put my custom WoC units into the campaign without the need to use the Warband system.
>>*Using the Local Recruitment option, while also having access to the Warband system and upgrades, is going to make your faction a little OP sooner than later.*<<

-"Does the AI have access to this?"
Didn't test that, but if we assume that the AI is following the same recruiting rules as the player they should (in theory) have access to this type of recruitment.
Will the AI use this type of recruitment or completely ignore it?
No idea, it's entirely up to the AI at the end of the day.

-"Is there a way to increase my local recruitment slots beyond two?"
Not to my knowledge, sorry about that.

-"Does this also work with the allied outpost mechanic?"
Yes! Be sure to build the outpost on a province with a Dark Fortress, though.

-"I can't recruit X vanilla unit with this method"
Due to problematic balance a good part of the WoC daemonic extended roster cannot be recruited with this method, you'll have to recruit those units with the normal WoC recruitment.
Consult this discussion to know which units are covered by this mod https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2998525410/3817418437355854805/

-"I opened the mod with RPFM and I'm getting a datacoring warning, is that normal?"
Normally you'd want to avoid datacoring, but in the case of this specific mod datacoring was necessary, so yeah: it's normal.

-"How can I use this mod to put my custom WoC units in campaign?"
Follow this quick guide https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2998525410/3805027864674661182/

-"Can you also make stuff related to global recruitment?"
No.
Global recruitment go beyond the scope of this mod and I have no idea about how to achieve such a thing.

-"SFO/Radious ecc. ?"
As a matter of fact I'm officially retired from SFO/Overhaul related mods.
As always: If you already have previous experience in SFO submodding feel free to make an SFO version out of any of my mods that are currently missing one, I will link your submods if you provide me with a link.

-"Your mods are ugly and janky, why? just why?"
Here's a friendly reminder: I'm just an amateur and nothing more.
If you want beautiful stuff with no jank then stick with CA and/or professional modders and avoid my mods, simple as that really.

*KNOWN ISSUES*
-Some vanilla unit cards were already visually tied to the Black fortress' building chain despite not being directly recruitable from there due to the Warband system.
You'll notice a few duplicates in the building browser but it's just a little visual bug.

*COMPATIBILITY*

Should be compatible with pretty much everything EXCEPT other mods that datacore the Vanilla ui_features_to_cultures_tables table and possibly mods that heavily modify the Warriors of Chaos UI and/or add new recruitment button/s.

Consult this discussion to check the known incompatible mods https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2998525410/6273018183374262029/

And that's all I guess!
Credits time!

Thanks to Phazer for RME editor!
Thanks to H3ro and his great tool!
Any of this would not have been possible without Frodo45127's RPFM which is still updated to this very day, thank you!
I would also like to thank Sebidee and Caligula for their great modding guides!
And I would like to thank you!
Whatever you liked my mod or not thanks a bunch for giving it a try!

3004867930.title: Lyla of Avelorn - High Elf Legendary Lord
3004867930.description:
[h1]Allow me to introduce Lyla, a new custom legendary lord for (some of) the High Elves![/h1]

Lyla originates from Avelorn and while being a character in official lore, not much was said about her, beyond a certain passionate encounter with Tyrion. This mod changes this, providing a new legendary lord when playing as Alarielle's Avelorn (or Korhil's Chrace when using Mixu's Unlocker). She's available to be recruited on turn 1 from the lord recruitment window.

So who is Lyla, I hear you ask! Well a fully fleshed-out piece of mod-lore will be available in a discussion thread, while I'll give you the TLDR right here. Lyla is an agile frontline fighter and infantry-blender, intended to be on par with Tyrion as a baseline and then as she advances in rank, she specializes in a certain part of the High Elf roster and also develops magical abilities. As a (in the mod) product of a union between a famous Chracian warrior and an Avelornian mage, Lyla will focus on the units specifically tied to both those kingdoms, namely the White Lions, War Lions, Sisters of Avelorn and Handmaidens. Do note though that not all her bonuses are unit-specific and can support others as well, which is the case of her red and blue skill lines, who remain the same akin to the standard princes and princesses lords.

In regards to her yellow line and unique abilities though, that's where her heritage comes in. When fully outfitted, Lyla has access to 5 different "elemental spells" through her yellow line, to demonstrate her baseline magical affinity (explained further in the full lore). These are Tidecall, Regrowth, Fireball, Wind Blast and Hailstorm. Besides this, Lyla has 4 unique items and 2 unique skills. In addition to providing 1 more spell, Wyssan's Wildform, these aim to boost mainly the Chracian and Avelornian portions of the High Elf roster, although some of them are more general army-wide boons. She has one kind of mount, a Griffon named Dromui. 

These things unlock themselves in various stages at ranks 5, 10, 15 and 20, encouraging you to have Lyla as your main offensive army. I can tell you that already by herself, she is a great help in fighting against Tullaris's Scourge and N'kari for the respective kingdoms. Enjoy!

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
Her in-battle porthole is empty. Otherwise fully functional.

3006052748.title: Missing Special Herdstones
3006052748.description:
Everyone is aware of the big Beastmen update that added the ability for Beastmen to erect Herdstones in settlements. Everyone should also be aware that various racial capitals have special Herdstones that grant a universal buff and a Melee Attack buff against the culture the capital corresponds to. These were all great improvements but there were some things missing. Southern Realms, Tomb Kings, Vampire Coast and Skaven just have generic Herdstones in their racial capitals and other racial capitals (which I'm defining as settlements where one or more races have a special main settlement building that has extra slots and possibly other bonuses) lack special herdstones as well. That's where this mod comes in which aims to fix this issue as well as add some additional adjustments to some of the existing special Herdstones. Everything that goes unmentioned is unchanged.

[h1]Maelstrom Desecrated (Galleon's Graveyard)[/h1]
[i]Noctilus merely exploited an existing magical phenomenon. Chaos has far more imaginative designs.[/i]
Grants a Ward Save in increments of 1% per level. More powerful than the others but in all likelihood, the player will not be able to complete the Ritual of Ruination there and thus must sacrifice a Herdstone Shard for the bonus.

[h1]The First Civilization Sundered (Khemri)[/h1]
[i]Man's first civilization survived the death of its people but will not survive the Age of Chaos![/i]
Increases Leadership in increments of 1 per level. Mutually exclusive with The Blackened Pyramid.

[h1]Principality in Ruins (Miragliano)[/h1]
[i]No amount of Gold or mercenaries could have stopped the tides of Chaos. All nations of Man will fall![/i]
Increases Magic Item Drop Chance in increments of 3% per level. Mutually exclusive with Evil Replaced with Evil.

[h1]Demolished Bell Tower of the Pretender God (Skavenblight)[/h1]
[i]The Horned Rat is nothing more than an upstart daemon to be taught it's place as servant to the true Gods of Chaos.[/i]
Increases Beastpath Evasion Chance in increments of 2% per level.

[h1]Eight Peaks Toppled (Karak Eight Peaks)[/h1]
[i]No Dwarf, Skaven, or Greenskin can lay claim to the Eight Peaks any longer for the Cloven Ones have left nothing but ruins.[/i]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Dwarfs or Greenskins. Increases Underway, Beastpath and Worldroots interception chance in increments of 2% per level. Mutually exclusive with the Crag of the Cloven.

[h1]Evil Replaced with Evil (Sartosa)[/h1]
[i]The Old World's den of scum and villainy has met a fitting end, at the hands of a force much more despicable than they could ever be...[/i]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Humans. Increases razing income in increments of 3% per level. Mutually exclusive with the Principality in Ruins.

[h1]The Cursed City (Lahmia)[/h1]
[i]With the birthplace of vampirism in ruins once more, the city has truly earned the moniker of "The Cursed City".[/i]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Tomb Kings or Vampire Counts. Increases the recruit rank of Wargors in increments of 1 per level. This will not show up in the landmark icon tooltip due to a vanilla bug.

[h1]The Last City (Itza)[/h1]
[i]The First City of the lizardmen reduced to ash, the once beautiful Emerald Pools now run red with the blood of its guardians while mutated beasts crawl out of the spawning pools. The Children of the Old Ones will never recover from this![/i]
Increases casualty replenishment rate in increments of 1% per level.

[h1]The Scoured Pits (Hellpit)[/h1]
[i]Throughout the depths of Hellpit, the creations of ordered fleshcrafting fought the fruits of chaotic mutation. The erratic mutations of the Skaven were bested by the much more ordered mutations of Chaos, thus proving the Dark Gods are the true masters of mutation.[/i]
Increases Melee Defence in increments in 1 per level.

[h1]The Coast of Ruin (The Awakening)[/h1]
[i]The Pirate King of the seas has been brought down along with his Grand Armada. Neither the Lizardmen nor the Pirates can lay claim to the coast any longer for it now belongs to the Cloven Ones...[/i]
Increases Gorebull recruit rank in increments of 1 per level. This will not show up in the landmark icon tooltip due to a vanilla bug.

[h1]The Isle of Sacriledge (The Gaean Vale)[/h1]
[i]Even the most beautiful of lands are not safe from the touch of chaos. The valleys of the Gaean Vale are trampled and tainted and the Temple of the Mother Goddess now a cave of horrors.[/i]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting any High Elves or Wood Elves. Increases Lord recruit rank in increments of 1 per level.

[h1]The Blackened Pyramid (Black Pyramid of Nagash)[/h1]
[i]Nagash was weak! Let the world tremble at the sight of darkness far worse than the undead![/i]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting any Undead. Decreases Miscast Chance in increments of 5% per level. Mutually exclusive with The First Civilization Sundered.

[h1]Great Herdstone of Cold (Naggarond)[/h1]
Increases Armour in increments of 2 per level instead of 1.

[h1]Fall of Man (Altdorf)[/h1]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Empire factions only instead of any and all human factions.

[h1]Bloodfeasters' Ruin (Castle Drakenhof)[/h1]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting against Vampire Counts only instead of any and all undead factions. Increases Spell Resistance in increments of 2% per level instead of 1%.

[h1]Morrsleib's Eclipse (Hexoatl)[/h1]
Increases Winds of Magic Power Reserve Capacity in increments of 2 per level instead of 1.

[h1]Ruins of Urskoy (Kislev)[/h1]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Kislev factions only instead of any and all human factions.

[h1]Splintered Compass (Wei-Jin)[/h1]
Grants a Melee Attack bonus when fighting Cathay factions only instead of any and all human factions.

[h1]Defiled Tournament Grounds (Couronne)[/h1]
Increases Charge Bonus in increments of 2 per level instead of 1.

3030996759.title: SCM Marienburg (9.0)
3030996759.description:
This mod will crash without [u][b]Mixer's Unlocker[/b][/u] enabled 

[h1]Download [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493]Immortal Empires Expanded![/url] to play with 2 new factions in Ind and Khuresh, new legendary lords, and new mechanics![/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4dMbXjBM/flags.png[/img]

[b]TLDR: This mod adds FIVE! fleshed-out lore-friendly factions interacting with the Wasteland, with legendary lords, an improved version of the caravan mechanic, a lot of unique mechanics, a completely unique roster, and much more. Lastly, this mod marks the return of the [u]Landship[/u] to WH III. Please read this mod page for vital information.[/b]

[h1]Introduction[/h1]

 This mod has a combined development timespan of 2.5 years (!). Starting development in WH2 by the legendary OVN team. This mod gives Marienburg a completely lore-friendly DLC-type makeover. Not only does this mod completely overhaul Marienburg as a faction, with a completely stand-alone unique roster and RoR-pool, its own unique mechanics, legendary lords, and heroes – but it also adds 2 completely new playable factions on the campaign map. One as a Marienburg subfaction and one old enemy joins the board for the Vampire Counts.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/BQn5RK0p/hkrul-jk-port.png[/img]

[quote=Jaan van de Kuypers][b][i]‘’The business of Marienburg is business’’[/i][/b][/quote]

Jaan van de Kuypers is the richest man in the Old World and the most influential merchant in the Empire. All the Kings, Tsars, Queens, and Emperors of the mortal races owe him money or favors. This is by far the most complex and unique character design that we ever attempted, as [b]Jaan van de Kuypers is not a fighting lord. He is probably the worst legendary lord you've ever seen [/b] Instead, he has strong economic and diplomatic buffs as long as you keep him garrisoned in Marienburg, where he rules from his Estate. He is never seen without his bodyguard, Legendary hero Pieter ‘’Big Piet’’ de Groot.

He is the informal ruler of Marienburg as the Van de Kuypers is the most powerful and influential family of the so-called ‘’Ten’’. The ten most Greatest Merchant Families. In his campaign, your goal is to bribe – blackmail, or indebt the other families to consolidate ultimate rule over Marienburg. Do this by completing various missions and completing his legendary item set. Additionally, he uses the [b]Gilded Route[/b] and send trade convoys across the sea searching for wealth.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/GtHPN489/munvard2.png[/img]
[b][i]Lord of Shadows, Ruler of the Underground[/i][/b]
Mundvard the Cruel

Mundvard the Cruel is a ruthless Vampire Lord who has ruled the underworld of the Wasteland for centuries. Unlike most of his vampire-kin, Mundvard has a particular and uncommon interest in the affairs of men. Especially affairs that involve accumulating wealth. He runs criminal networks, syndicates, and slave trafficking rings. His ultimate goal was to not rule the Wasteland from the Shadows but from a newly established throne in the City. 
Mundvard rides his pet Terrorgheist, the Beast of Suiddock, and is a powerful caster profound in both the lore of vampires and the lore of shadows.

On his campaign, he can [b]establish criminal networks[/b] in hostile towns and cities to leech from the world above. Additionally, he can accumulate slaves and sell them. Lastly, his knowledge of the Underground allows him to traverse the Underworld. 


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FH8zvGW9/egmond2.png[/img]
[b][i]Nipponese, Marienburger and patron of Tzeentch[/i][/b]
Egmond den Euwe

Egmond Den Euwe is the heir to one of the great Merchant Houses of Marienburg, House Den Euwe. He leads a special trading mission on the Eastern Shores of Cathay in a desperate attempt to prevent his family from going bankrupt. Unfortunately, his desperation caught the gaze of Tsien-Tsin. A diety he now follows enthusiastically – unaware of Tsien-Tsin’s true origin: Tzeentch. 

Egmond can also utilize the Gilded Route like Jaan. Additionally, Egmond can convert Empiric soldiers to Tzeentch and upgrade them to Tzeentch warriors. Lastly, he can utilize the Changing of the Ways mechanic. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sQm76Z0Z/hkrul-dauphine.png[/img]
Camille Dauphina

[b](IEE only)[/b] As the Matriarch of the Sea Camille Dauphina follows information regarding the infamous Red Chaos Whale in the Cult's quest to bring down this creation of Stromfel. Starts in the distant lands of Khuresh.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/p5d8gXgc/hkrul-fooger.png[/img]
Arkat Fooger

[b](IEE only)[/b] Van de Kuypers has brought the wealthy House Fooger to the brink of bankruptcy. In a dire attempt to save his Clan's honor, Arkat Fooger hopes to stake a claim in Ind's spice route. 
[h1]Character Preview[/h1]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sXxC21hS/all.png[/img]

[h1]Facts & Figures[/h1]
[list]
[*]6 Legendary Lords
[*]12 Legendary Heroes
[*]7 generic Agents
[*]5 New factions
[*]30+ units
[*]10+ Regiments of Renown
[*]90+ unique Ancillaries
[*]7 Landmark Buildings
[*]A uniquely skinned version of the caravan mechanic
[/list]

[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]Why have you reuploaded the mod?[/b]
Steam only allows the main author to update the pack and it was problematic when the person was out of touch.

[*][b]This mod crashes on loading the game, why?[/b]
Make sure you have the latest version of the Mixer enabled

[*][b]Can Marienburg confederate and be confederated by Empire Factions?[/b]
Yes, 4 human Marienburg factions still count as Empire factions.

[*][b]Jaan van de Kuypers is worthless in battle, can you buff him?[/b]
No. Jaan van de Kuypers is a frail old man with 0 fighting capabilities, just like his lore. Garrison him in Marienburg and allow his generals to do the fighting

[*][b]I want to get the RoR and roster units as Reikland[/b]
Conquer Marienburg as Reikland and unlock all the unique units.
