3057019745.title: AI Declares War
3057019745.description:
[h1]Welcome Back, Commanders[/h1]
This is a script which forces AI to declare war against factions they have a low opinion of. I found that it increases the performance of the AI. Without a war target, AI can become passive and stagnate but once they have a goal they will form a true empire. 

By default, the chance of a war declaration increases exponentially from 0% to 100% as opinion decreases from -100 to -200. There are a variety of configurable features and I have added MCT support. The default settings are what I recommend. 

Using MCT, you can make my script behave identically to other War Declaration scripts, like making war declaration guaranteed at opinion -50 or making war declaration a constant 10% at opinion -150 like FiftyTifty's removed script. However, MCT is not required for my mod to function. If you want to increase chance of war, you can raise Base Chance, Scaling Chance, or move either opinion threshold towards 0. To decrease chance of war, do the opposite.

[h1]Default Functionality[/h1]
If the AI has an opinion lower than -100 towards a faction, then we will roll a random chance to see if we declare a war. The random chance is calculated using an exponential formula. -100 opinion or better means 0% chance, -150 opinion means 9% chance, -175 opinion means 31% chance, and -200 opinion means 100% chance. These values might seem low, but over multiple turns even a low chance of war declaration can guarantee war. For example, a 25% chance of war is actually around 80% chance of war within 5 turns. [url=https://www.desmos.com/calculator/d4uyspw3sm]Interactive Desmos link[/url] 

By default, the AI will declare war on humans AND AI. When war is declared, the attacker's military allies and the defender's allies will both join the war. This script will never force declare war on a vassal or rebel faction, and a rebel or vassal faction will never be forced to declare war. Additionally, a faction will never be forced to declare war on it's own vassal, ally or client state. 

This mod also detects the most recent peace treaty offer between two factions and will not force another war until 10 turns(configurable) after the peace treaty. When a peace offer is rejected, it doesn't matter and when one is accepted it must be the most recent peace offer between those factions. Unfortunately, this does not detect when a script skips the offer and forces a peace treaty.

Finally, war will not be forcibly declared by a faction that is already in 4 or more wars. However, nothing stops other factions from forcing more than 4 wars on them. This script can only cause 1 war declaration per ai per turn to avoid issues.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021][img]https://i.imgur.com/1Vglg7c.png[/img][/url]

[h1]MCT Settings[/h1]
Target Human - Should the script make AI declare war on humans? Default: True
Invite Aggressor Allies - Should the script make AI attacker's military allies join the war? Default: True
Invite Target Allies - Should the script make AI defender allies join the war? Default: True
Max Wars - If the AI is already in this many wars, it will not be forced to declare more. -1 is unlimited. Default: 4
Grace Turns After Peace - Wait this many turns before trying to force war between two factions who signed a peace treaty. Default: 10

When opinion is above the Base Opinion Threshold, this script will not run.

[h1]Scaling Mode[/h1]
If Opinion Floor is lower then the Base Opinion Threshold, then scaling mode is enabled and the chance of a war declaration will exponentially increase from the Base Chance to the Max Scaling Chance as opinion decreases from the Base Opinion Threshold to the Opinion Floor. Below the floor, the chance will be Max Scaling Chance. You can set Max Scaling Chance above 100 without issues to increase the rate war chance increases. In between the threshold and the floor, the formula for chance of war declaration can be found at the [url=https://www.desmos.com/calculator/d4uyspw3sm]Desmos link.[/url]

[h1]Fixed Mode[/h1]
To disable scaling mode, set the Opinion Floor higher than Base Opinion or set Max Chance lower than Base Chance. When scaling mode is disabled, the chance of war declaration will simply be the base chance.

For example, to mimic FiftyTifty's script which has a fixed 10% war chance below -150 opinion, use
Base Opinion Threshold: -150
Opinion Floor: -150
Base Chance: 10
Max Scaling Chance: 10
Opinion floor could be any number higher than -150 and scaling chance could be any number less than 10 and my error handling would make it act like this.

[h1] Compatibility [/h1]
There should be no compatibility issues with any mods. This should work with AI overhauls because my mod directly declares war, it does not interfere with them. It also works with script based mods like Bring the Boys home. The only issues are with mods that FORCE peace. This mod won't detect the treaty and might force war again. However, this is not campaign breaking. I believe it is multiplayer-safe and also safe to remove or add during a campaign but I could be wrong. Let me know in the comments if it works or doesn't work for those cases.

Inspired by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1983237410&searchtext=Make+AI]Make AI declare war on other AI more often[/url]
All my mods are compatible with SFO.

3079850881.description:
[h1] HOW DO GET MORE THAN ONE EXPEDITION?[/h1]
You can't. That would be a pain to balance so no

[h1] Features [/h1]
Adds new dinosaur units for Lizardmen, as well as a new campaign mechanic for acquiring them.

[h1] Nakai cannot use expeditions sadly due to him having no regions [/h1]
Use this submod to let him recruit directly from his horde buildings:
//steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3085589102

[h1] Compatibility [/h1]
Compatible with Immortal Empires Expanded again
Compatible with Lustria Rises
Compatible with Warband Upgrade Ultimate (dinos have a separate upgrade tab)
Compatible with Rhox's other caravan mods. (Marienburg, Torinubar (LCCP))
SFO submod by Gabesky
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3086916833&searchtext=

Tabletop Caps, by Capt. Freakout
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812165190&searchtext=table+top+caps


[h1] Translations [/h1]
中文翻译 -Chinese https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3081886544

한국어번역 -Korean https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3082060200

[h1] Premise [/h1]
Guided by the sacred plaques, the Lizardmen have been drawn to several areas of unremarkable wilderness scattered across the southern hemisphere. Here they discovered paths to hidden landscapes, prehistoric nature reserves, each inhabited by primeval creatures. Many of these ancient animals were thought to have been extinct. Clearly the Old Ones had wished them to be preserved, and to be re-introduced to the world. But it will require a deft approach. For now, the other races remain oblivious, and must remain so, by any means necessary.

[h1] Gotta Catch 'Em All [/h1]
There are a total of 37 units to collect. 
29 units divided across the 7 sites
8 units available through dilemmas and narrative events

[h1] Safari Sites [/h1]
A map is available in the expedition menu showing which sites contain which dinosaurs.
[b]Players should note that Itza is not a destination. [/b]
The units displayed there are acquired through dilemmas which can occur at any of the sites.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bgzRcqc.png[/img]

[h1] Expeditions [/h1]
These work like caravans, wherein you recruit an expedition chief, pick a destination, and face dilemmas and battles. Unlike caravans, expedition teams don’t move across the map and they are always hidden from enemy armies. They are imagined to be stationed at covert monitoring posts outside the sites, awaiting orders to cross the border. As such, they appear instantly at the target site and remain there, in hidden encampment stance, until their work is completed.

[h1] Expedition Goals [/h1]
When mounting an expedition, the player will be asked to set a goal. An expedition’s goal will determine the rewards it gives. The 1st two options are available immediately. The 3rd and 4th require levelling up your expedition chiefs and investing points in their skilltree. 
[list]
    [*] [b]Field Research[/b]: Temporary faction-wide research bonus
    [*] [b]Egg Collection[/b]: Many low tier dinos plus 1 or 2 mid tier dinos
    [*] [b]Herd Extraction[/b]: A balanced mix of mid tier dinos
    [*] [b]Live Capture[/b]: High tier dinos.
[/list]

[h1] Specimens [/h1]
Specimens refers to the resource gathered by expeditions. It determines the quantity of rewards received, giving a higher number of units or a higher research bonus. There are a few ways to gain more specimens.
[list]
    [*] committing more gold to funding expeditions
    [*] through dilemmas
    [*] by defeating trespassers
    [*] by levelling up expedition chiefs and buying skills
[/list]

[h1] Trespassers [/h1]
Frequently, warmbloods will stumble across the sites and the player will have to choose whether to ignore or attack them. Be aware that ignoring trespassers will result in your expeditions being ambushed by the indigenous natives of the sites. You may want to deliberately take this on however, as beating them in battle is the only way to unlock certain units. 

[h1] Adversaries [/h1]
Adversaries are notable trespassers who will repeatedly invade the sites and attack expeditions. Each adversary must be defeated on 3 occasions before they are vanquished permanently. There are 4 adversaries and 4 unique rewards locked behind vanquishing them in the form of powerful units.

The conditions for triggering their appearance are: [b] (spoilers) [/b]
[list]
    [*]Event 1: [spoiler]Complete any kind of expedition to all 7 sites.[/spoiler]
    [*]Event  2: [spoiler]Complete a herd extraction expedition to 4 different sites.[/spoiler]
    [*]Event  3: [spoiler]Complete a live capture expedition to any 3 different sites.[/spoiler]
    [*]Event  4: [spoiler]Win 3 of the ambush encounters that start occurring after the player has elected to ignore 3 groups of trespassers.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1] Ai factions [/h1]
Ai lizardmen will recruit the units in this mod, gaining them at a similar rate to the player. This is regardless of whether the player is playing as lizardmen or not

3082390369.title: Just Good Babysitter
3082390369.description:
7.0+ compatible

Have you ever felt yourself more a baby tender than a commander because your units stop doing what they were doing and go smoking every 5 seconds for CA knows what reason? If yes - this mod is for you.

It helps your units with one simple thing - following orders
If one was ordered to attack, the unit will continue to attack until there is no one to attack.
If one was ordered to stay - he will stay

- automatically attack nearby targets from idle mode if last command from player was to attack
- will not attack if guard mode is enabled

there is also a bit of logic implemented
- units prefer to attack same target as before they gone idle unless it is shattered
- ranged units will attack same target if its in their range
- active units preferred over routing or shattered ones
- routing ones preferred over shattered
- new: units attacking shattered targets will change to another target if there is more than 4 active enemy units left and current target is not a character

if you see any inconsistencies  or something can be improved - let me know, but basic purpose of the mod - to handle idle states giving you time for more important decisions

The is few MCT (Mod Configuration Tool) options, so check it out! To persist changes should be made in campaign

[b]IMPORTANT! The mod do not control units who have Guard mod enabled, such units considered under manual control[/b]

How to do basic debug
1. Get the '[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789857593&searchtext=Script+Debug+Activator]Script Debug Activator[/url]' mod
2. Enable debug mode in MCT settings of a mod
3. Reproduce the problem, look for the log files in WH3 rood directory
4. See if logs contains any "SCRIPT ERROR" lines

Update 09/02/2025
Weights system added, helping better decide which target should unit attack from idle state
- Units should prefer closer enemies, or those over which they have a speed advantage
- Now they should split between enemies more evenly
- Units got a chance to change target that is shattered and have higher speed

Mods compatibility
- Compatible with AI General 3

3107188023.title: Sarvente's Custom Characters: Xiao
3107188023.description:
Just when I thought I won't be coming back to custom heroes

[h1] MOD OVERVIEW [/h1]
I began my long journey into actual modding by starting with custom legendary heroes, and once I learned how to make the normal heroes, I've made a decision to switch to them instead. But in a spark of inspiration, I've decided to make a legendary hero for Yuan Bo, and thus created Xiao. With that, I believe I'm not done with custom characters just yet. As it usually goes with most of my mods lately, it has custom everything except for the audio.

[h1] HERO OVERVIEW [/h1]
A frontline bruiser with high damage and survivability, Xiao is a powerful warrior capable of staying alive and sustaining prolonged combat with pretty much anything. With a puppet body devoid of any weaknesses common among creatures of flesh and blood, she is apt at dueling enemy heroes and lords using an extremely powerful debuffs. 

[h1] KNOWN ISSUES [/h1]
— Clipping
— Her custom trait is not yet finished, and so is her skill tree (please refer to the message below for explanation)

As of right now, the mod is not fully finished [strike] because my mental energy is utterly spent and my creativity has hit a dead end  [/strike], however I will try to update it bit by bit. The hero is fully playable both in campaign and in battles. Plase make sure to repost any bugs and/or give suggestions regarding the improvements to her trait and/or skill tree.

[h1] ADDITIONAL INFO [/h1]
— The hero is custom made and has no relation to official GW lore. [strike] Lore-wise, she was designed specifically for Yuan Bo and his faction in mind. [/strike] Since a lot of people asked to make her usable with other Cathayan factions, you can make her usable with either Zhao Ming of Miao Ying by doing a minor edit to script by replacing the highlighted string with "wh3_main_cth_the_northern_provinces" to make her usable for Miao Ying or "wh3_main_cth_the_western_provinces" for Zhao Ming. Please refer to the last screenshots for information how to do it. Otherwise, the character is Yuan Bo exclusive. [b] Keep in mind that in case you change the script to spawn Xiao for other Cathayan LLs you'll have to repeat this after every mod update, since it will revert the script to its original state [/b]

— Most skills have up to 5 levels, but due to UI limitations these leves aren't properly displayed in the skill tree UI. Make sure to click the skills multiple times to invest the maximum amount of points into them.

[h1] FUTURE PLANS [/h1]
Once again, I plan to take some time on updating my old mods for the time being. There are still many concepts, but they will have to wait.

[h1] CREDITS [/h1]
Creators of wonderful modding tools, such as Asset Editor, RPFM, QtRME and RME Editor.
Corv0


Check out my Ko-Fi page if you wish to support me: ko-fi.com/sarvente2367

Have a good one, everybody and until the next year (hopefully I'll still be making mods by that time).

3140200173.title: Victory Conditions Overhaul
3140200173.description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QNk207hG/upvote-gif.gif[/img]

[quote]This mod adds custom victory objectives and rewards. [b]This mod is still under construction and does not yet support every faction in the game.[/b] Click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2964052084]here[/url] to see which factions are supported.[/quote]

[h1]Factions Currently Supported: 93/109 (85%)[/h1]
[h2]Roadmap (no ETA):[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Lords of the End Times:[/b] Neferata, Nagash, Thanquol, Glottkin
    [*][b]Dunes of the Dead:[/b] Settra, Khalida, Khatep
    [*][b]Rise of the Mortarchs:[/b] Luthor Harkon
    [*][b]Sons of Aenarion:[/b] Malekith, Teclis. Tyrion rework
    [*][b]The Contest of Claws:[/b] Rakarth, Gor-Rok
    [*][b]The Rest:[/b] Tiktaq'to, Kroq-Gar, Sigvald, Kholek
    [*]Revisiting some of the oldest routes
[/list]

[h1]Latest Patch (25 SEPTEMBER 2026):[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New victory conditions for Boris Todbringer
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3140200173/688619956215091184/]Known issue: quest battle limit reached[/url]. If you play any other mod that adds quest battles, Todbringer battle will stop working
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TPJVZTwd/2-unique.png[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]ROUTES[/b]: Victory Conditions Overhaul introduces a major rework of the default victory conditions. It rejects the classic idea of short and long campaigns and proposes a new concept based on completing routes. A route is a campaign all on its own, tailored for each faction, and completing it will be enough to trigger victory and receive the victory achievements.

All factions have three routes to choose from, each with unique objectives and rewards. They are usually designed to be short to mid length campaigns of around 50-70 turns. After victory, you can choose to pursue another route, or work on all three simultaneously as you expand your empire.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]REWARDS[/b]: Completion of a route unlocks flavourful rewards which are thematic to the route's objectives. These can range from unlocking legendary heroes like Grimgor Ironbound, slave to Astragoth, to unique items or followers like Amanar, stat buffs or even dilemmas and quest battles which provide more narrative and rewards.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]MULTIPLAYER[/b]: Play with friends either in head-to-head or co-op campaigns.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]STEAM GUIDE[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2964052084]Click here to see a list of all the supported factions and their objectives and rewards[/url].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/43Q6rXdX/3-narrative.png[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]LEGENDARY LORE[/b]: If you prefer campaigns with an even stronger emphasis on narrative please consider the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789857945]Legendary Lore[/url] mod, which generates text popups for various actions undertaken by the player such as defeating Legendary Lords and capturing significant settlements.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]WARHAMMER 2 CINEMATICS[/b]: If you want the Warhammer 2 cinematics to trigger with your VCO campaigns please check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3331667376]this mod[/url].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]QUEST BATTLES[/b]: VCO has brand new and returning quest battles to pursue. There are three categories of quest battles:
[list]
    [*][b]Cut Content Quest Battles[/b] - These are restored quest battles made by Creative Assembly for the Vortex campaign in game 2.
    [*][b]Quest Battles For Old DLCs[/b] - The earliest DLCs did not feature the grand finale quest battles that came with later DLCs, so I fixed that.
    [*][b]Miscellaneous Quest Battles[/b] - Just some random quest battles I've been thinking up and putting into the game.
[/list]
See all quest battles [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3140200173/4358998952357890866/]here[/url].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5tSBZf0x/4-faq.png[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]Can I enable this mod in the middle of my campaign?[/b] No. Victory conditions are set in stone on turn 1. If you disable VCO in the middle of your campaign, your objectives will disappear.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]I can't see the latest update/fix/it's crashing?[/b] You are not running the latest version of the mod. Delete the mod pack file (victory_conditions_overhaul.pack) in this directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop which will force Steam to download the latest version.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]Can I still unlock achievements with this mod?[/b] Yes, the achievement will trigger upon completion of at least one route. No achievement means a Steam connectivity or mod incompatibility issue. NEVER the fault of this mod.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]Is this mod compatible with [insert mod here]?[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3140200173/6273018183380408557/]Almost always yes, but read this important information on script breaking which WILL block you from achieving victory/quests/dilemmas if you don't look out for it[/url].
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]Can I make my own victory conditions? [/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3589678765]Yes. Click here to learn how.[/url]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nX3QMcjm/1-bullet.png[/img][b]There's a bug! ("The quest didn't trigger, the dilemma didn't pop up, etc")[/b] Report all bugs. If you want individual help with your bug, come to Discord.

3157105199.title: Warband UI Framework
3157105199.description:
This mod provides an expanded and streamlined UI framework for Warband upgrades, featuring enlarged panels, over 50 new UI tabs, two-column tab layout, reduced button size, and rank-after-upgrade display.

It is best viewed at 1080p (1920*1090) or higher resolution; for higher resolution, avoid too large UI scaling which can hide top portion of the panel.


[h1]Do I need to subscribe to this? [/h1]
If you mainly play vanilla races, and only use the main [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853239091]Warband Ultimate[/url] mod, you do not need to subscribe to this UI mod.

It is recommended if you:
-- have many other Warband submods for vanilla or modded factions
-- encounter missing UI issues for certain DLC or custom races;
-- have too many buttons on right side.
-- would like to mod your own upgrade options.


[h1]For modders: [/h1]

The UI framework has no upgrade path, no UI provided --- this enables all the freedom to customize arts and upgrade path without the need of warband ultimate.

For customizing arts, I suggest first copying the whole ui/skins from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853239091]Warband Ultimate[/url] mod, to ensure nothing is blank first; then replace button / backgrounds images for customization.

A list of added [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3157105199/4206994256761698184]UI tabs[/url]. More tabs can be added if needed. Most new tabs can be used freely without conflicting main mod. 


[h1]Misc: [/h1]
For urgent requests, please reach out via our [url=https://discord.gg/NU5t9CK8eF]Discord[/url]. I don’t always check Steam comments.

And I always welcome [url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=WHEF2PNWVCQD4]a cup of coffee[/url] for my work.

3166984131.title: The Phoenix Court (High Elf Politics)
3166984131.description:
[h3][b]Adds a lore-rich political intrigue system to the High Elves[/b], allowing you to compete over seats of authority.  Using the Chaos Dwarf [b]"Tower of Zharr"[/b] system as a base, The Phoenix Court goes far beyond it, giving all Ten Kingdoms of Ulthuan their own [b]unique political strengths and goals[/b].  

Features a frankly excessive amount of [b]lavish new art[/b], all of it either hand-drawn or modified from official sources.[/h3]

[h3]Politics[/h3]
[*] Compete over [b]loreful Seats[/b], each with its own flavor text and thematic effects
[*] Deeply [b]integrated with High Elf gameplay[/b]: buildings, edicts, traits, technologies, rituals, and even post-battle options all have political effects
[*] Adds over two dozen [b]Intrigue dilemmas[/b] to all participating factions
[*] [b]"Insult"[/b] system lets your rivals react realistically
[*] Clear, fully [b]integrated help text[/b] guides you on your path to power[/list]
[h3]Art[/h3]
[*] Changing [b]weather, seasons, and lighting[/b] beautifully measure the passage of time
[*] [b]Animated flames[/b] and [b]candles that light[/b] when you reach a goal, [b]translucent windows[/b] and other visual touches fully immerse you in the Court ambiance
[*] Even generic UI elements change when you are in the Court, for the maximum elf experience[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[*] The Court creates a significant disadvantage for High Elves by blocking normal diplomatic confederation, balanced out by the positive effects of Court Seats
[*] Court Seats buff underpowered and underused elements of the faction, adding choice while avoiding excessive power[/list]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2372902440572556760/8E8E643E204436265CFBBF70B29D3AEDE28B40D2/?imw=160&imh=150&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox[/img]
[*] Some events trigger (official) voiced dialogue from other faction leaders, and all include detailed, immersive flavor text
[*] Event text is rewritten (fifteen times!) to be unique to the Kingdom involved: interacting with each Kingdom is unique both story-wise and mechanically
[*] Usurping Seats creates thematic consequences. Each Kingdom punishes you in a different way
[*] Claim every seat for a final event unique to your faction, choosing between loyalty and ambition[/list]



[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/5953266223847995145/DF553B703CEC25D8529B5C9F015D25F0EF30BE23/?imw=310&imh=85&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox[/img]
[h3]The White Tower[/h3]
[i]A sanctuary of learning and philosophy, the White Tower of Hoeth is also a powerful force in elven politics.

Examples:[/i]
[*] [b]High Priestess of Lileath[/b] - Crafts magical items for you.
[*] [b]Grand Historian[/b] - Improves relations with other long-lived races of Order.
[/list]

[h3]The Council of Nobles[/h3]
[i]Ulthuan has an elective kingship, and its noble houses strive for centuries to position their candidate to be the next Phoenix King.  Between such struggles, day-to-day administration falls to a council of princes and lower nobles.

Examples:[/i]
[*] [b]High Priest of Mathlann[/b] - Summons a great Merwyrm when fighting at sea
[*] [b]Royal Seneschal[/b] - Grants Influence for each Council of Nobles seat
[/list]

[h3]The Evercourt[/h3]
[i]The Everqueen's position is hereditary, requiring no election.  Thus, its intrigues focus on gaining Her Serenity's attention, which is drawn as easily by poetry or dance as strength of arms.

Examples:[/i]
[*] [b]Oracle of Isha[/b] - Empowers the "Banish Corruption" province edict.
[*] [b]Consort of the Everqueen[/b] - Permits vision over all Magical Forest regions.
[/list]


[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/5953266223848131948/C2218E936FE1E6CB13296359228DAEB9D55C2A7F/?imw=500&imh=85&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox[/img]
[h3]Loreful Strengths and Agendas[/h3]
[*] [b]Play as any of the Ten Kingdoms[/b] of Ulthuan, each with [b]unique political strengths[/b]
[*] Fulfill the unique, [b]lore-based goals[/b] of each Kingdom in order to unite with them 
[*] Normal [b]diplomatic confederation is disabled[/b] for the Ten Kingdoms; earn it at court![/list]
[h3]Additional Kingdoms[/h3]
Six out of ten Kingdoms are playable in the vanilla game.  The other four still participate in the Phoenix Court, but will be unplayable unless a mod supporting them is installed.  The following mods are fully supported:
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2965870624]Alshua's Ellyrion[/url][/b] (for [b]Ellyrion[/b])
[*] medusa0's [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878521711]Surthara Bel-Kec[/url][/b] (for [b]Tiranoc[/b])[/list]
And the following two mods are fully functional but still await tweaking to make text match their new faction leaders:
[*] Mixu's [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2802810577]Legendary Lords[/url][/b] (for [b]Chrace and Saphery[/b]) 
[*] Note: Caledor is represented by Imrik [/list]
[h3]Elven Colonies[/h3]
Though politically weaker, the Elven Colonies also participate at Court.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3166984131/4339851480059045417/][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2372902440572533471/FE31FF24D39D1625BB08DDE5E3DA910CD61CB521/?imw=1500&imh=500&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox[/img][/url]



[h1]Translations[/h1]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3169522950]汉化/Chinese[/url][/b] 
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3270813152]Korean[/url][/b]	
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3718323618]Russian[/url][/b]

[h1]Meet the Modders[/h1]
This mod is an equal partnership between Rhox and Alshua, who both feel they tricked the other into doing the annoying part of the work.
[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198093726039/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1142710]Rhox's Steam Workshop[/url][/h2]
Rhox is arguably the greatest living

3209123287.title: Belakor's Shadow - Corrupted Daemon Princes overhaul (MCT Support)
3209123287.description:
This mod enhances the mechanism of corrupting lords of the mortal faction of Belakor (Shadow Legion).

Now available not only for humans but also for elves, it provides useful traits based on the 5 faiths and levels, unlike before where only Undivided Daemon Princes appeared.

Additionally, it bestows different traits based on whether they are spellcasters or not, similar to the existing Chaos lords.




This mod is my second scripting mod, and while it has undergone several tests, there may still be bugs. If you find any, please report them.




Before:

Only human faction
Only Undivided Daemon Prince without useful traits

After:

1. Available to human and elf factions

2. Unlock special traits upon reaching levels 20 and 30 (Only turned by Bel'akor) (Adjustable via MCT.)

3. Four types of Daemon Princes based on spellcaster or non-spellcaster lords 
(Normal lords cannot ascend to tzeentch's Daemon Princes, while mage lords cannot ascend to Khorne's Daemon Princes)

4. Different traits granted based on spellcaster or non-spellcaster status


5. And no longer available to use Norsca (Is there anything to corrupt in Norsca when Chaos Warriors are practically the same?)

6. [strike] Not usable for lords above level 20 (it was too powerful)[/strike] Adjustable via MCT.

7. human factions added through mods can also be affected. However, they are treated as Empire and receive the traits.



8. Using the MCT  option allows for several additional settings.

- Corruption Effect Duration
- The First Trait Rank
- The Second Trait Rank
- The level immune to corruption.
- Can corrupt norsca faction.
- Race-specific Daemon Prince (beta)

You can find detailed information in the in-game MCT menu.




[b] BUG FIX : Fixing the issue where all Daemon Princes were receiving the Spell Caster trait. sorry [/b]

3270391569.title: The Cult of Slaanesh
3270391569.description:
This mod aims to recreate the Cult of Pleasure as it existed in Warhammer Fantasy’s Storm of Chaos: a Dark Elf faction fully devoted to Slaanesh — stripped of Khaine and reshaped by excess.

[hr]

[h1]Features[/h1]
These changes apply to the Cult of Pleasure, Cult of Excess and S'sildra Tor factions.

[hr]

[h2]Roster Changes[/h2]

• [b]Lore of Slaanesh[/b]
Supreme Sorceresses and Sorceresses gain access to the Lore of Slaanesh

• [b]Cult Heroes[/b]
The Khainite Assassin is replaced by the [b]Druchii Anointed[/b] hero
The Death Hag is replaced by the [b]Cultist of Slaanesh[/b] hero

• [b]Slaanesh Daemons[/b]
All Slaanesh Daemon units are added to Morathi’s roster (except Soulgrinder and Chariots)

• [b]Removal of Khaine Units[/b]
Harpies, Manticores, Witch Elves, Black Guard and Har Ganeth Executioners are removed

• [b]Regiments of Renown[/b]
Khaine-aligned Regiments of Renown are replaced with more fitting alternatives

[hr]

[h2]Campaign Changes[/h2]

• [b]Mark of Slaanesh[/b]
All mortal Dark Elf units gain the Mark of Slaanesh and receive a small cost increase
(except Beast units)

• [b]Cult Infrastructure[/b]
The Black Ark worship building is replaced with a [b]Cult of Pleasure[/b] building, allowing recruitment of Slaanesh units

• [b]Skills & Resistance[/b]
The Ward of Khaine skill is replaced with the Slaanesh-equivalent missile resistance skill for all Lords and Heroes

• [b]Mount Changes[/b]
All Manticore mounts are removed.  
The Beastmaster instead gains access to a [b]Preyton[/b] mount

• [b]Ancillaries[/b]
Slaanesh ancillaries are available to all Lords and Heroes

• [b]Starting Army[/b]
Morathi begins with a [b]Druchii Anointed[/b] hero and [b]Devotees of Slaanesh[/b] instead of a Khainite Assassin and Witch Elves

[hr]

[h2]Design Philosophy[/h2]

The goal of this mod is to recreate the Cult of Pleasure as it appeared in Storm of Chaos,
while adapting the army list to function as a coherent Dark Elves faction in Total War.

This means:
• all Khaine-aligned units and heroes are removed  
• Manticore mounts are removed  
• the roster avoids heavy reliance on mortal Chaos units  

While the original army list included Slaanesh-marked Warriors and Marauders,
these units were deliberately omitted to preserve the identity of the Cult of Pleasure
as a Dark Elves faction influenced by Slaanesh — not a hybrid Chaos roster.

[hr]

[h3]Compatibility[/h3]

This mod has [b]built-in compatibility[/b] with:

• Marth’s Variant Selector  
• DrunkFlamingo’s Tabletop Caps (TTC)  
• Spartan’s Building Progression Icons  
• Victory Conditions Overhaul  
• Alshua’s Cultist mods  
• Better Starting Army

Both this mod and Alshua’s mods add very similar Cultist of Slaanesh heroes.  
To avoid duplicates, only this mod’s version will be available for Morathi.

If you prefer Alshua’s version for Morathi, use one of the optional submods below.

For SFO or other overhauls, a submod is required.  
This mod is balanced for vanilla only.

[hr]

[h3]Submods[/h3]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3276492909]Alshua’s Cultists Submod[/url]  
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3276493047]Alshua’s Pleasure Cultist + Submod[/url]  
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3278793509]Slaanesh Units in Custom Battle[/url]  
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3361465433]Uniforms & Heraldry of the Dark Elves Submod[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3672268813]Chinese Translation[/url]

[hr]

[h3]My Other Mods[/h3]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2791113369]Chaos Visual Overhaul[/url]  
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3341201941]Lingling’s Legendary Lizards[/url]

[hr]

[h3]Credits[/h3]

Alshua — permission to use assets from the Pleasure Cultist hero and Painshrine model  
Rhox — scripting support  
Matthew39 — screenshots

If you enjoy the mod, please consider rating and leaving feedback.

[hr]

[h3]Support the Mod[/h3]

This mod is created and maintained in my free time.
If you enjoy it and would like to support my work,

3279560220.title: Force AI Agent Embedding 9.x MOAR' FECTIVE' NOW
3279560220.description:
HOWDY

This script force embeds all AI heroes into their faction's armies. Fewer hero hornets buzzing around the campaign map, tougher AI armies, and slightly faster AI turns since embedded heroes don't move or pathfind.

Human players are never touched.

[h1]How It Works[/h1]
[list]
[*]At the start of each AI faction's turn, every eligible hero is embedded into one of that faction's armies
[*]If no army can take a hero, it goes about its business on the map as normal and tries again next turn
[*]Can be safely added to or removed from a campaign at any time
[/list]

[h1]Which Heroes Embed[/h1]
[list]
[*]All heroes of the champion, dignitary, engineer, runesmith, spy, and wizard agent types
[*]This looks at agent TYPE keys, not subtype keys, so MODDED HEROES work too
[*]Special-purpose agents are excluded and stay on the map doing their job:  Cult magi (Khorne / Nurgle / Slaanesh / Tzeentch), the Changeling's Trickster Cultist, Plague Cultists, Pestilent Scheme Priests, DOOOOM! Engineers, Ptra Necrotects and the Hand of the Shadow Crown
[/list]

[h1]Which Armies Can Receive Them[/h1]
[list]
[*]Regular land armies led by a real lord
[*]Never: garrisons, navies, besieged armies, or forces led by hidden "colonel" generals
[*]Never: special armies that refuse heroes anyway - Cathay caravans, Chaos Dwarf convoys, Slaanesh disciple armies, Waaagh! armies, and Khorne Blood Hosts
[/list]

[h1]How Heroes Are Distributed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Soft cap of 1 of each hero type per army (up to 2 in overflow cases), hard cap of 4 total heroes per army
[*]Armies at 19+ units are considered full
[*]Emptier armies are preferred, which avoids armies that are secretly mid-recruitment and would silently refuse the hero
[*]Unique and legendary heroes get priority placement
[*]Heroes prefer to embed into the faction leader's army when there's room, then spread out evenly across the rest
[*]If no army has room, up to 2 low-tier units (tier 1 preferred, tier 2 max) are removed from an army to make a seat
[*]Anyone who gets refused simply retries the next turn
[/list]

[h1]Special Handling[/h1]
[list]
[*]Vlad and Isabella von Carstein always seek each other out: whichever one is the hero embeds into their partner's army, waits for them if that army is temporarily full (removing a unit to make room if needed), and re-joins them if the game ever separates the two
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
[*]MP + Radious/SFO safe (and 99.99% of everything else)
[*]Works with modded factions and modded heroes
[*]If you also use my AI Army Upgrader, this mod automatically processes first each turn - a nice-to-have ordering, not a requirement for either mod to function
[*]Vanilla AI Army Upgrader available here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3768702328]Zach's AI Army Upgrader[/url]
[*]SFO: Grimhammer III AI Army Upgrader available here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3664441028]Zach's AI Army Upgrader[/url]
[/list]

This is my first script I've made myself for WH3, please be gentle~

Massive thanks to FiftyTifty and Groove Wizard for guiding me through this process and helping me learn a book
https://steamcommunity.com/id/FiftyTifty/

3292995911.title: Morgan's Heroes (aka, Tamurkhan's Chieftain Porting)
3292995911.description:
[b]This mod will cause CTD without Tamurkhan DLC, and it is a submod of OvN Grudgebringers[/b]

[h1]Description[/h1]
This mod adds Tamurkhan's Chieftain mechanic to Grudgebringers. If you don't know what it is, play Tamurkhan first

It is more of a template for modders who are having trouble porting the mechanic rather than a mod for actual gameplay. Make sure to change global variables, GUID, and other things if you are using it as a template. There is one exception, if you're trying to use it on the mod Stratovarius is uploading, then no, it is not allowed. If you have modding questions, use mod_development in the Modding Den Discord without pinging. 

Also do note that this feature requires lots of things, so ponder fully whether you really want it before leaping off
[list]
 [*] 4 TWUIs (Biggest one is 18K lines long)
 [*] 9 CCO callbacks depending on how much customization you want
 [*] 40ish DB tables
 [*] About 1K lines of Script
 [*] 90 skin pictures (While I skipped it though)
[/list]

[h1]Q&A[/h1]
Q. Why Template?
A. I was making it for a Nagash mod, but the mechanic has so many things related to Legendary Heroes that I don't want to convert it to a Legendary Lord version. 
After this decision had been made, due to a sunk cost law + since I saw at least 4 people needing the template, I made it as a template mod instead. And Grudgebringer submod as I have some control over the mod and as the mod has several Legendary Heroes in it. 

Q. This mod's balance is awful
A. I couldn't care less

Q. Skins are so Nurgly
A. I'm not going to ask another person to make 90 skins just for a template mod

Q. Why no dilemma?
A. I don't like lore writing. (See the effect bundle's loc if you want to know how lazy I was)

Q. Why no quest battle?
A. I didn't want to add one. Too much work. Oh, if you're a modder who is using this as a template and want to add one, you need to compare mine with vanilla's to see what has been changed

Q. Clicking the hero icon in the top bar always leads to Ludwig no matter who I click
A. Yeah, That's coming from me not using the panel system

Q. Why not put it as a part of the main Grudgebringer mod? 
A. Multiple reasons: 
1. That mod already has too many gimmicks
2. I'm going to put DLC checking CTD in the mod, but not all of the team members have all the DLC
3. Too many skin drawings are needed. 
4. Also too many balancing jobs are needed. 

Q. Does this mod work in TOW?
A. No, only in IE and IEE

Q. Will you do X for me? 
A. No go away.

3313629415.title: Murranji's Great Bastion Expansion Mod
3313629415.description:
[h2]Description[/h2]

The key goal of the mod is to turn the Great Bastion feature into a more engaging and interactive mechanic by increasing the variety of enemies that can attack the Bastion and adding unique and specialised ways to bolster its defences to enable closely fought giant siege battles. 

The addition of a new pool of powerful mercenaries that is earned through invasions and battles at the Great Bastion is intended to demonstrate a way that the mechanic could be turned from solely a one sided army spawner into something that can be turned into providing a reward for the other parts of the campaign.

The mod adds an additional faction effect for Miao Ying to unlock new unusual locations in the Great Bastion (IE only). It also enables and fully integrates this updated Great Bastion mechanic for Yuan Bo, who earns an extra turn reduction for his Stone and Steel token cooldown whenever he wins a battle in the Great Bastion provinces. For non Shadows of Change version see the no SoC submod. The key features of the mod are:

[h2]The Threats[/h2]

[b]Increased Invader Variety:[/b]
Invasion forces can now spawn as any mono Chaos God as well as the Daemons of Chaos, the Chaos Dwarfs, Warriors of Chaos, and Norsca, all with full DLC rosters. All armies have randomised units and increase in strength over time.

[b]Ongoing Invasions[/b]
While an Invasion is ongoing the invaders will spawn additional reinforcement forces every 4 turns. Reinforcements are not necessarily the same race that attacks at the start of the invasion. Destroy all invaders once and for all to end the invasion.

[b]Random Assaults[/b]
Other races bent on destruction will now launch surprise attacks on the Great Bastion. Fend off the Beastmen, Greenskins, Skaven, Ogres, Dark Elves, Lizardmen and Cathayan Rebels when they threaten your or your allies gates. Random assaults won’t occur while an invasion is ongoing.

[b]Dynamic Threat Meter[/b]
As the average level of Chaos corruption across your provinces rises the constant threat meter will also increase - from the flat 6 to up to 10%. Control the corruption across your provinces to slow the growth of the threat meter.

[b]Fixed bugs that were reducing the number of invasion forces[/b]
The vanilla version of the Great Bastion mechanic includes 2 bugs which could reduce the number of Invasion armies spawned by up to 2 forces per invasion. This mod fixes those parts of the script ensuring the full number are spawned.

Oh and Zhatan will no longer destroy the invasion faction all by himself for you any more…

[h2]The Defences[/h2]
All 4 building chains in the Defence super chain have been upgraded to provide an additional powerful defensive buff or reward.

[b]Sanctum chain[/b] - automatically summon an emergency force of reinforcements whenever a Gate settlement is besieged. The force grows in strength as you level up the building.

[b]Fortification chain[/b] - unlocks a unique and powerful ancillary and banner for each level of the chain, with different ancillaries across the 3 gates.

[b]Artisan chain[/b] - provides an additional specialised buff to the forces of Yin garrisoned in a gate region to help you rain death on approaching enemies.

[b]Refectory chain[/b] - provides access to the ‘Great Bastion Veterans’, an additional mercenary unit variant of several Cathayan units with access to a unique ability that increases their melee attack and defence when they are docked on a wall or a hard point. Increase your chances of recruiting these mercenaries by levelling up the building.

[h3]Miao Ying faction bonus[/h3]
As castellan of the Great Bastion Miao Ying has an additional faction effect that gives her a chance of spawning new unusual locations only available in the Great Bastion provinces. These buildings provide additional garrison troops and unique faction bonuses. This works for the AI too.

[h3]Stone and Steel[/h3]
The dual cities of Wei-Jin and Nan-Gau stand ready to aid in the defence of Cathay. While these cities are held in any Cathayan faction’s hands they will each provide a random buff every turn to the Yang and Yin units in the Great Bastion garrisons. However if a city falls then the buff they provide to the Great Bastion will fail also.

[h3]Hold the Door[/h3]
If your allies have a Sanctum building they will summon you an emergency force to help defend their settlement as well. At the start of the game you will get the option to automatically declare war on any faction that attacks a gate settlement. 

Sick of the Imperial Wardens failing their one job? Now you can help them out directly instead. Prefer the challenge of fighting off Chaos forces and Sniktch and Lokhir Felheart at the same time - just leave them to fight alone.

[h3]Immunity to attrition[/h3]
Builds in the popular requirement to disable siege attrition to any garrisoned forces.

[h3]Just Turn It Off[/h3]
If you prefer to take a break from the waves of invasions capture the 7 regions closest to the Great Bastion (Bloodwind Keep to the Stonesky Foothills on Immortal Empires and Red Wastes to Eastern Steppes on Realm of Chaos). This will keep the threat meter at 0. If you ever want to start the invasions up again just abandon one of those settlements and the threat meter will begin to increase.

And more…

[b]Compatibility[/b]
This will overwrite any changes made by mods that modifies the wh3_campaign_great_bastion.lua script.
Works for Immortal Empires, Immortal Empires Expanded and Realm of Chaos.

3318719948.description:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3318719948][img]https://i.postimg.cc/FFM0JD4F/underempire.png[/img][/url]
[i]"Is it possible that the Skaven are no less than a manifestation, a dark and morbid reflection of man's cities, his civilisation, even his fears? Are not the Skaven, their religion, and their foul dank world not just a growing shadow and a dark twin of mans deep and barren nature?"[/i] 

[h2]Grudge update![/h2]
[i]Behind closed doors, far from the Council of Thirteen’s prying eyes and ears, a new clan is on the rise. Once among the most fervent of the Horned Rat’s children whose zealotry even rivaled the Pestilent Brotherhood, Clan Grudge now serves a new master. The clan’s zeal has not diminished, but their devotion to the Horned Rat has long since perished. In its place burns a far more exquisite fire: the worship of the Dark Prince himself – Slaanesh, Master of Excess, Pain and Pleasure.

Under the cunning guidance of Grey Seer Rathan, the clan has cast aside the old ways and fully embraced the hedonistic and decadent practices of Slaanesh. Their warrens echo with screams and laughter while the air is thick with a cloying scent of perfume mixed with blood and musk.

No longer a mere skaven, Rathan now bears the touch of the Dark Prince, his body elongated and graceful in unnatural ways. None truly know the ancient Grey Seer’s origin or age, but some whisper of an immortality granted by his new master. Rathan stands as living proof of the new covenant, a leader of razor intellect and predatory wisdom refined and molded by Slaanesh’s blessings into something new and majestic.

As Clan Grudge’s connection to Slaanesh deepens, so too does their ability to tear open the veil and unleash the armies of Slaanesh upon the world.[/i]

[h2]Skaven Clans IE[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Clan Pestilens[/b] - From the infested ruins of Oyxl, Lord Skrolk spreads the plagues of Pestilens throughout Lustria's heartlands.
[*][b]Bubonic Court of Nurglitch[/b] - Sitting atop the Altar of the Horned Rat, Nurglitch and his Bubonic Court plot to win the third Skaven Civil War.
[*][b]Clan Morbidus[/b] - Having stolen the Temple Avenue of Gold from the Lizardmen, Arch Pontifex Sitch hunts for greater treasures in the Southlands.
[*][b]Clan Septik[/b] - With eyes focused on the north from the Altar of Ultimate Darkness, Grrzk Roteye seeks a secure base in Naggarond from which to conquer the foul Dark Elves.
[*][b]Clan Skrat[/b] - Nestled in the plague-infested ruins of the Dusk Peaks, Poxtooth schemes his next assault on the Cult of Sotek and the Lizardmen.
[*][b]Clan Verms[/b] - Huddled beneath Karag Dron, his last refuge from the fury of the Council of Thirteen, Blight Tenscratch quivers with fear as he hears the marching paws of Clan Volkn, come to burn him from his nest.
[*][b]Clan Treecherik[/b] - Gristl Twitchslice has managed to hold on to his seat at the head of Clan Treecherik in Flayed Rock for several days now, making him the most successful lord of the clan in some time. If he survives for another week or two, he will have lasted for an entire month, the best in twenty years.
[*][b]Clan Crooktail[/b] - Deep beneath the Chaos Wastes, at the bottom of the Dragon Crossroads, lies the hold of Clan Crooktail. From there, Wastelord Viciss Baukis plots the demise of any who seek to do him harm. 
[*][b]Clan Vrrtkin[/b] - Sent to the Plain of Dogs by Clan Skryre to devastate an upstart Skaven clan, Trikstab Gridnode and Clan Vrrtkin have been given free reign to deploy their toxic weaponry on all the other inhabitants of the area. Once the Skaven are dead.
[*][b]Clan Fester[/b] - From the ruined depths of Karak Azgaraz, Skarrik Spinemanglr and his horde of corrupted ratmen swear death to the Empire of Man.
[*][b]Clan Grudge[/b] - The decadence and decay that accompanies the Dragons of Cathay has rubbed off on the Skaven who inhabit the area, causing something most strange to occur - beneath Xen Wu there is a Cult of Slaanesh... led by a rat!
[*][b]Clan Kreepus[/b] - Sent to Mordheim by Clan Eshin, Misericorde of Clan Kreepus mines the valuable warpstone as he fends off the ever-encroaching advances of the Empire and others who would come to take his supplies.
[*][b]Clan Feesik[/b] - As a thrall clan to Pestilens, Clan Feesik has little independence or resources. Only by the most cagey tactics and snivelling kowtowing to their betters can they hope to survive.
[*][b]Clan Gangrous[/b] - From beneath Titan's Notch, Szik Deadeye and the mutilated rodents of Clan Gangrous plot a war against the surrounding Ogre Kingdoms.
[*][b]Clan Gnaw[/b] - Duneskulk Skreekblade and Clan Gnaw roam the Badlands from their base beneath Bitterstone Mine, hunting the creatures and Greenskin tribes that dwell in amongst those battered landscapes.
[*][b]Clan Skurvy[/b] - The waters off the coast of Naggaroth have seen the strange emergence of a half-dead fleet of rats, noxious and piratical, raiding their landscape.
[*][b]Clan Ferrik[/b] - From beneath the conquered Dwarf hold of Karak Dum, Forgemaster Iron-Skull plots his next raid upon the hated Dawi. Only when every Dwarf is enslaved and working in his mines will this Skaven be satisfied. 
[*][b]Clan Haematoma[/b] - From the swampy jungles of Lustria, Clan Haematoma prepares to surge forth like a crimson tide, their twisted minds and blood-drenched legions driven by unshakable fury. Wielding the blessings of their infernal patron, they aim to annihilate all who refuse to kneel before the dominion of blood and conquest. 
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[h3]Question[/h3] 
"Hey guys, how do I recruit these Chaos damned deserters of Abhorash's Path?" 
		
[h3]Answer[/h3] 
The BKH infantry units can be found within the Champions of Chaos DLC Warband recruitment pool. They will populate in all provinces that have [b]Vampire Corruption rating above 50[/b], and in regions marked with the [b]important Vampire Keep icon[/b] The keeps are a safety net so even if you run out of Vampire Corruption these special places will still provide you with steady supply of units for your armies. A full list of regions can be found here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3357763311/4635985982183815940/][b]Click Me[/b][/url]. Please also note that the only way to acquire the second units is by utilizing the war band mechanics and upgrading the base infantry into their next form.

[h3]Question[/h3] 
"Hey guys, how do I recruit these new Legendary Lords?" 

[h3]Answer[/h3] 
The Legendary Lords are part of a quest battle chain that comes from 4 new unusual locations that can be found at the following regions: 
[list]
[*]Nuln
[*]Slyvania
[*]Carcassonne 
[*]Galleons Graveyard
[/list]

[h3]Question[/h3]
"Who exactly can recruit these?"

[h3]Answer[/h3] 
The BKH units [i]should[/i] work for all chaos factions. The Undivided Warriors of Chaos Legendary Lords Belakor, Archaon, Sigvald, and Kholek are able to recruit any of the 4 Mono God corrupted BKH units. Valkia, Azazel, Vilitch, and Festus are each limited to their specific patron God's corrupted BKH unit. There will be an option within MCT that will allow you to enable the other corrupted infantry units for the four Mono God Legendary Lords. Please note though that if you use this option said Legandary Lords may not have tech upgrades that would have been available, as they would have been for their native corrupted gods faction.

3386989556.title: Tabletop Caps: Reborn
3386989556.description:
[h1][b]Tabletop Caps: Reborn[/b][/h1]
This mod here is a reborn version of Tabletop Caps, the excellent mod from DrunkFlamingo. As DF has stepped away from modding, he's asked me to help maintain Tabletop Caps. You can look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789896406]original mod here.[/url]

The mod will remain mostly to-form - it's unlikely I'll be making huge sweeping changes - but I may change design where it suits my preferences and try to slowly adapt the code to forms I'm more comfortable with using. My plan is to ensure functionality and improve quality of life before any gameplay-changing decisions, and any of those will be modifiable using MCT.

[b]All existing TTC submods are "forward-compatible" to this version, and that will remain true unless I make breaking changes.[/b]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
This mod adds army-level Unit Caps for all factions, inspired by the Warhammer Fantasy Battles Tabletop rules for army composition.

All units from the base game are assigned one of three categories: core, special, or rare. An army can have unlimited core units, while special or rare units are capped by the number of special or rare points available to each army. These delineations provide gameplay-driven restrictions on army design, which are applied to human and computer players in a campaign.

When the recruitment panel is open, you will be able to see the costs of each unit displayed on the unit cards, both for the unit options available to recruit and for the units already in your army, and the total and remaining special and rare points for that army.

The goal for the mod is that you will have to make some hard choices about which elite units you want to bring, and that both you and the AI will field no ‘doomstacks’, instead bringing balanced forces. The ultimate goal is that a much higher share of your battles will be interesting fights between two armies with reasonable compositions.

[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]
Core, special and rare distinctions are decided based on tabletop precedent and game balance. In cases where certain units diverge substantially from tabletop, they are balanced according to how they function in game, and are subject to change after heavy argument.

If you'd like to change the cost of various units, you can use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3348616922]this WH3 mod[/url] which adds an in-game editor to tweak TTC values for each unit.

You can find a full list of the current unit costs for tabletop caps on [url=http://ttc-costs.surge.sh/]this website[/url] which was created by the illustrious bapplebo on the Modding Den. 

All limits are enforced for the AI just like for humans - including Slaaneshi Devotee armies, Khorne army summons, rogue armies, and challenge armies. There are a few things in-game which ignore the caps values - such as quest battles.

You may use MCT to change a few settings - such as changing the amount of points available to an army, or to disable it for the AI.

[h1]Bugs / Requests / Suggestions[/h1]
If you've got a bug to report, a feature request to make, a balance tweak, or some other suggestion, please use the forms on this mod's [url=https://github.com/chadvandy/groovy_ttc/issues/new/choose]GitHub Issues.[/url] It's very hard to keep track of reports through Steam comments.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
This mod should be compatible with all other mods. However, custom units added by other mods will be considered core (unlimited) units, unless the mod author specifically adds their units to the Tabletop Caps system. If you come across a unit mod that you’d like to work better with this mod, let me know and I’ll see if I can help the author set that up. 

This mod should be compatible with multiplayer games in consecutive turns mode. Simultaneous turns mode should be fine too, in theory, but I haven’t tested it and it is very new, so consider yourself a beta tester if you’re taking this into a simultaneous turns MP game.

[h1]Mod Configuration[/h1]
This mod has settings available in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815354316]Groovy's Mod Configuration Tool.[/url]

[h1]Thanks to [/h1]
DrunkFlamingo, for being an incredible pillar in the Total War modding community and all the hard work he's done in gaining and spreading wisdom.
Cataph, both for help with balance and for creating the new mod image.
Bapp, for creating the webapp mentioned above, where you can view unit costs.
The gaggle of Modding Den for bouncing ideas off of and helping with design and feedback.
Purpa the Catt, ooka chonk chonk, oh oh oh!

[h1]Links[/h1]
[url=https://github.com/chadvandy/groovy_ttc]Github Repo[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/moddingden]The Modding Den Community Discord[/url]
[url=http://ttc-costs.surge.sh/]Bapp's Tabletop Caps Costs Site[/url]

3397481450.title: [9.x.x] Land Encounters And Points Of Interest - Events, Towers, Taverns, Boons & Curses + IEE + TOW
3397481450.description:
Credit to the original mod author, [b]diagonal_zero[/b]. Original mod at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833501876]Land Encounters And Points Of Interest[/url]. This is standalone, so do not enable both.

[b]Needs a new campaign.[/b] The latest rework changed too much for older saves. See the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3397481450/592943711836517175]pinned topic in the Discussions tab[/url][/b] for everything that changed.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]What it does[/h1]

The campaign map fills up with places worth a detour. Battles to fight, treasure to dig up, towers to climb, forges to claim and taverns to run. Almost every choice is a trade-off, and your lords pick up lasting boons and curses along the way.

[h2]Encounters[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Battle spots[/b]: walk onto one and a dilemma shows the enemy before you choose to fight or avoid it. Rarer battles turn up more on higher difficulties, including allies in trouble that you can rescue.
[*] [b]Pre-battle offers[/b]: pay to tip the fight. Bribe guards, thin their ranks, hire allies or bless your banners. Some cost gold, some cost blood, and some make the fight harder for a bigger prize.
[*] [b]Missions[/b]: optional goals for the fight, like keeping your lord alive or killing their champion, that pay out if you meet them.
[*] [b]Battle modifiers[/b]: rare twists on a fight. Storms, last stands, whole armies of a faction's famous units and more.
[*] [b]Spoils[/b]: a won battle can let you pick a reward from the field.
[*] [b]Treasure sites[/b]: 16 kinds of site, each with its own special choice and two more drawn from a pool of treasure and realm offers. Wake a guardian for its prize, loot a cursed shrine, or blackmail a governor.
[/list]

[h2]Towers[/h2]
One tower stands in each map zone. Delve floor by floor, with each floor a battle somewhere new on the map and a growing haul. After each win, pick one offer to help the climb or leave with what you have. Lose a floor and you lose the haul.

[h2]Smithies[/h2]
Claim a Smithy for free items and tribute. Its Work Orders kit out your whole army, the forge can be rushed when it is cooling, and the smith can temper a boon or break a curse. Upgrade it for better items, and hold it with its region for income and a stronger garrison. Your best Smithy also offers Smith's Commissions, missions that pay an item. Enemies can besiege it.

[h2]Taverns[/h2]
Each map zone has a racial Tavern and a neutral one. Hire mercenaries and veterans, try the drinks and games at the bar, take bounties and quests from the Tavern Keepers' Guild, and visit the hedge-witch to lift a curse.

[h2]Boons and Curses[/h2]
Lords carry lasting boons that grow as they win battles, and curses that get worse over time until something lifts them. They come from hard fights, pacts, Towers, Taverns and treasure, up to level 5 each. Each one shows as a trait on the lord, and an icon in the army's effects names its level and counts down to its next change.

[h2]Army spells[/h2]
Over 400 army spells, from every lore of magic, bound item and army ability, can be won or bought for your armies.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Random Encounter Force Generation System[/h1]
Enemy armies are built from a gold budget and an army recipe, so a fight can be a shield wall, a horde of monsters, a gunline or a race's iconic units. It can pull lords, heroes and units from a lot of other mods. Check the [b]Supported Mods[/b] thread in the [b]Discussions[/b] tab for the list.

[h1]Settings[/h1]
Everything can be tuned through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021]MCT[/url]. Each feature has its own page to turn it off or adjust it, with an in-game guide to how it works and what every offer does. Smithies and Taverns can be removed from the map entirely.

New to the mod? The game's help pages have a LEAPOI section that walks through every feature, and a message at the start of a new campaign links to it.

[h1]Changes to the base game[/h1]
These reach past the mod's own events, so they are worth knowing if you run other mods that touch the same things.
[list]
[*] [b]Dilemma layout[/b]: when a dilemma has more than three rows of choices, or would not fit on your screen, its choices go into a scrolling list. This applies to every dilemma in the game, not just this mod's. Shorter dilemmas look the same as before.
[*] [b]Battle scripts for allied and enemy armies[/b]: the mod adds battle scripts that load in every battle but only act in its own fights. There they bring an allied army onto the field at the start and send it at the enemy, have the enemy charge in relief battles, and run the battle buffs, missions and modifiers. An allied battle also cuts your reinforcement timer by a random 0 to 100%.
[*] [b]Objectives button[/b]: in the mod's fights that carry buffs, missions or modifiers, a small button next to the menu bar hides or shows the battle objectives panel.
[/list]

[h1]Good to know[/h1]
[list]
[*] Compatible with Realm of Chaos, Immortal Empires, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493]Immortal Empires Expanded[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3081800026]The Old World[/url].
[*] Can run alongside Murranji's encounter mod. You will get events from both.
[*] I have no idea if this works in multiplayer. Random rolls are built to stay in sync, but it is untested.
[*] AI factions take and upgrade Smithies and Taverns too, and take a flat reward from treasure sites.
[*] Item rewards can be pretty much any item in the game, including items added by other mods. Only items your faction can use and does not own yet are offered, and tougher kinds of battle give rarer ones.
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes units appear in factions that do not make sense. Units are sorted into factions by their key names, which relies on other mod author

3485519396.title: Campaign AI Tweaks
3485519396.description:
[h3]Updated for 9.0.4[/h3]

I recommend the collection linked above for the most complete experience.

This mod attempts to push the campaign AI towards certain behaviours and touches on faction potential.

[u]It is possible this mod will desync your multiplayer campaigns. I don't play multiplayer so I don't know how it would affect it.[/u]

[u]DO NOT use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3594429287]AI camping settlement fix[/url] with this mod. My mod already provides a workaround for the AI afk bug, so adding that mod on top is unnecessary and may cause strange, unintended behavior in the AI when combined with mine.[/u]

[u]This mod is NOT COMPATIBLE with any other AI behavior mod. DO NOT use those mods at the same time as this one. Those include "Very Aggressive AI", "AI army tasks", "Ultra aggressive AI", "Hecleas' Overhaul" and literally any mod that might make changes to the AI unless it's those included in the mod collection above.[/u] 

Compatible with SFO after having a quick look at their mod pack. They don't seem to have any AI related changes there.

[h2]Features[/h2]

1 - Less AI sitting around a settlement with multiple armies afking for multiple turns. A bug CA has been trying to fix for a while now.

2 - AI will prefer to occupy settlements more unless they are threatened by a nearby enemy army.

3 - Chaos Dwarfs AI will heavily prefer to build towers in province capital settlements when occupying them post-battle.

4 - AI will declare wars more often, earlier and giving priority to hated enemies. At the same time the AI is more reluctant to declare war on factions with friendly relationships, player included. They will also be less interested in fighting against their same race, except for warmongering factions such as greenskins.

5 - Increased the "anti-player bias" in diplomacy in general, moreso in harder difficulties, so the AI is able to better judge the threat the player represents.

6 - Nearly maxed the percentage of income the AI is allowed to use for army recruitment and construction.

7 - AI will comply with alliance war coordination targets set by the player.

8 - Slightly increased faction potential for minor factions.
------ To opt out of this feature, enable this [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3540536228]submod[/url][/u] alongside the main mod.

9 - AI will be slightly less reckless when deciding if it is strong enough to engage enemy forces, generally leading the AI towards bringing more armies to a war front and keeping them closer for safety.

10 - When playing as Warriors of Chaos, the starting nearby norsca vassal will be slightly stronger. Strong enough to have an edge vs other minor factions, but not enough to consistently beat major factions.
------ To opt out of this feature, enable this [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3540518852]submod[/url][/u] alongside the main mod.

11 - AI will destroy discovered foreign slots more often (cults, undercities).

12 - Warriors of Chaos AI will prefer to leave ruins in their wake, for their vassals to colonize.

13 - Allowed Warriors of Chaos factions to send lone lords to complete tasks outside their territory on their own, to better fit their recruitment methods. Before they would sit at home for way too many turns waiting forever to build a reasonable sized army before moving out. Now, they recruit on the move as they visit regions with fresh recruitment pools. Nurgle factions also partially benefit from this.

14 - The AI is now much more willing to colonize ruins if armies nearby aren't under immediate threat.

15 - Drastically reduced chances that Slaanesh AI spawns  disciple armies, avoiding an issue where they stop recruiting regular armies when weaker disciple armies are present. Also avoiding disciple army afk spam.

16 - Edited the modifiers that control how much diplomatic value the AI gives to settlements when trading them. Highly recommend using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2974581654]Lycia's Ai Construction mod[/url] with this.

17 - Adjusted the overall balance of the autoresolve involving the player and the AI, generally making AR more favorable towards the AI in an attempt to match the AI's judgement of balance of power. Reducing suicidal AI attacks on the player and in cases where the player still gets a victory, it will come with a non trivial cost.

18 - Added the option to "Loot and Colonise" to all norscan factions; this includes the player. The purpose of this change is to balance the logic of the construction of chaos god altars vs core norscan settlements. Norscan AI will now strongly prefer to occupy norscan homeland regions as a normal norscan settlement, utilizing its new loot and colonise option. Outside norscan homeland, it will be random if they build altars or core settlements; slightly skewed towards settlements. However, they will be strongly pushed towards building core settlements in province capitals, even when outside norscan homelands. This will improve the performance of Norscan AI and their recruitment variety

Some of my other mods if you're interested.

3601814378.title: Treasures of the Endless Deeps
3601814378.description:
What´s this mod doing? ➡️ [b]Adding new magic items, item sets, ancillaries and spells as reward for defeating the roving pirates[/b]

[hr][/hr]
⚠️ Note: This is an improved Version of my first mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3578974048]Treasures of the Endless Oceans[/url] 
[b]Do not use both![/b] ⚠️

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Defeating Pirates should feel rewarding![/h2]
The purpose of this mod is to make hunting down the roving pirate factions actually worth it.
It adds a set of powerful items you’ll receive for defeating them.

What´s the difference to my original mod? 
🔥[b]There are now 7 reward sets, each containing 7 unique items.[/b]  

[h3]How it works:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Defeat one of the roving pirate factions.
[*]Each faction holds seven possible treasures - one will be awarded at random.
[*]The granted item determines which of the seven reward sets you’ll follow for the rest of your campaign.
[*]Defeating the remaining pirate crews will then grant you their set-specific item.
[*]Once all seven pirate lords are sunk, you’ll complete the collection: four main items, one arcane item, and two followers.
[*]Finally, those once-pointless pirate fights will feel truly worth your effort.
[/olist]


[h3]Translations:[/h3]
🇩🇪 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3603815575]German[/url]
🇷🇺 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3682644193]Russian[/url]
🇮🇹 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3628931294]Italian[/url]
🇨🇳 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3630027609]Chinese[/url]
🇪🇸 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3633647807]Spanish[/url]
🇰🇷 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3652632252]Korean[/url]
🇫🇷 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3665509160]French[/url]


⚠️ [b]You would love to have something like this for ALL factions? Try this:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3626991681] Shadows of the Lost[/url]

[hr][/hr]
Q&A: 
[b]Q: Why did I choose to publish this as a new mod and not an update to the original?[/b]
A: I didn´t want to break any running campaign. Also I don´t want to change what´s working well and people enjoy. Just because I consider this an better version of my mod, it doesn´t mean everyone does and those who don´t can stick to the original.

[b]Q: Do the items from the original mod still exist?[/b]
A: Yes, they are part of the new sets, but I reworked some of their stats. That´s why using both mods will break the game.

[b]Q: Does this work with running campaigns?[/b]
A: Yes, already defeated pirates will respawn, so you can get their item.

[b]Q: Does this work only with Immortal Empires?[/b]
A: Yes, since those pirates do only exist in IE as far as I´m aware.

[b]Q: Is this compatible with other mods?[/b]
A: It should be working with almost everything, except the original Treasures of the Endless Oceans. CTD is reported with "Gunfire of the Abyss", likely because both mods try manipulating the roving pirates. 

➡️ For SFO exists a submod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3785448792

[b]Q: Does this work in multiplayer?[/b]
A: Yes. Pirates will respawn until all players have their respective item.

[b]Q: Can I just reload a save before defeating the first pirate to get into another reward-set?[/b]
A: No, that´s not how CA´s rng works. But if you desperatly want to get a different set for your current campaign, try this: [spoiler]Do any Action that forces the game to recalculate (e.g. proceed to next round, other fights, etc.) before the battle.[/spoiler]

[b]Q: How many things does this mod add?[/b]
A: There are in total 49 items (35 magic items and 14 follower). There are seven 4-piece item sets included. Fully equipped, each of the sets grant you a powerful spell.

[b]Q: Is this mod balanced?[/b]
A: For sure some of the items and the spells are powerful, but I tried my best to find the sweet spot between balance and being satisfyingly rewarded for hunting down those pirates. If anything breaks the game for you, let me know.

[b]Q: I have a full set equipped, but why is no spell showing up in battle?[/b]
A: Check if you have those little arrows below the wind of magic gauge, there you can switch "spell lore pages". (Miao Ying sometimes has to use dragon form for the new spells to show up, idk why)

[b]Q: What if an Ai-faction destroys a pirate?[/b]
A: [strike]Well, in that unfortunate case you won´t be able to get all 7 rewards, naturally. I played a lot of campaigns and never saw it happen, so I hope this isn´t an issue at all. I´ll try to find a way to deal with this, if it happens often reportedly.[/strike] No longer an issue since the pirates respawn if you don't have their item yet.

[hr][/hr]
💀 [b]Personal Note:[/b]
This is my second mod. I’m still learning, but I’m having a lot of fun doing it. Let me know in the comments if something doesn´t work as intended. Any feedback is welcome😊

[b]My other mods:[/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3626991681] Shadows of the Lost[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3674295514]Just More Items[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3578974048]Treasures of the Endless Oceans[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3675409783]No More (Un)Common Item Drops[/url]

Recommended additional mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3586484854]Roving Pirates Relocated[/url] by Aipe


Have fun 🔥

Skulls

3607399515.title: Lizardmen Units - Amazons
3607399515.description:
[i] "Twice during this stretch of our journey we come into contact with the warrior women known as Amazons, and on both occasions I don't mind admitting they scared the living snot out of me. The first time, it was a drug-fuelled berserker, lithe and fast, yet gripped by the desire to shed blood. Purple and blue feathers hung from intricate plaits in her hair." 

—The journal of Johann Besksbein, Day 48 [/i]

[b]My first ever unit mod![/b]

Still waiting patiently till the OvN team ports over the Amazons faction. So in the meantime, I decided to take a stab at creating units myself! I went scrounging for online for similar mods and found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/185] taraanis' mod[/url] that adds Amazonian Warriors to the Lizardmen. That was the foundation of this mod, without it - I don't think it this would have been possible. If you want to expand the roster and add Amazon Warriors, I highly recommend you check it out! provided a link at the bottom of the description.
