3645642628.title: [DEPRECATED] Saxit's Beastmen Cockatrice Bug Fix
3645642628.description:
!!IMPORTANT!! For 7.0.3, CA has fixed this issue with 7.1, so don't start a new game with this fix when that update is released. I'll leave it up for a while so that people who started with this can finish their campaigns without errors. Since this mod actually do very little in the databases it's safe to keep using it if you want to (CA did exactly the same as I did, basically). 

Beastmen can't currently buy the Cockatrice units.

There are two cockatrice beastmen units in data: wh3_dlc24_bst_mon_cockatrice and wh3_dlc27_bst_mon_cockatrice

The dlc24 version is what the building is pointing to, but the dlc27 is what is allowed for beastmen. 

The dlc24 version is now the allowed version.

The difference between these units as far as I can tell is that dlc27 is 50 gold more in mp and has no siege. Both units point to the same land_unit entry for other stats.

Should work for an ongoing game.
If you had version 1 of the mod and updated to version 2, you might get an issue with on going recruitment (i.e. 1 turn left out of the 2 needed) because version 1 pointed the recruitment building to dlc27 instead. 

Conflicts: It only adds wh3_dlc24_bst_mon_cockatrice to the beastman group in units_to_groupings_military_permissions_tables, as well as telling the building that it can recruit wh3_dlc24_bst_mon_cockatrice in the building_units_allowed_table. The latter is actually the default values, to make sure no other mod fix overwrites the same keys.

There shouldn't be any conflicts unless they change the same keys in these tables.

Disclaimer: This is just a bug fix that anyone could have done. As such, if anyone else makes a mod and it causes a conflict with this, they're free to incorporate this fix into their mod. Though a mention would be nice. :)

Thanks to:

@Fenrir4life for telling me that the capacity upgrade didn't do anything in the first version of the fix.

@stormwings for telling me that there was an issue with other mods overwriting the building defaults of allowing the dlc24 unit.

3662333210.title: The Ubersreik Five
3662333210.description:
[h1]The Ubersreik Five: Recruitment Update[/h1]

[b][i]Update: This update introduces a fully scripted recruitment story arc for the Ubersreik Five, designed to capture the feeling of a small band of heroes fighting impossible odds — very much in the spirit of Vermintide.

When your Legendary Lord reaches Rank 5, a new recruitment dilemma will trigger. Your lord will have the opportunity to teleport to Ubersreik, arriving without their army — only the lord and any accompanying heroes. There, they will join the U5 in a sequence of escalating battles against Skaven, Chaos, and finally Undead forces.

NOTE: Karl gets an XP boost after his first battle to get him quickly to Level 5, this is to avoid a desync in the minicampaign if he is seiging Ubersreik at the time the event dilemma fires. It also provides some compensation that Karl faces quite a few early enemies, and is pushed by extra enemies in the mini-campaign.

You can also decline this initial dilemma and skip the U5 mini-campaign. In this case, you will miss the rewards and traits that come from the fights for Ubersreik and Helmgart, but you will be able to recruit the U5, and they will show up after a few turns.

The entire mini-arc plays out on the campaign map, not through the mission system. This allows for a fully sandbox experience where you decide how to approach each fight. My intention was for the arc to feel like a Vermintide-style gauntlet — a handful of heroes carving through overwhelming numbers — but you are free to recruit additional units if you want. How you survive the arc is entirely up to you.

Completing the storyline grants unique rewards for both your Legendary Lord and the U5.
This update includes a significant amount of scripting. I’ve tested it extensively with a small, controlled mod list, and everything functions as intended. However, it’s impossible to account for every mod combination or every creative way players might approach the scenario, so please keep that in mind. Just a note that the recruitment chain relies on settlement keys on the vanilla IE map, and other mods that alter these are likely to cause issues. It is compatible with 'The Old World" map.

The full U5 are available to the same factions as previously, and Sienna can still be recruited by the VC, and Kerilliann by Wood, High, and Dark Elves. I have also scripted it with MP campaigns in mind, and now only one player in MP will be able to recruit the U5, though all players will see the dilemmas. Should also be Save Game-safe, and if you are well into a campaign, you should not see anything different with this update installed. If you wish to see the new story, you will need to start a new campaign.

I hope you enjoy this mini‑campaign and the Vermintide flavour it brings to your campaign. 

Thank you so much to everyone who has tried the mod, and thank you for all the fantastic suggestions and helpful reports. I will keep updating this to include as many of those suggestions and fixes as I can, but it is not a fast process! [/i][/b]


[b]⚔️ Features[/b]
- Unique Heroes: Kerillian, Bardin Goreksson, Victor Saltzpyre, Sienna Fuegonasus, Markus Kruber.
- Unique Skill Tree & Abilities: Skills and abilities that reflect their careers as Waystlaker, Shade, Slayer, Outcast Engineer, Witch Hunter, Warrior Priest, Battle Mage, Necromancer, Mercenary, Grail Knight.
- Unique Ancillaries: Custom items that synergise with their career roles.

[b]📜 Notes[/b]
- Scripted for multiplayer compatibility, though I haven’t been able to test MP. It should work—please let me know if you encounter any issues.
- Compatible with most mods (Do not use my previous Bardin mod, as he is fully included here).
- Designed for Immortal Empires campaigns.
- AI factions will not recruit these heroes — they are player‑exclusive.
- Recruitment availability:
                     Bardin, Markus, and Victor: Empire, Bretonnia, Dwarfs, Kislev, Grand Cathay
                     Kerillian: As above but also High Elves, Wood Elves, Dark Elves
                     Sienna: Empire, Bretonnia, Dwarfs, Kislev, Grand Cathay, Vampire Counts
- Balance tuned for single‑player Immortal Empires (they are meant to be powerful heroes).
- Feedback is always welcome and very useful — and thank you to everyone who has supported my mods and workshop!

German translation thanks to Balthasar23th - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3688748704

Currently on the to‑do list (this is my planned order, but these things take time and stuff changes!)
• 	Several interacting heroes for Vampire Counts (this is a bigger project, and hard to say when)
• 	Boudica (Beasts Sorceress) for Dark Elves
• 	Compilations and updates to older mods for improved MP compatibility and skill dumps
• 	Additional heroes for Chaos and Chaos Dwarfs

Thank you to everyone who has tried my mods, it is appreciated!

3669446827.title: Nuke Be Gone！
3669446827.description:
Mod Description: No More Tactical Nukes
Damn those nukes!
Damn those Nurgle shit bombs!
Damn the Chaos shorts bombardment!
Damn the Tzeentch's Storm of Fire!
Get them out of here!

CA has introduced numerous "unit-deleting" abilities into Total War: Warhammer III, leaving traditional multi-entity units (infantry, cavalry, etc.) in an incredibly awkward and vulnerable position. To restore the tactical viability and enjoyment of using these units, this mod removes the following army abilities/map-wide bombardments:

Tamurkhan’s shit rain

Ikit’s Doomrockets

Tzeentch’s Storm of Fire

Chaos Dwarf Dreadquake bombardments

Important Note:
The goal of this mod is not to limit the player’s power, but to prevent the AI from instantly deleting your frontline without counterplay. If you are currently playing as one of the factions mentioned above and wish to use these abilities yourself, please temporarily disable this mod.

Mod 介绍：
该死的耗子核弹！
该死的纳垢屎弹！
该死的混沌矮子轰炸！
该死的奸奇火焰风暴！
全部给我滚开！

CA给战锤3塞入了大量的兵线删除技能，使得传统的多模组部队陷入了非常尴尬的境地。为了挽救多模组部队的体验，本mod移除了塔尔木可汗的屎弹，伊克特核弹，奸奇火焰风暴以及混沌矮人的军队地图炮。

注意，本mod的初衷不是为了限制玩家，而是限制AI大规模删除玩家兵线。如果你在游玩以上提到的几个派系，请暂时停用此mod。

3681602385.title: 2 Extra Building Slots for Major Settlements
3681602385.description:
Simply adds 2 extra building slots for all major settlements, i.e all provincial capitals. This means that most major settlements go from 8 building slots to 10, whereas special settlements like Altdorf or Wood elf forests go from 10 to 12.

I made this mod because most other building slot extension mods add way too many and become pretty overpowered. 2 extra, in my experience, is pretty balanced and is how I prefer it, but I couldn't find an actual mod that only adds 2.

Compatible with IEE and Old World.

The mod was created using another mod as a base (with me simply tweaking the numbers), but since I originally made this mod a year ago, I don't actually remember which mod I used. Credit goes to them, whoever they may be.

3716025482.title: Northern Provinces Rework: The City of Smoke (Miao-Ying Vanilla+)
3716025482.description:
[h1]Overview: (V2.1) [u]Now compatible with update 8.0![/u] [/h1]
A Vanilla+ Miao-Ying faction re-work focusing on the industrial aspects of Nan-Gau (the City of Smoke in lore), and it's role in bolstering the Great Bastion and the armies of Cathay.

[h1]New Resources:[/h1]
[h3]Imperial Supplies: [/h3]
- A modified Ivory Road mechanic now lets you gain Imperial Supplies through caravan contracts.
[h3]Ordnance: [/h3]
- New building chains in the City of Smoke convert Imperial Supplies to Ordnance.
- Can be spent in the City of Smoke menu (in a new tab) that give new abilities and boosts to gunpowder units.

[h1]Mechanics:[/h1]
[h3]City of Smoke: [/h3]Construct the Forging Districts landmark in Nan-Gau (as Miao Ying) to unlock the City of Smoke system.
- Expand Nan-Gau with unique “foreign slot” infrastructure (Dwarf Deeps style)
- Access new building chains
- Convert Imperial Supplies into Ordnance
- Invest Ordnance in the new City of Smoke panel (gunnery school style).

[h3]Bastion Fortifications and Storm Dragon's Directives:[/h3]
- Use excess Imperial Supplies or Ordnance to empower the Great Bastion or your armies.
- Be cautious, as usage could attract attention, increasing the Great Bastion Threat level.

[h2]City of Smoke building chains:[/h2]
[h3]Great Forges of Nan-Gau: [/h3]Boosts armour and unit experience
[h3]House of Cloud & Flame: [/h3]Unlocks Sky Lantern & Sky Junk techs and improves global recruitment and trade
[h3]House of Cog & Crane: [/h3]Unlocks infantry gun unit techs and improves reload times
[h3]House of Smoke & Powder: [/h3]Unlocks artillery unit techs and increases ammo and reduces upkeep
[u]City of Smoke effects also scale with the Great Bastion Threat level (higher threat, more bonuses), encouraging balancing of the threat level to get the most out of the boosts.[/u]

[h2]New Generic Buildings:[/h2]
[b]Supply Depot:[/b]
- Consumes Imperial Supplies
- Boosts logistics and removes local climate penalties.
[b]Weapons Merchant:[/b]
- Consumes Ordnance
- Improves settlement defence, boosts nearby armies and provides a small gunpowder garrison

[h2]New Techs:[/h2]
[b]Peasant Production Lines
Supply Depot
Outsourcing
Weapon Merchants
Defender of All Northern Provinces
The Best Defence[/b]


[h2]New Landmarks:[/h2]
[b]Tower of Ashshair (Shang-Yang):[/b]
- Improves Ogre relations, reduces caravan tolls, adds garrison
[b]Paved Ivory Road (Great Hall of Greasus):[/b]
- Increases caravan node skip chance and cargo capacity
[b]Hijacked Convoys (Zharr_Nagrund):[/b]
- Adds additional caravan capacity and increases cargo capacity

[h1]Bonus Features:[/h1]
- Tweaked the Bastion gate garrisons to have a couple more higher-tier units at the higher-tier settlement. (because why were peasants still defending a tier 5 gate settlement)
- If the Imperial Wardens loose a bastion gate to a non-Cathay faction, Miao will get a dilemma to confederate them (penalty free)

[h1]Known Issues and Planned Work (WIP):[/h1]
- The Storm Dragon Directives menu can sometimes let you perform a ritual when none is selected, or won't let you when one is. This can be fixed by unselecting and re-selecting the current army.
- When upgrading the Sky Junks, crane gunners in the Sky Junk also fire rockets (I've tried fixing this the CA approved way but it's not working, oh well, guess you just get MORE ROCKETS)
- Vanilla caravan UI won't support custom resources. I'm trying to modify the base UI, but as a temporary fix, I've adapted the Chaos Dwarf Military Convoys to work for Miao-Ying (a far superior UI anyway).
- I have some ideas for Zhao-Ming and Yuan-Bo's factions too, but in the meantime, check out the awesome mod by 柒里寻风: 'Elixir and Secret: Zhao Ming Faction Expanded'.

[h1]Compatibility: [/h1]
- Should be compatible with most mods, there will be issues with mods that add new Cathay technologies, or change Cathay caravan database entries.
- Is compatible with IEE and SFO (but please let me know if there are any issues with these). *unconfirmed with latest update
- Compatible with Cathay Grand Yin Yang and mostly with Miao Ying Mechanic Expansion: Nan-Gau Workshops (though due to foreign slot clashs, if you want a garden in Nan-Gau, that needs to be built before constructing the City of Smoke)

[h1]Additional Shout Outs:[/h1]
[b]Drunk Flamingo[/b] (Da Modding Den Discord): Providing a UI template for pooled resources
[b]Casualfield [/b]and their mod 'Daemon Portals for Warriors of Chaos', essential for enabling the foreign slots in the City of Smoke, so please check it out! https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3545940377
Generally [b]Da Modding Den Discord [/b]server for helping answer my sometimes daft questions!

3753323752.title: RogueTotalWar: Warhammer Spire
3753323752.description:
[i]A Slay-the-Spire-inspired rogue-lite campaign mode for Total War: Warhammer III.[/i]

Are you tired of campaign runs that take dozens of hours of empire management, expansion, and map-painting?
Have you ever wanted to start a new campaign, only to be discouraged by how long the full campaign experience can become?

Have you ever felt that many mid-tier or transitional units are rarely worth using?
Some units have interesting designs, but because of separate recruitment buildings, better alternatives, or slow campaign progression, they often never get a real chance to shine.

Do you want a rogue-lite mode for Total War: Warhammer III that plays more like the caravan system: fast battles, frequent rewards, constant army-building, and escalating challenges?

Then you are in the right place.

[b]Warhammer Spire[/b] is a rogue-lite campaign experience for Total War: Warhammer III, inspired by [i]Slay the Spire[/i] and the original Cathay caravan system.

In this mod, you do not need to recruit units manually, construct buildings, manage settlements, or paint the campaign map. Instead, you progress through a chain of events and choices: choose your path, build your army, gain random rewards, grow stronger, and keep challenging increasingly powerful enemy armies.

[h2]Core Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Built into the original campaign, but designed as an almost independent gameplay experience. Everything begins with the new [b]Warhammer Spire[/b] button in the lower-right corner of the campaign UI.

[*]Progress through a chain of decision events, fight battles, and earn units, heroes, artifacts, and equipment rewards. No traditional campaign management is required.

[*]During a run, you may obtain lords, heroes, and units from almost every race, allowing you to build your own dream army.

[*]Your army fully recovers after each battle. Every fight is meant to be played at full strength, without worrying about casualties, replenishment, or long-term attrition.

[*]The mod uses the original multiplayer unit prices as the basis for balance, aiming to provide a relatively fair combat experience for around 30 rounds.

[*]MCT support is included for adjusting several difficulty-related options.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Loop[/h2]

[list=1]
[*]Enter a normal campaign and choose any faction from any race you like. Your chosen race becomes your main race and influences the baseline of your future unit and equipment rewards.

[*]Once the campaign begins, click the new crossed-swords button in the lower-right corner of the screen to start [b]Warhammer Spire[/b].

[*]A special event army will be generated. Move it to a suitable position on the campaign map and begin the event chain.

[*]Build your army, fight battles, win rewards, gain experience, level up your heroes, and equip powerful artifacts.

[*]Follow the event chain to visit different race nodes, face themed enemy armies, and earn rewards associated with those races.

[*]Fight, earn rewards, fight again, earn more rewards... and see how deep your run can go.
[/list]

[h2]Current Version Content[/h2]

[list]
[*]Supports almost all major races and factions up to the [b]LORDS OF THE END TIMES[/b] version.

[*]Event rewards include most vanilla lords, heroes, regular units, elite units, and the majority of vanilla equipment and artifact rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*]Single-player only.

[*]Save-game compatible. A new campaign is not required. However, since this mod’s main gameplay is almost entirely independent from normal campaign progression, starting a fresh campaign is still recommended.

[*]MCT is supported, with several adjustable options.

[*]Confirmed compatible with:
[list]
[*]Community Bug Fix Mod
[*]Memreader
[*]Camera Mod
[*]Helper UI
[/list]

[*]Does not conflict with MIXER Unlocker. However, factions unlocked by Unlocker are not currently supported by this mod. In practice, Warhammer Spire is mostly based on race selection rather than specific playable factions.

[*]Does not conflict with SFO.

[*]Lords, heroes, units, and items added by other mods will not appear in Warhammer Spire reward pools for now.

[*]May be incompatible with mods that heavily alter vanilla item, equipment, or unit data.

[*]May conflict with UI mods that modify the lower-right campaign button area.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*]Most factions within the same race play almost identically in this mod, though some races with distinct sub-factions, such as Warriors of Chaos, may differ.

[*]In the late game, especially after floor 30, there may be some stuttering before entering battle. Suggestion: consider round 30 a win and end the run.

[*]The game won't able to continue when chaos lords got replaced with daemon princes. Don't choose that.

[*]Crash may occur when playing Malakai against Ironbrow. Workaround: use a different Dwarf faction.

[*]When starting as the Changeling or Nagash, there's an issue where heroes cannot join the army. Workaround: use 'Skip Hero Selection'

[*]A small number of crash bugs may still exist and have not yet been reproduced consistently.

[/list]

[h2]Credits / Thanks[/h2]

[list]
[*]Yukino_Cth & Chd_Caravan Mod
[*]SummonServant Mod
[*]Special thanks to the author of [b]Cathay Campaign Difficulty Overhaul[/b]: Wyccc
[*]OnePitchMan. He told me how to fix one of my known issues
[/list]

[h2]QA[/h2]

[list]
[*]Q: Why does my army move to a different location on the campaign map after each battle?
A: This is to simulate a wandering adventurer's journey and to keep the battlefield maps varied throughout the run.

[*]Q: Why is there no text showing up in the event popups?
A: Make sure you've subscribed to and enabled the companion mod with the same name, tagged [EN Patch]. It's set as a required mod.

[*]Q: I can't find the mod toggle button for a certain race. What's going on?
A: Most major r

3768657855.title: [9.0.X] Dechala and Samael: The Denied Wedding
3768657855.description:
Dechala is called the Denied One for a reason.

Long ago, her family surrendered her to Samael, the Silver Tongue, a Daemon Prince of Slaanesh who later became her husband. Dechala escaped him, but Slaanesh decreed that she would never ascend to daemonhood while she remained apart from Samael and he still existed.

This mod brings their unfinished rivalry into Dechala's Immortal Empires campaign. Samael returns through promises, poisoned gifts and increasingly powerful manifestations. Dechala can accept his help, openly defy him or turn his own schemes against him.

Their struggle eventually leads to a final wedding prepared as a trap. Destroy Samael to claim Dechala's daemonic ascension, and with it the power to grant daemonhood to her own Lords, or bind his essence and recruit him as an immortal Slaaneshi Lord.

This is my first mod and is currently in beta. Suggestions, balance feedback and bug reports are very welcome.

Tides of Torment is required.

Changes from the last update:
- Updated for 9.0.X
- Bound Samael now gets the Army of Renown skill node added in patch 9.0

Planned improvements:
- This mod adds 2 quest battles on top of the existing ones, which may be too many for one campaign (and one of them reuses an existing map :D). I may replace or rework one of the existing ones. I'm still thinking about it.

3773211997.title: 集成战略 (Integrated Strategies)
3773211997.description:
[h1][b]前置需求[/b][/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3376886102]通用框架 (Generic Framework)[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3552538974]英灵召唤 (Summon Servant)[/url]

[h1][b]内容概要[/b][/h1]
为所有派系增加了集成战略功能，允许玩家探索事件节点，迎战随机出现的关卡，获取未知的收益和奖励。目前集成战略功能仅适用于超凡帝国，受战锤3传送战底层限制，玩家所选择角色必须在战役地图上以正常姿态出现方能进行探索（非驻扎、集结、伏击、强行军等姿态）。

[h1][b]事件节点[/b][/h1]
探索中将随机出现4种节点：得偿所愿（10%）、不期而遇（40%）、险路恶敌（40%）、诡意行商（10%）。
得偿所愿 - 可以获取补给的节点，在此随机提供两件收藏品以供玩家抉择。
不期而遇 - 遭遇一次随机事件，不同事件的抉择内容会有所不同。
诡意行商 - 可以消耗源石锭购买收藏品的商店，其中必定出现普通、罕见、稀有各一件收藏品和一件免费的随机收藏品。
险路恶敌 - 遭遇一场随机战斗，不同难度的敌人作战方式会有所不同，战胜敌人可以获取随机收藏品奖励。战斗难度分为三档：简单、普通、困难，根据当前回合数、派系收入数额、参战领主实力动态调整。

[h1][b]大炎通宝[/b][/h1]
大炎通宝，蕴藏珍妙。投钱听命，或有奇效。
通宝有三种币制，代表其效果的大致划分：
花钱 - 能带来稳定收益；
衡钱 - 效果较为均衡；
厉钱 - 较为激进，效果将难以捉摸。
玩家可在每回合开始时，或主动花费源石锭进行投钱，随机替换当前通宝效果。

[h1][b]已知问题[/b][/h1]
8.1更新中CA修改了事件的底层逻辑，当同一回合内触发多个事件后，事件内需要消耗资源的选项即便现有资源不足仍可以选择，若因此选择了资源不足的选项，就会出现各类不明bug，例如英雄无法入队等。

[h1][b]重要更新[/b][/h1]
2026.8.25
大幅推迟险路恶敌难度升级的时机。

2026.8.24
现在点击钱盒将弹出投钱事件，以防止手滑触发。

2026.8.22
现在可以通过Mod Configuration Tool设置回合开始时是否进行投钱。

2026.8.14
新增10种不期而遇事件。
新增票券和大炎通宝系统。
探索事件节点现在需要消耗票券。
事件节点出现概率调整为：得偿所愿（10%）、不期而遇（40%）、险路恶敌（40%）、诡意行商（10%）。

These Mods has taken a lot of effort from me and is still constantly being updated. If you like my Mod and are willing to treat me to a cup of coffee, I would be very happy❤️

3801443992.title: Recruitment of All-Race Units · Foreign Barracks
3801443992.description:
[h1]All-Race Recruitment · Foreign Barracks · Forced Confederation[/h1]
[h2]🙏 Special Thanks[/h2]

[b]Taldaris[/b]: Support for this MOD to keep landmarks' buildings, lords and heroes from turning into goblins

[b]A quick note of gratitude[/b]: Sincere thanks to Taldaris for his all-out help along the way. This MOD you see right now would not exist without him.

[b]Destroy a faction, and all its people and mounts become yours.[/b]

In the base game, defeating a Legendary Lord faction only grants you its lands. This MOD lets you [b]seize its troops and personnel altogether[/b] — all 24 races and 979 unit types are recruitable, and the enemy Legendary Lords will be directly added to your recruitment panel.

[hr]

[h2]🎁 Conquer a Race, Absorb Its Forces[/h2]

Defeat a Legendary Lord faction and choose "Accept Submission", and [b]on the next turn[/b], reinforcements will come to your side:

[b]① 1 Lord + 4 Heroes[/b], all from the race you just conquered

[b]② Eternal Vitality[/b]: They will not vanish upon death and can be resummoned

[b]③ Preserved Levels[/b]: They spawn at their current level with no extra bonuses


[hr]

[h2]How to Play (3 Steps)[/h2]

[b]1. Eradicate the Faction[/b] — Fully eliminate a [b]Legendary Lord faction[/b] of a race.

[b]2. Accept Submission[/b] — Select "[b]Accept Submission[/b]" in the post-battle pop-up window.

[b]3. Construct Barracks[/b] — Build "[b]Foreign Barracks[/b]" in one of your cities to recruit its units. Legendary Lords will appear in the recruitment panel.

You can skip absorption if you prefer; pick "Occupy As Normal" to keep vanilla gameplay. The choice is yours.

[hr]

⚔️ Barracks has 4 tiers, unlocking progressively (cumulative recruitable units)
1️⃣ Basic Units 124
2️⃣ Intermediate Units 483
3️⃣ Elite Units 760
4️⃣ Premium Units & Top-tier Monsters 979
(979 total units covering all 24 races)

Constructed in vanilla building slots (Order / Chaos Foreign Legions), consuming no new slots and not replacing existing buildings.

🪨 Stele = the "tech tree" for foreign units
· One stele per the 24 races, built on dedicated landmark slots in that race's capital; unlockable at City Tier 3
· Once built, units of that race gain 9 categories of unique bonuses: Infantry / Missile Troops / Cavalry / Monsters / Beasts / Chariots / Artillery / Explosive Units / Flying Units

🚩 Recruitment Panel · Race Filter Row
24 race banners (two rows). Lit = only display units of this race; multiple selections allowed, click again to deselect.
Fully compatible with Better Recruitment UI.

[hr]

[h2]Safety & Compatibility[/h2]

[b]· Vanilla-Friendly[/b]: No changes to vanilla units / buildings / stats / AI.

[b]· No AI Advantage[/b]: AI cannot build these barracks or gain extra troops. This mechanic is player-only.

[b]· Works with Existing Saves[/b], no new campaign required.

[b]· Compatible with major overhauls such as SFO and Radious when installed together.[/b]

[hr]

[h2]📌 My Other MODs[/h2 ]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3790685048]All Races · Unit Hundred-Battle Level Up "Are You My Chosen?"[/url ]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3782037737]All Lords & Heroes Growth System "Are You My Chosen?"[/url ]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784846954]AI Boost (Hero Reinforcement) · Trait Roulette "Are You My Chosen?"[/url ]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3804922850]Order Difficulty Overhaul[/url ]
[/list ]


[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Q: Do I need to build the stele first for Barracks Tier 3 & 4?[/b]
A: No. It only scales with city tier; the stele is purely a bonus building.

[b]Q: I cannot find Foreign Barracks in the construction list?[/b]
A: That race has not submitted — the barracks will not show up before submission.

[b]Q: The submission pop-up does not appear?[/b]
A: Verify three conditions: you defeated a [b]Legendary Lord faction[/b], you captured its final settlement, and you selected "Accept Submission".

[b]Q: Units are visible but cannot be recruited?[/b]
A: Elite units follow vanilla unit caps; this MOD does not bypass vanilla limits.

[b]Q: Cannot see this MOD after subscribing?[/b]
A: Use the official new launcher or WH3 Mod Manager. Old launchers may fail to detect it.

3810029219.title: Skeletor Inspired Nagash VO
3810029219.description:
I have no lifed for three days to make this a reality. Ever since seeing tarrif's warhammer memes of Nagash, I cannot see him having any other voice besides something similiar to skeletor.

- Vocals are not AI.
- I did use AI to help get the sound files in game though and to build a recording app. There was like 600 lines to record. And individually moving those around, reformatting them by hand with wwise, doing all that, would've been a nightmare.

Disclaimer :
Folks brought up that I should clarify this isn't a copy of the original skeletor so CA doesn't have to take it down and the mod doesn't cause any kerfuffle. Updating some of the description, thumbnail, and title. This is clearly parody, and it doesn't use any of Skeletor's original audio. No AI voice generation was used, so the voice is is not copied using any source audio or material.

Bugs I am aware of and looking into.
- A few more vanilla lines that play
- Other lords using Nagash's level up sound
- Some folks experiencing no VO sound on campaign map. (It's a audio mixer incompat, i will patch this)
- The text strings not displaying modified scripts
- some audio is louder than it should be.

Future Updates
- Redoing skeleton VO
- Adding a voiced Zoro Summon (Requests are that he will be a bloated corpse, he will not be combat effective and will purely be a meme unit. I will be keeping this mod with overhauls like radius in mind)
- More bug fixes
- Tariff Requested lines, more Tariff References
- Veering away from longer lines, adding more short quips

FAQ : 
Who is Zoro? Zoro is not cannon lore, I just figure every EVIL overlord needs a minion to gyrate and insult and blame when things go wrong. Since Nagash doesn't have a krell like summon early, but just some zombies to start, I figured a sad shambling zombie would do. Why not Mannfred? Mannfred is in different places on the campaign map. So it would be immersion breaking to have him pop in for a random conversation with Nagash.


Next update (Expect this within the next couple weeks, am taking a bit of a breather, lots of work and errands and stuff)
- Mixer compat or mixer patch
- Fix his idle audio in battle not having attenuation 
- Fix the peak limiter causing some graininess for high volume lines

- Added a system to check for lines that average too high a volume. And a peak limiter to prevent ear splitting differences.

Cleaned up a few lines.

Added more idle lines

Update changelog.

Lines Added for a ton of new entries.

3812278307.title: Global Pcall Listener Fix 9.0.x
3812278307.description:
[h1]What this does[/h1]
Since game patch 9.0, Total War: WARHAMMER III runs every script listener [b]unprotected[/b]. When any mod's script hits an error inside a listener, the game silently stops processing the rest of the listeners for that event. Every other mod listening to the same event (FactionTurnStart, CharacterTurnStart, BattleCompleted, UI events...) is skipped for that firing, with no red text on screen and nothing in the script log. If the faulty mod errors every turn, everything behind it on that event is dead for the whole campaign.

This mod restores the pre-9.0 behaviour: every listener runs in a protected call, one mod's error no longer takes the others down with it, and the error is reported the way it used to be.

It changes no gameplay. It only changes what happens when a script fails.

[h1]For players[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Mods stop silently breaking each other.[/b] One buggy mod can no longer disable features of other mods that happen to use the same event. Each listener runs regardless of whether the one before it failed.
[*][b]Errors are visible again.[/b] The familiar red "ERROR - SCRIPT HAS FAILED" text from before 9.0 is back. The message names the event and the script file that failed, so you know which mod to report it to.
[*][b]No gameplay changes.[/b] No stats, no AI, no balance. Only error handling.
[*][b]Multiplayer safe.[/b] This is the exact code path the game shipped with for years before 9.0. Both players run the same script, so nothing can desync.
[*][b]Any load order, any time.[/b] Load position does not matter. Add it to or remove it from an existing campaign freely; it stores nothing.
[*][b]Important:[/b] if you start seeing red text after installing this, those errors were [i]already happening[/i] silently. This mod does not create or fix bugs; it stops them spreading and lets you see them.
[/list]

[h1]For modders[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Your listeners cannot be starved by someone else's bug.[/b] Without this, a mod loaded before yours that errors on FactionTurnStart means your FactionTurnStart listener never runs, and nothing tells you why. "My mod stopped working on turn 12 with 40 other mods" is very often this.
[*][b]Full error reporting.[/b] Error message, traceback captured at the failing line, and the callstack of the code that registered the listener, via script_error() into the script log, plus the on-screen text and the campaign's event error log.
[*][b]Conditions that error evaluate as false[/b] for that firing instead of aborting dispatch. One-shot listeners behind a failing listener are no longer silently consumed.
[*][b]No dependency.[/b] Your mod does not need to require this. If you want the behaviour for your users, you can bundle the file in your own pack; a once-flag makes multiple copies harmless.
[*][b]Still guard your own listeners.[/b] This protects you from other people's errors and makes your errors visible to users. It does not make bad code good.
[/list]

[h1]Technical details[/h1]
In script/_lib/lib_core.lua, core_object:new() now picks event_unprotected_callback() unless the dev tweaker USE_PROTECTED_EVENT_CALLBACKS is set, and it is never set in the shipped game. The old xpcall path, event_protected_callback(), is still present and became a global in 9.0.

This mod is a single file at script/_lib/mod/zz_listener_protection.lua. It replaces core.event_callback with a line-for-line copy of the 9.0 body, bound to event_protected_callback instead. Because the dispatcher looks the method up through the core object at call time, the override applies to every event, including ones attached before this file loaded. Loading from _lib/mod means it covers campaign, battle and frontend.

Guards: once-flag against double install; bails out cleanly if event_protected_callback does not exist (pre-9.0 lib_core). Logs one line, "Listener Protection: protected listener dispatch installed", so you can confirm it took.

Verified on 9.1 and 9.2 (lib_core.lua is identical between them). After each game patch the copied body is re-checked against the new lib_core.lua.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
[*]Compatible with everything that does not itself replace core.event_callback. Mods that wrap core.add_listener (error-wrapping libraries, profilers) stack on top of this without issue.
[*]If another mod also replaces core.event_callback, the one loaded last wins. If both restore protected dispatch, the result is the same.
[*]Save game compatible. Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.
[*]Works on any campaign, including SFO, Mixu, Radious etc.
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[b]I'm getting red text I never had before.[/b]
Those errors were already occurring; before this mod they were swallowed and silently disabled other mods' listeners. Read the file name in the message and report it to that mod's author.

[b]Does this affect end-turn time?[/b]
It restores the code path the game used before 9.0, so the cost is what the game had for years. Nothing measurable in testing.

[b]Why did CA change this?[/b]
The comment in lib_core says the unprotected path is "used during autotests and in the released version of the game". The protected path remains in the file behind a developer-only switch.

3816385668.title: The Coming of Winter: Katarin Faction Expansion
3816385668.description:
[code]                          "Kislev is the Motherland… the Motherland is Kislev!"                    [/code]
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3816446693]English Translation[/url][/h1]

[h1]The Coming of Winter : Katarin Faction Expansion[/h1]

Inspired by Katarin's own style of rule and the Chekists of the older background lore, this mod adds a complete "Tzarina's Autocracy" system to Katarin's faction.

Katarin is no longer a statue in the Ice Palace. From here she decides Kislev's course herself — bringing the Orthodoxy to heel, holding the Empire close, purging dissent, keeping all of it in her own hands.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Tzarina's Autocracy[/h2]

Battles won against the Ruinous Powers are converted into "Prestige" according to the value of the enemy dead. Prestige is spent to advance six different agendas, each of them rich in faction rewards.

[b]Diplomatic Ties[/b]: unlocked by allying with non-Kislev factions. As the agenda advances you unlock Empire reinforcements for recruitment, up to the Steam Tank and the Land Ship.

[b]Ice Creed[/b]: unlocked by completing Ice Court training. Strengthens Ice Witches and Frost Maidens; at tier 4 it grants the unique artifact "Frost Echo".

[b]Elevating the Guard[/b]: unlocked by building the guard chains. Strengthens guard-type units; at tier 3 it unlocks "zealous conscription", letting you recruit Armoured Kossars and Winged Lancers on the spot.

[b]Winter Invocation[/b]: unlocked by performing army or province invocations. Strengthens the invocation rituals and steadily reduces the Devotion they cost.

[b]Absolute Rule[/b]: unlocked by building Chekist outposts. Control in all provinces and agent action success chance rise with each tier, magic items arrive by chance each turn, and the Purge landmark chain is unlocked for construction.

[b]Orthodox Reform[/b]: unlocked by raising the Tzarina's Authority. Unlocks unique Patriarch heroes and wins more support from the Great Orthodoxy; at tier 4 you can confederate or vassalise the Great Orthodoxy.

[h2]The Akshina[/h2]

[b]Chekist[/b]: an Akshina hero who serves the Tzarina directly, unlocked for recruitment by the Purge landmarks. Can perform a unique agent action: establishing a Chekist sleeper station.

[b]Chekist Outposts[/b]: set up "Chekist investigation stations" in friendly cities and "Chekist sleeper stations" in enemy ones. Over a dozen action buildings, including interrogation, propaganda, infiltration and asset seizure.

[b]Akshina Assassin[/b]: a new unit, recruited from the Purge landmarks and tier-3 forest buildings.

[h2]Other Content[/h2]

New personal skill lines for Ice Witch Lord and Frost Maiden heroe.

Tor's province and army invocation effects have been reworked.

[h2]Credits[/h2]

The Chekist hero used the model from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3665254171]Dead's Akshina Hero[/url]. I'm extremely grateful for the authorization from Dead Baron!

[b]Multiplayer[/b] - I haven't played multiplayer game, so I can't help with issues related to it.

[h2]My other mods[/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3785784804]More Unusual Location[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3625765898]Zhao Ming Expanded[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670461603]Yin Yin Expanded[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3684044251]Great Bastion Expanded[/url]

2789896406.title: Tabletop Caps: Thrones of Decay
2789896406.description:
[h1]Features[/h1]

This mod adds army-level Unit Caps for all factions, inspired by the Warhammer Fantasy Battles Tabletop rules for army composition.

All units are either core, special, or rare units, and have an associated points cost. Each army is allowed to have an unlimited number of core units, up to 10 points worth of special units, and up to 5 points worth of rare units.

When the recruitment panel is open, you will be able to see the costs of each unit displayed on the unit cards, both for the unit options available to recruit and for the units already in your army. Additionally, the total available and spent points are visible on the UI when you have any army selected. 

Core Special and Rare distinctions are decided based on tabletop precedent and game balance. In cases where certain units diverge substantially from tabletop, they are balanced according to how they function in game. 

All limits are enforced for the AI just like for humans - including Slaaneshi Devotee armies, Khorne army summons, rogue armies, and challenge armies. The only thing which does not have tabletop caps is quest battles - these will be extra challenging with this mod enabled, but are still very much winnable for an experienced player. 

You can find a full list of the current unit costs for tabletop caps on this website http://ttc-costs.surge.sh/ which was created by the illustrious Bapp on the Modding Den. 

Balance for the factions who are new with WH3 is still very much being decided - I haven’t had time to play every single faction through an entire campaign with the mod yet. Feedback is greatly appreciated.

The goal for the mod is that you will have to make some hard choices about which elite units you want to bring, and that both you and the AI will field no ‘doomstacks’, instead bringing balanced forces. The ultimate goal is that a much higher share of your battles will be interesting fights between two armies with reasonable compositions. 


[h1] Compatibility [/h1]
This mod should be compatible with all other mods. However, custom units added by other mods will be considered core (unlimited) units, unless the mod author specifically adds their units to the Tabletop Caps system. If you come across a unit mod that you’d like to work better with this mod, let me know and I’ll see if I can help the author set that up. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2789896406/3267933887514325642/]You can see a list of submods for popular unit mods here[/url].

This mod should be compatible with multiplayer games in consecutive turns mode. Simultaneous turns mode should be fine too, in theory, but I haven’t tested it and it is very new, so consider yourself a beta tester if you’re taking this into a simultaneous turns MP game.

[h1]Mod Configuration[/h1]
This mod has settings available in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815354316]Vandy's Mod Configuration Tool.[/url]

[h1] Thanks to [/h1]
Cataph, both for help with balance and for creating the new mod image.
Bapp, for creating the webapp mentioned above, where you can view unit costs.

[h1] Links [/h1]
[url= https://github.com/DrunkFlamingo/DrunkFlamingo_TotalWarMods]My Github[/url]

2821600897.title: Cultist of Pleasure Reskin
2821600897.description:
[h3]Cultists of Slaanesh get a reskin inspired by the Cult of Pleasure.  Graphical only.[/h3]

Subscribe to [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2881916371]Cultist Expansion - Pleasure Cultist +[/url][/b] if you want all the exciting gameplay and lore features!

[h2]Design[/h2]
All of the Cultists of Slaanesh in the vanilla game are elves, which is a cool lore choice.  Elven society has long been poisoned by the various Cults of Excess.  The vanilla Cultists all look almost identical, however, as if they were clones or monks, rather than the sensual, fashion-obsessed elves who fell so deep into vanity and desire that they began worshipping daemons.  This mod is intended to create a beautiful and visually diverse group of Cultists that feel more like fallen elven hedonists.  

Whenever I borrow a hair asset in this mod, I sit the Cultist down in the salon and give her a makeover.  These hairstyles vary, thus, from being heavily modified versions of existing styles, to styles that bear no resemblance to their source anymore.  Please enjoy the classy feeling of these unique looks, while your Cultists enjoy the feeling of being able to go to a party without worrying that they'll run into the woman whose hair they stole.

I like to put a lot of subtle changes in my reskins.  I edited the facial bone structure, lip shape, and other small details in some of the faces, as well as adding different makeup, tattoos, and jewelry.  Their physical builds are considerably different as well, ranging from slimmer than default to much curvier.  Many of the cultists now choose to wear shoes, and though they still mostly have spikey leather, I have reduced how dominant the aesthetic is, to feel more elven and less modern.  

I kept two of the original, bald variants, because the original game only had two different faces.  If you like the original variants, you will still have access to them.  If you do not, then there should be enough new variants that you do not need to recruit them.

This is my first "sexy" reskin (despite what my Nurgle fans may say), and it's pretty embarrassing to hit publish on.  It's necessary, right?  When making a Cultist of Slaanesh?  


[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
This is intended as part of my Cultist Expansion project, but unlike the Cult Oracle, it is a reskin, not a new Hero.  It is intended as the first step towards creating two types of Slaanesh cultists, and in the future you may see a mod that makes some changes to the skill tree to match the new Cult of Pleasure theme.

I would definitely make sure to release this Pleasure Cultist Hero for Morathi's faction as well.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Fully compatible with Spooky's Cultist of Pleasure Variants, or others that add rather than replacing variants.  May not be compatible with other reskins of the Cultist of Slaanesh.  Should work with any other mod, though some minor database editing was needed to increase the number of variants beyond vanilla's number.

2833501876.title: Land Encounters And Points Of Interest
2833501876.description:
[h1] Explanation and reason for this mod to exists [/h1]
Do you feel the original ROC map that we ended up having is big but quite empty? Do you believe that a world as big and alive as the Warhammer world should have more to do than just travelling from city to city through vast nothingness so that you can siege another city? Or a random escaping army? Are you tired of never having more random enemies to fight, like your classic slavers or expeditionaries?

Originally another fellow modder called Anyndel, imported the sea battles into the land for the Warhammer 2 Mortal Empires. Well I loved his mod but always felt it was missing more. He abandoned it but still was at least visible in the Workshop. And so with the coming of Warhammer 3 and me wanting to mod the last and final game in the trilogy and Anyndel retiring, I ended up giving it a shot.

[h1] Current features [/h1]
[h2]Land encounters[/h2]
[h3]Treasure and event spots[/h3]
Treasure spots are simple spots that can give you a little story and rewards of the following type: 
[olist]
[*]Money
[*]Experience
[*]Ancillary
[*]Army effects
[/olist]

Or a combination of any of them. They are the less common of the points of interest and generally good for a little boost of power for the army.

[h3]Battle spot[/h3]
To check the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2833501876/3446961485750535268/]click here[/url].

[h3] Land encounter configuration [/h3]
Currently the system is configured so that 75% of all the spots of a zone in the ROC map (there are more than a 100 spots) are active during the campaign and of this 15% are treasures and 85% are battles with a 5 turn cool down after activation. I will try to make them configurable but that won't happen until after I understand MCT better.

[h2]Point of Interest[/h2]
Points of interest are perpetual markers: they confer benefits for the faction that controls them, have they own very differential functionalities, can emit quests and have to be upgraded or defended by the player and the AI to have a competitive advantage. 
[h3]Smithy[/h3]
To check the smithy functionality you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2833501876/3446961485750616427/]click here[/url].

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
- Sometimes CA movement range system will break after a battle. You can keep playing but you won't see the movement range of your army. Reset the game to see it again (You can keep playing until it crashes).

- Does not support multiplayer. Some methods of CA managers I have used do not support multiplayer as declared in the documentation so if you try playing this as such you may suffer a desync quite quickly. I do not really know if this can be solved. Sorry.

[h1] What is the future of this mod[/h1]
[b]This mod is not feature complete.[/b] It also has some issues that I need to resolve first before it can truly release as feature complete. I have released it mostly because it is fun to play with even in its current state and because feedback  by the community is welcome as well, to make it even more fun. I may continue developing if I see that CA continues to really support the game. Right now thinks are improving but the game is truly uninspired. Should thinks improve I shall continue with the roadmap I had in mind.

There are several ways to expand this mod. Think of a Song of Conquest type of system. It will take quite some time but I plan to maintain this mod over a long period of time. 

I already laid the underlying base for those features by the way. But they are hard to do them right, and so, patience.

If more modders are interested I can open a repository to combine efforts and maintain it together.

[h1] Incompatibilities [/h1]
[b]Start a new campaign when playing with this mod. It can be enabled mid campaign but it has a high chance to crash as it put things in the map that weren't there in the beginning. [/b] Discovered by @Lets Fuck Brandon

[b] Incompatible with the following mods [/b]
All Landmarks Mod seem to have an incompatability with this mod somehow, like:
1. Landmarks of Legend IE
2. Immortal Landmarks
3. Other landmarks mods variations. 

If you are using one of this mod your game will crash when you or the AI are receiving an incident from some of the treasure spots. I really don't know why this happens but it seems that every mod of this types conflicts with this one. So you will have to choose which one to use but they cannot be used together (for now).

4. Incompatible with SFO. Proved in the comments that it crashes with it. No support planned in the near future. Sorry.
5. Maybe also with Radious? I will need someone to test it. Never been a huge fan of the overhauls.

[h1] Translations [/h1]
Supplied by other fellow modders: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2834418439]Russian[/url] by @Gosudar
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790155753]Chinese[/url] by @To infinity and beyond


[h1] Acknowledgements [/h1]
An enormous thanks to Vandy, DrunkFlamingo and Mixu for all the recommendations, insight, patience and great knowledge. To Anyndel, for the initial idea and implementation (that served at least as a general guide as what it was needed to do it). To other modders in the Modding Den like Bastilean for the support and the interest. As always thank you too fellow warhammer players for keeping the game alive. Is a masterpiece and if we continue to support it we will have it for a long time. Let's remain positive!

For more of my mods see the collection of my creations: 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2793081350

For giving more visibility to the mod in the workshop don't forget to:
[img]https://media.tenor.com/-aJ5PYLYj4gAAAAd/click-subscribe.gif[/img]

2853057944.title: More Forgiving Loyalty
2853057944.description:
Trust no-thing, especially yourself. While I think loyalty's a flavorful system, it can be annoying to keep all of your lords happy, when something as small as removing an item or simply hitting end turn can cause a downward spiral to army disband. Completely removing the system means missing out on some interesting dilemma effects though, so I wanted to make a happy medium. This mod basically makes it so that for a lord to rebel, you have to be doing extremely poorly, intentionally treating them like garbage, or choosing -loyalty dilemma options. You know, actual reasons one might want to rebel. 

This mod affects all factions that use loyalty. If instead you just don't want to deal with loyalty in any form (dilemmas or otherwise), try this alternate mod which should remove it entirely: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853058175


[h1] QUESTIONS: [/h1]

Is this savegame compatible?
-It should be able to be added and removed without issue, as it primarily modifies the percentage chances after certain events. Do let me know if problems arise though.

Mod conflicts?
-This only touches a few strings relating to loyalty campaign features and variables, so should be relatively safe. It's not compatible with Loyalty Removed, for obvious reasons.


[h1] CHANGES: [/h1]

-Battle outcomes with the lord keep the 1/2/3 loss/gain on close/decisive/crushing defeats or close/decisive/heroic victories respectively, but victories are 50% (100% for heroic) chance rather than 15-25%.
-Gain on completing a mission increased to 100% chance from 40%, loss from failing missions unchanged from 50%.
-Base chance of loss on end of turn removed. Loss related to lord being higher level than faction leader unchanged from 10% chance, gain related to lord being lower level increased to 10% chance from 5%.
-Loss on unequipping items removed, 40% chance to gain on equipping items unchanged, up to loyalty 5.
-Recruiting or disbanding units from the stack have a 25%/10% chance for gain or loss respectively, up/down to loyalty 5.
-Chance of loss from replacing the lord reduced to 20% from 50%.
-Loss and gain from signing treaties with the 'appropriate/inappropriate' factions is removed.
-'Chaining' loss from other lords defecting is removed.


-Chance for a loyalty dilemma upon hitting low loyalty increased to 50% from 33%.
-Chance for a loyalty dilemma upon hitting critically low loyalty increased to 75% from 50%.
-Starting loyalty level uncertainty range altered to 3 from 5.


=============
Image credits: Developer art and 30 minutes in MSpaint on a meme.

2855142590.title: Morathi Simple Slaanesh Expansion - Cult of Pleasure Can Recruit Slaanesh Daemons
2855142590.description:
[h1]Morathi Simple Slaanesh Expansion[/h1]
Morathi's Cult of Pleasure can now recruit all Slaanesh's daemons, fight with or face a combined Dark Elf and Slaanesh daemon roster as devastating flankers join repeater crossbows to dominate Naggaroth, Ulthuan, Lustria, and the Warhammer world.

[h1]Slaanesh Heroes and Lord[/h1]
Morathi's Cult of Pleasure can now recruit new Slaanesh heroes, and Dark Elf wielders of Slaanesh magic:

[b][i]Cult of Pleasure Building Chain[/i][/b]
Cultist of Slaanesh - Level 3

[b][i]Sorcery Building Chain[/i][/b]
Alluress (Lore of Slaanesh) - Level 3
Alluress (Lore of Shadows) - Level 3
Sorceress (Lore of Slaanesh) - Level 3

And a new lord, the Supreme Sorceress (Lore of Slaanesh).

[h1]Recruitment[/h1]
Enables Morathi to recruit Slaanesh daemons from the Cult of Pleasure, Beastmaster, and Sorcery building chains.

[b][i]Cult of Pleasure Building Chain[/i][/b]
Daemonettes - Level 2 (Vanilla)
Seekers of Slaanesh - Level 3
Seeker Chariots - Level 3
Exalted Daemonettes - Level 4 (Vanilla)
Heartseekers of Slaanesh - Level 4
Chaos Warshrine of Slaanesh - Level 4
Hellflayers - Level 4
Keeper of Secrets - Level 5
Exalted Seeker Chariot - Level 5

[b][i]Beastmaster Building Chain[/i][/b]
Chaos Furies of Slaanesh -  Level 3
Fiends of Slaanesh - Level 4

[b][i]Sorcery Building Chain[/i][/b]
Chaos Spawn of Slaanesh - Level 3
Soul Grinder of Slaanesh - Level 5

[h1]Bonus Marauder Recruitment[/h1]
After conquering the Norscan wastelands Morathi's Cult of Pleasure will be able to recruit a selection of marauder units from the special defensive building that is only able to be built in the untamed northern wilds, where few elves settle.

[b][i]Garden of Sensual Delights (Norscan Outpost)[/i][/b]
Devoted Marauders of Slaanesh
Devoted Marauders of Slaanesh (Spears) 
Devoted Marauders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)
Hellstriders of Slaanesh
Hellstriders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)
Marauder Horsemen of Slaanesh
[b][i]NEW:[/i][/b] Norscan Warhounds
[b][i]NEW:[/i][/b] Norscan Warhounds (Poison)

[h1]Black Ark Cult of Pleasure Building[/h1]
Corrects the vanilla omission and adds a Cult of Pleasure building chain for Black Arks. Recruit Slaanesh daemons from Black Arks with the same building requirements as above.

[h1]Slaanesh Skill Line for Cult of Pleasure Lords and Heroes[/h1]
Adds special Slaanesh skill lines for Cult of Pleasure lords and heroes as the Dark Prince bestows gifts on his acolytes. Khainite heroes (Death Hag and Assassin) will not receive the skill line for now.

[h1]Bestow the Mark of Slaanesh on Units[/h1]
Cult of Pleasure units can be bestowed with the Mark of Slaanesh via a purchasable unit upgrade obtainable by clicking the unit.

[b][i]NEW:[/i][/b] Witch Elves can now be bestowed with the Mark of Slaanesh via purchasable unit upgrade to become Devoted of Slaanesh, losing their Khainite abilities of Frenzy and Madness of Khaine, but gaining the usual Slaaneshi boons, as well as Soporific Musk attacks.

The Slaaneshi Witch Elves also gain a new passive Rapture of Slaanesh area hex that further reduces enemy MD and speed, whose intensity scales with the number of enemies the Witch Elves have killed, topping out at -8 MD and -24% speed at 120 kills, thus retaining their unique tactical niche akin to Madness of Khaine, but with a Slaaneshi character.

Other Khainite units (Har Ganeth Executioners) can not receive the Mark of Slaanesh for now.

[h1]Elven Chaos War Shrine of Slaanesh[/h1]
Changes the default model and VO of the Chaos War Shrine of Slaanesh to the more elfish Slaanesh cultist model.

[h1]Technology and Character Effect Bonuses[/h1]
Technology and character skill effect bonuses will be applied to Slaanesh units, generally following the same vanilla effects as for beasts and hydras; the Dark Elves summon new beasts of burden for their task of world conquest. All technology and character skill effects have now been separated from vanilla effects, making the localisation of the new effects easier to follow.

Slaanesh corruption in a region will also boost the experience level at which Slaanesh units and heroes are recruited.

[h1]Slaanesh Ancillaries[/h1]
Gain and steal Slaanesh camp followers, magic items, and banners, as the Cult of Pleasure.

[h1]Chaos Corruption Bugfixes[/h1]
Switches the residual Chaos Undivided corruption effects within the Cult of Pleasure to Slaanesh corruption. Thanks and credit to Seleucid for finding and fixing most of these bugs first in his [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2854049687]mod[/url].

Switches special buildings, like Uthuan fortress gates, Ziggurat of the Dawn, and empire forts, to give Slaanesh corruption if owned by the Cult of Pleasure.

[h1]Settlement Garrison Rework[/h1]
Cult of Pleasure wall and garrison buildings have been reworked to confer exclusively Slaanesh units to the settlements defences. Combined with the Dark Elf roster from the main settlement buildings, each settlement defence battle will now be fought with a combined Elf-Slaanesh roster. Cult of Pleasure and Sorcery chain buildings also confer a handful of special bonus units to the garrison.

[h1]Localisations[/h1]
Chinese loc here thanks to [b][i]To infinity and beyond[/i][/b]:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790155753

German loc here thanks to [b][i]TRON[/i][/b]:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2869014684

2857794526.title: Warband Cross Race
2857794526.description:
[h2](Updated to 9.0)[/h2]
This is a submod of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853239091/]Warband Upgrade Ultimate[/url] (required). It provides two extra functionality:

1. Allows player & AI to upgrade foreign units of same alignment.

2. Various lore-accurate cross-race upgrades, e.g., Norsca marauder to Chaos, Chaos Dwarf laborer to Greenskin units, human knights to Vampire blood knights, Dark-elf upgrade other elf units.


[h1]Which foreign units can be upgraded?[/h1]
Applicable to foreign units in your army from allies / vassals / mercenary / caravan. 

Only lore-accurate aligned races can upgrade each other, e.g., among human races, between dwarf and human, between human and high-elf / wood-elf, among undead, chaos tide, ogre upgrade for all, etc.


[h1]Which cross-race upgrades are enabled?[/h1]
1) Vampire skeleton to tomb kings version, and zombie to coast version --- allowing more subsequent upgrades.  
2) Morathi can upgrade witch sister to Daemonette, and all slannesh upgrades.
3) Norsca can upgrade its marauders to the Chaos version, then all the way to Chaos knights and champions. 
4) Chaos Dwarf can upgrade its orc and goblin laborers to Greenskin orc and goblin units.
5) Ogre to plague ogre, for any ogre or nurgle factions.
6) Several human knights (brt, emp, ksl, cth) to Vampire blood knights.
7) Dark elf can upgrade some hef / wef units into def unit.

To upgrade into another race, navigate to the corresponding race panel, e.g., to upgrade your Norsca marauder to Chaos marauder, click the unit, then click the undivided chaos panel (button to the right).


[h1]Side effects on Garrison:[/h1]
For gate / fort garrison, it may consist of units from multiple races. For example, high elf's phoenix gate can have a mix of high and dark elf units. This is not a bug, rather, an intended side-effect that I do not plan to fix.


[h1]Compatibility: [/h1]
[b]Incompatible with Radious Warband.[/b]

Compatible with all other mods, SFO, save-game & co-op.

Not required, but mods work well together:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889689320/]Warband RoR[/url]: adding this will allow cross-race upgrade into RoR.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790029103/]Better Alliance[/url]: prevents forced alliance breaking, and make army skills benefit allied units.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2843411818/]Diplomacy options[/url]: allow all factions to vassalize, so you can reliably recruit units from vassal.


[h1]Misc: [/h1]
I don't always check Steam comments. For time-sensitive request, please contact me on discord, either via modding den or my own [url=https://discord.gg/NU5t9CK8eF]channel[/url].

And I always welcome [url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=WHEF2PNWVCQD4]a cup of coffee[/url] for my work.

3024485234.title: Army limit mechanics (ALM)
3024485234.description:
[h1]Army limit mechanics (ALM)[/h1]
The mechanics implemented in the mod allows you to set a limit on the units recruited depending on the number and level of military buildings built by the faction in the campaign.
All limits are enforced for the AI just like for humans.

[h1]Units limit by building level[/h1]
This is the key definition on which the mechanics implemented in this mod are based.

I will explain with an example:
Consider three detachments of the army of the Empire:
[list]
[*] Swordsmen
[*] Halberdiers
[*] Greatswords
[/list]
All this units has type "melee infantry". 
Default "Unit limit by building level" for this type equals 2. 
All this units recruited in Empire military barracks, which has three levels. 
Thus, depending on the level of the building, you can recruit the following number of units:

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Building level[/th]
        [th]Swordsmen[/th]
        [th]Halberdiers[/th]
        [th]Greatswords[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Training field[/td]
        [td]2[/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Rally field[/td]
        [td]4[/td]
        [td]2[/td]
        [td][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Barracks[/td]
        [td]6[/td]
        [td]4[/td]
        [td]2[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

When you build a level 3 barracks, you will be able to hire 6 squads of swordsmen, 4 squads of halberdiers and 2 squads of two-handed swords.
Do you need more? Build another barracks.
However, AI is in exactly the same position.
Now the power of the faction's armed forces depends not only on income, but also on the number and level of buildings built by the faction. The AI has a lot of money, but the limitations set by the ALM mechanics will not allow the AI to create powerful armies that the player simply does not have money for. The AI will have to hire units only within the specified limit. Of course, artificial intelligence will still create huge armies numerically superior to your armed forces, but their composition will be much more modest.

[h1]Units limit settings by type[/h1]
By default, the limit is set for a certain types of units:
[list]
[*]Melee Infantry
[*]Missile Infantry
[*]Monstrous Infantry
[*]Melee Cavalry
[*]Missile Cavalry
[*]Monstrous Cavalry
[*]War Beast
[*]War Machine
[*]Chariot
[*]Monster
[/list]
The value can be set in the range from 1 to 4.
To change these settings, use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2927955021]Vandy's Mod Configuration Tool[/url] (see slide 1 for this mod).
This is a rough setup. Each player has his own opinion about the correct balance in the game and the proposed settings will not be enough for him. With different players adhere to diametrically opposite points of view and base settings tools don't not please everyone.  
But yet I found a way out of this difficult situation. 
Built-in editor has been added to the game with which the player can independently set the limit for any unit of any race (see slide 3 for this mod).

[h1]Unlimited units[/h1]
Each race in the campaign has several base units with no recruitment limited. For example, for the Empire, these are spearmen and archers (see slide 2 for this mod).
As I said, AI has a lot of money, and he likes to hire large armies.
But now, when the recruitment limit is exhausted, he will be able to hire only basic unlimited units. Each race must have several unlimited units, otherwise the AI will not be able to recruit new units after the limit is exhausted.
Which units should have an unlimited set for each race in the game?
I think every player has their own opinion on this and many will disagree with the basic settings of this mod.
And now the good news. You can flexibly customize the list of unlimited units for any race in the game. For this using the built-in editor (see slide 4 for this mod).

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
This mod only includes scripts for the ALM game mechanics. For the mod to work properly, you will need one of three submod (depending on the mode of your company):

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3024485326]Submod for vanilla campaign[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3024485447]Submod for SFO[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3024485528]Submod for Radious[/url]

Imagine that this mod is a "program" that needs a "database" to work properly. So, the mods listed above are the databases necessary for the ALM mechanics to work.
This mod should be compatible with all other mods. However, custom units added by other mods will be considered unlimited units, unless the mod author specifically adds their units to the ALM system.
Each submod includes support for the most popular units mods for TWW3 (more than 150 mods).
You can see the full list of supported mods [url=http:\\coolman.ru\alm_mods.pdf]here[/url]
Players using SFO or Radious will say that this list contains only vanilla mods. Don't worry, if you use a submod for any of the mods listed in the list, everything will work correctly.
In the future, I plan to constantly supplement this list by adding support for other mods.

[h1]Units upgrade mechanics[/h1]
ALM supports the mechanics of upgrade units (see slide 6 for this mod).
But again, each player has their own opinion on how to properly configure the upgrade rules.
Therefore, I added a built-in unit upgrade editor to the mod so that each player could customize the upgrade rules according to their views and preferences (see slide 5 for this mod).
But not everything is so simple. Using the editor, you will find that you can configure the update rules not for all units.
There is a list of regiments for which you will not be able to configure an upgrade:
[list]
[*]Renown units
[*]Units from custom mods whose support has not been added to the ALM system
[*]Units that don't have buildings to recrui

3039004186.title: 3D Porthole Lighting Fix
3039004186.description:
Praise Sigmar! CA have finally addressed 3D portholes with their 5.0 update, and I would say they now look a damned sight better than at launch. That being said, I will continue to keep this mod updated for those who prefer it to vanilla. Thank you to everyone for the kind words of appreciation!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Original:
At long last, the beleaguered inhabitants of Warhammer III have discovered a cure for their collective depression and no longer feel/look so darned blue all the time! 

This mod adjusts some color and lighting values for 3D portholes to get rid of the pervasive blue-purple tint. The result isn't quite an exact approximation of WH1's high-contrast portholes nor of (post-update) WH2's lighting but somewhere in between. Therefore, while for instance the Fay Enchantress now looks a bit more, hmm... "radiant" than usual, it is possible to achieve deeper shadows or more subdued luminosity in your 3D portholes if such is your desire. To do so, open this packfile using RPFM and tweak the ambient cube B/G/R values as well as the tone mapping brightness and burn values to your satisfaction. A screenshot displaying vanilla WH3's values is visible above as a reference.

This is my first mod, so I will do my best to answer any questions in the comments.

3578974048.title: Treasures of the Endless Oceans
3578974048.description:
[h3]What`s this mod about? ➡️ Adding some unique items[/h3]

I always felt it was kind of disappointing that defeating the roving pirates in campaign usually gives you… practically nothing (unless you’re playing Vampire Coast)

This mod fixes that by giving each pirate faction a [b]unique[/b] item you can claim when you beat them. Finally, sinking a legendary pirate feels like it’s worth it.

[hr][/hr]✨ [b]You want more?[/b] Try the improved Version of this mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3601814378]Treasures of the Endless Deeps[/url]✨
[hr][/hr]
[h3] The Items [/h3]

⚫ Dark Pearl of the Forbidden Coast 

🧥 Shadowing Cloak of the Bleak Coast 

🧭 Mulletson’s Mystical Compass 

🗡️ Captain Sisicco’s Poisoned Sabre 

📿 The Tyrant’s Necklace 

🛡️ Cruickshank’s Infested Armour 

💰 Gentlemen Jenkins’ Bottomless Purse 

🏴‍☠️ Banner of the Drowned Fleet (awarded when all of the pirates are defeated and yes: It says banner, but works as a talisman)

Before anyone yells “OP!”: 

1. Yes, the items are strong – but imo not insanely overpowered. It’s compensation for all the times I’ve beaten those pirates and got nothing.

2. I always play on legendary – a few good items don’t hurt there.

3. Most importantly: You don’t have to use this mod if you don’t like it.

[h3] Compatibility: [/h3]

✔️ Should work in multiplayer.

✔️ Should be compatible with most mods, as it only adds rewards to existing pirate factions. (NOT compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3601814378]Treasures of the Endless Deeps[/url]!)

Recommended additional mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3586484854]Roving Pirates Relocated[/url] by Aipe

3594429287.title: AI Camping Settlements Fix 9.x

Made a fix and wanted to share it. Should fix most if not all instances of the AI doing nothing, camping their capitals and cities. 

It overwrites/changes very specific ai behaviors for defending their capitals and settlements, along with the amount of turns they are allowed to 'idle' before they *have* to do something.

This should prevent it from happening on new campaigns as well as fixing ongoing campaigns. Please allow 2-5 turns after this is enabled to show its effects.

Multiplayer and mid-save add/remove safe

2846183349.title: Siege AI & Mechanics Overhaul
2846183349.description:
[h1] This mod changes how siege works in significant ways. Recommended to use with a mod that increases difficulty. Compatible with Ver.9.0.x[/h1]

[b] This mod aims to improve vanilla WH3 and IE experience. A separate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2848282302]mod[/url] that modifies only the siege AI & ogre siege equipment has been published! [/b]


[b]**** SAVE GAME COMPATIBLE ****[/b]
[b]**** COMPATIBLE WITH MOST GARRISON MODS ****[/b]


--- [u]Why I created this mod[/u]:

I hate it that AI factions starve the siege defenders to death 9 times out of 10.
I hate it that players are forced to play the offensive in siege battles time and time again.

--- [u]What this mod does[/u]:
[list]
  [*]AI will more often attack walled/minor settlements rather than starving defenders to death.

  [*]Defensive buildings provide attrition immunity for garrisons; also provide small public order bonus, ammunition bonus (during siege battles) and upkeep reduction (local army). However, due to CA changed how siege turns are calculated, it is impossible as of now to provide siege attrition immunity to local army while allowing enemy to build siege equipment. 

  [*]Players and AI factions cannot build towers and barricades after the battle begins. Initial supply (including buildings, technologies, effects) increases by a lot to compensate.  (inspired by fraggenburg's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789948438]mod[/url])

  [*]Losing control of the key building no longer bleeds ticket (Fixed by CA since 4.0), add a 15% missile block buff to key building's buff, add a stronger speed debuff to traps.

  [*]Increase health of city gates, defensive barricades and walls, increase health for siege towers and ram, increase attack power of ram. (Minor value tweaks for 4.1)

  [*]Siege equipment can be built more quickly.

  [*]Enable unused models for higher tier towers.

  [*]Rework how minor settlement defensive buildings change settlement battle type:
[list]
  [*] Level 1 and 2 minor settlement WITHOUT defensive buildings - skirmish
  [*] Level 2 minor settlement WITH Level 1 defensive buildings - unwalled settlement battle
  [*] Level 3 minor settlement WITH OR WITHOUT defensive buildings - unwalled settlement battle
  [*] Level 3 minor settlement WITH Level 2 defensive buildings - WALLED settlement battle
  [*] Level 2 Dwarf&Bretonnia minor settlement WITH OR WITHOUT defensive buildings - unwalled settlement battle
  [*] Level 3 Bretonnia minor settlement - WALLED settlement battle
[/list]
[/list]

  [*]Ogre AIs can now build some siege equipments, so that they too will initiate siege assaults more often.


[b] Let me know if you encounter any bug or have suggestions for improvement/balancing! [/b]

3149445431.title: Audio Mixer
3149445431.description:
[h1]The Audio Mixer[/h1]
Welcome! First of all let me say without the guidance and innovation of Ole and ChaosRobie none of this fun stuff would be possible.

The Audio Mixer has 3 main functions:

[b]1)[/b] Act as a [b]voiceover (VO) audio compatibility mod[/b]:
[list]
To ensure all VO mods work nicely together a single compatibility mod is needed to combine the inner workings of audio in one place to prevent mods with modded VO from overwriting each other. For those interested the technical reason for this is that only one version of each Dialogue Event in the game's .bnk files can exist, so all modded State Paths in Dialogue Events need to be merged with each other as well as the vanilla State Paths so that there is a single version of each Dialogue Event.[/list]

[b]2)[/b] [b]Facilitate music modding[/b]:
[list]
Total War: Warhammer III features an adaptive music system comprised of modular tracks that change dynamically according to events and the environment in game. While technically impressive this can result in music that feels fragmented and without any musical theme, something which many iconic soundtracks in games and film have. With thanks to the vision and direction of composer Eric Gordon Berg, the Audio Mixer implements a replacement music system for campaign and battle replacing the vanilla system with a more traditional playlist system which randomly plays tracks from a playlist. This, as opposed to a fragmented compilation of tracks, forces music to be complete soundtracks that enrich the game with a bold, thematic and vivid feeling of immersion. The frontend system still functions the same as vanilla where music is linked to frontend themes. As it happens the vanilla music system can't be modded directly so a new system was always necessary, and we believe this new system is a better direction for the game's music. You can mod music through the Audio Mixer Music Manager API. For information on how to use the system refer to the documentation in  
the Audio Mixer's scripts or see Eric Gordon Berg's wonderful [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3581474259][b]Harmony of Shadows - An Original Soundtrack for Cathay[/b][/url].[/list]

[b]3)[/b] Act as a [b]storage facility for custom movie .dat files[/b]:
[list]
Some audio, for example movie audio, requires .dat files (which are involved in playing the audio) to be in a movie-type pack. If modders wish they can store those .dat files in the Audio Mixer and make it a requirement for mods to avoid the various compatibility and testing issues that making your mod a movie-type pack causes, feel free to send the files over if so.[/list]

Join the [url=https://discord.com/channels/373745291289034763/1197167723940155442][b]Modding Den Discord server[/b][/url] to discuss audio further, [url=https://discord.com/channels/373745291289034763/1201320062544511099][b]make a casting call[/b][/url] for your own project, or [url=https://discord.com/channels/373745291289034763/1201928427897098260][b]share your details[/b][/url] as a voice actor.
