2882729230.description:
I have uninstalled the game and will no longer be keeping this mod updated. If you would like to re-upload feel free.

[h3]Introduction[/h3]
This mod adds area of recruitment mercenaries to several factions with some loreful restrictions, please see the unlimited version of the mod here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2882729176 if you would like to be able to recruit all units.

Mercenary recruitment is 50% more expensive than local recruitment for balance purposes.

The AI will also recruit mercenaries from the same pool, but won't drain them :)

----------------------------------

[h3]When[/h3]
Mercenaries will become available in three stages during the campaign:

Early - Turn 1
Mid - Turn 25
Late - Turn 70

Each time new units will unlock and the existing units will start to replenish more often, starting with basic infantry and missile units in the early game and more being added over time.

Some choice regions have certain units available on turn 1 by design, such as tree spirits at Avelorn or artillery at Nuln.

----------------------------------

[h3]Where[/h3]
Mercenaries will spawn in regions culturally belonging to the below races:

High Elves
Dark Elves
Wood Elves
Empire(Including Southern Realms)
Kislev
Lizardmen
Cathay
Ogres
Skaven
Bretonia
Dwarfs
Greenskins
Norsica
Beastmen

This version of the mod contains some restrictions on what mercenaries each race can recruit, please see the table image above for more info.

2985506863.title: Asrai Unit Pack (Wood Elves)
2985506863.description:
[h1] Description [/h1]
• Adds 6 New Units to the Wood Elves faction.
• Officer Models for New Units
• Tech Tree Supported
• Allied Recruitment

[h1] Units [/h1] 
• [T1] [b]Glade Rangers[/b] - [Light Dual Swords Anti-Infantry]

• [T2] [b]Oak Guard[/b] - [Armoured & Shielded Hybrid Infantry]

• [T3] [b]Highborn Sunderers[/b] [Anti-Large Siege Greatbows]

• [T4] [b]Shieldmaidens of Ladrielle[/b] - [Heavily Armoured Defender Infantry]

• [T4] [b]Swordmasters of Eldrazor[/b] - [Armoured Greatswords]

• [T4] [b]Maidens of Kurnous[/b] - [Magical Missile Infantry]

Want to see the Shieldmaidens in the High Elves faction? Sub to this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3654051649]HEF - Shieldmaidens of Ladrielle[/url]

[h1] Balance [/h1] 
These units are not CA balanced, and while I have tried to keep them similar to base stats of other equivalent units they may be stronger or weaker in certain ways. Currently some of these units are quite strong and could use adjustments (stat and/or price adjustments).

Fundamentally, this mod could be seen as unbalanced as it can cover up weaknesses the faction is designed to have.

[h1] Compatibility / Submods [/h1]
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3610261314] SFO Submod [/url] by leginalblat
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2789896406] Tabletop Caps [/url] Built-in to this mod
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3185766002] Armourygeddon Support [/url] by Cipher & RagnaroK
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3190269537] Ignore Trees Submod [/url] by Cipher
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3192223871] Gifts of Athel Loren Submod [/url] by Cipher
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3247724215] Warband Upgrade Ultimate Submod [/url] by CatCanBawl
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297467336]Fay Folk of Athel Loren[/url] by CatCanBawl
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3452601064] Wood Elf Rework - Wildwood and Hearthfire Compatibility Submod [/url] by Das Boots
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3465514808] Wood Elves Rework AND Gifts of Athel Loren Compatibility [/url] by Das Boots
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3252719068] 2x Unit Size [/url] by Steeps
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3774517775] Jade Forest Embassy for Grand Cathay [/url] by Supperbon
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3324604909] KR Translation [/url] by Felix
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3652832056] KoreanTranslation [/url] by IOWA
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3014075713] RU Translation [/url] by Ded_Inside
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2971557979] CN Translation [/url] by 泡泡茶壶
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3030450983] CZ Translation [/url] by Martarios

[h1] Issues [/h1] 
• Some clipping issues here and there
• Most LOD Issues Fixed, but I still recommend [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2856019044] Hooveric LOD mod [/url]
• Can cause FPS drops when many of these units are on screen, particularly with x2 unit count modifier. Working on a performance optimisation patch for it.

[h1] Credits [/h1] 
• Dietrich for the inspiration and for providing the guides I used to learn asset modding. Check out his [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2919155427] Eternal Wood Elves [/url] mod, it works alongside this mod nicely.
• GreyHound for some short descriptions texts.
• CA for practically everything else
• RPFM, AssetEditor & QtRME modding tools
• [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198884562925/]Hecleas[/url] for FPS optimisations and providing a packfile with the fix.

Mods used to capture screenshots:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2937363217] Matthew's Reshade Preset [/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2922534576] Ultimate Lighting 2.0 [/url]

Recommended and compatible reskin [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297467336]Fay Folk of Athel Loren[/url] by CatCanBawl

MODDERS: Feel free to use this mod in any way you want - assets, database, names, anything. No permission needed.

3497444261.title: Druchii Cosmetics (Updated for 9.0.4)
3497444261.description:
Update 19.10.26: 
-"zoomed out" some character portraits on the unit cards
-put new faces on the Witchelves
-fixed issue that could potentially turn the Master invisible in Custom battle

The culmination of about three years worth of small small visual tweaks to the Dark Elves, very loosely based on their 6th edition look.


Highlights include:
-female soldiers added to most of the roster
-Dark Riders and Shades redesigned to be, well, darker
-second wheel added to the Cold One chariot
-abs surgically removed from Witchelves and donated to the Sisters of Slaughter
-unique models added for Black Ark Admirals
-a bunch of additional Hero and Lord variants added


[h1]Attention[/h1]
As of right now Black Ark Admirals might still spawn with the default Dreadlord skin. I'll try to figure out the problem, but I'm still very new to that aspect of modding. In the meantime, I advice you run the mod alongside [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888171970] Marthenil's Variant Selector[/url] and manually pic the version you like.

[h1] FAQ [/h1]
[b] I don't like X aspect of the mod, can you change it? [/b]
I don't do requests, sorry. But if you tell me what's bothering you, I'll tell you how to make the changes yourself. Just PLEASE make sure I haven't already answered your question in the comments. If you don't take the time to read the description or check the comments, I won't respond.

[b] Can I take parts of the mod to use myself? [/b]
Absolutely, go wild. To me, getting to contribute to other people's creative work is the most rewarding aspect of modding. Take whatever you like and don't hesitate to share your work.

[b] Is this compatible with X? [/b]
Should be compatible with anything that doesn't touch the look of the units.

[b] My parents were murdered by female elves and I can't enjoy the game with them in it.[/b]
Look up the early comments on my Asur Cosmetics  mod; I've gone over the process of how to remove the female models and audio.

3628731426.title: Bucket's Better Victory Messages
3628731426.description:
You've fought through the 3rd intense slog of a battle this turn. Your forces are broken, fatigued, and barely hanging on, but victory has been claimed. You click End Battle, and what do you see?

                                         HEROIC VICTORY
   “I see no heroes here. Only pawns playing their roles. Prove me wrong.”

For some reason, CA decided that the text blurbs for each victory and defeat classification (Decisive/Close/Crushing/Heroic/etc.) needs to be super disheartening and not at all fitting for the actual type of victory/defeat. That's where this mod comes in!
Once you install this mod, you'll no longer see the usual, brow-beating text, and instead a much more fitting praise/lament based on how well you won/lost.

   Default
  Decisive Victory: “No mere victory: fates were re-written, destinies ended and the immutable changed. All because of you.”
  Close Victory: "You may call it a victory, I call it fortunate."
  Heroic Victory: "I see no heroes here. Only pawns playing their roles. Prove me wrong."
  Pyrrhic Victory: "A hollow victory. Maybe we should just call it a loss?"
  Draw: "The only winner here is the Blood God, and He is no master of mine!"
  Close Defeat: "Victory was in your grasp… so close you could taste it. Yet, all history will remember is that you lost."
  Crushing Defeat: "Oh dear. My kin are all laughing at you. Perhaps try issuing a few orders next time?"
  Valiant Defeat: "Others will call this valiant or even courageous… It is still a defeat."

   My Mod
  Decisive Victory: "Glory to us all, for we serve no greater a master! Let the world tremble before your prowess!"
  Close Victory: "To snatch victory from the jaws of defeat is the mark of a great leader, though the fallen may not agree..."
  Heroic Victory: "The enemy are retreating and we yet stand! Victory! Glorious victory!"
  Pyrrhic Victory: "If we are victorious in one more battle, we shall be utterly ruined."
  Draw: "To live to fight another day is a victory in its own right..."
  Close Defeat: "On the verge of greatness, you suffer bitter defeat. A tragedy to be remembered."
  Crushing Defeat: "The blood of the vanquished feeds the soil, and shame lies heavy upon your brow."
  Valiant Defeat: "Though victory was not ours to be had this day, it surely does not belong to the enemy either."

3632497242.title: 타락모드 한글 번역 모드 합본팩
3632497242.description:
타락모드 번역 합본입니다. 이번에 업뎃하면서 유기된 타락모드들은 뺐습니다 (발키아 타락모드 같은거)

중요!!!: 여기에 번역된 타락모드들 전부 키면 100% 스트립트 오류 뜹니다 가능하면 서로 관련되거나 요구하는 모드들만 켜주세요

1차 GPT-5.4, 5.5 으로 기계번역을 하고 단어집 기능으로 2차 검수를 했습니다.

진행하시면서 심각한 오역이 있거나 특정 단계에서 팅기는데 번역모드 빼니까 작동되는 버그가 확인되면 캡쳐해서 자세히 알려주서야 확인 가능합니다.

원본 파일들은 아래 링크 혹은 러버즈랩 가서 찾으시면 됩니다 러버즈랩은 제목있으니까 구글 검색해서 하면 바로 찾을수 있을 겁니다 링크 거는건 성인 모드 사이트라서 안됩니다.

특히 러버즈랩 모드들은 요구하는 모드나 같이 쓰면 안되는 모드들도 있기에 내용을 필독해야 합니다
영문 모르시면 우클릭>T 누르시면 사이트 번역되니까 그걸로 참고하면 됩니다.
